BEGIN;

WITH eingang AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoAdmins${{ $json.adminsJson }}$edoAdmins$::jsonb) AS x(
        admin_id text,
        shortcut text,
        permission text,
        is_active boolean
    )
)
INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.trainer_admin AS a
    (admin_id, shortcut, permission, is_active, last_synced_at, is_deleted)
SELECT admin_id, shortcut, permission, is_active, now(), false
FROM eingang
ON CONFLICT (admin_id) DO UPDATE SET
    shortcut       = EXCLUDED.shortcut,
    permission     = EXCLUDED.permission,
    is_active      = EXCLUDED.is_active,
    last_synced_at = now(),
    is_deleted     = false;

UPDATE edoobox_raw.trainer_admin
SET is_deleted = true,
    last_synced_at = now()
WHERE admin_id NOT IN (
    SELECT x.admin_id
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoAdmins${{ $json.adminsJson }}$edoAdmins$::jsonb)
         AS x(admin_id text, shortcut text, permission text, is_active boolean)
);

WITH eingang AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoDates${{ $json.datesJson }}$edoDates$::jsonb) AS x(
        date_id text,
        offer_id text,
        date_start timestamptz,
        date_end timestamptz,
        place_ref text,
        room_ref text,
        leaders jsonb
    )
)
INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.offer_date AS d
    (date_id, offer_id, date_start, date_end, place_ref, room_ref, last_synced_at, is_deleted)
SELECT date_id, offer_id, date_start, date_end, place_ref, room_ref, now(), false
FROM eingang
ON CONFLICT (date_id) DO UPDATE SET
    offer_id       = EXCLUDED.offer_id,
    date_start     = EXCLUDED.date_start,
    date_end       = EXCLUDED.date_end,
    place_ref      = EXCLUDED.place_ref,
    room_ref       = EXCLUDED.room_ref,
    last_synced_at = now(),
    is_deleted     = false;

UPDATE edoobox_raw.offer_date
SET is_deleted = true,
    last_synced_at = now()
WHERE date_id NOT IN (
    SELECT x.date_id
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoDates${{ $json.datesJson }}$edoDates$::jsonb)
         AS x(date_id text, offer_id text, date_start timestamptz, date_end timestamptz,
              place_ref text, room_ref text, leaders jsonb)
);

DELETE FROM edoobox_raw.date_leader;

WITH eingang AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoDates${{ $json.datesJson }}$edoDates$::jsonb) AS x(
        date_id text,
        offer_id text,
        date_start timestamptz,
        date_end timestamptz,
        place_ref text,
        room_ref text,
        leaders jsonb
    )
)
INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.date_leader (date_id, admin_id, last_synced_at)
SELECT e.date_id, l.admin_id, now()
FROM eingang e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(e.leaders) AS l(admin_id)
ON CONFLICT (date_id, admin_id) DO UPDATE SET last_synced_at = now();

COMMIT;

SELECT
    'S54' AS schritt,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.trainer_admin WHERE NOT is_deleted) AS admins_aktiv,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.offer_date WHERE NOT is_deleted) AS datumszeilen_aktiv,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.date_leader) AS trainerzuordnungen,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM kursplan.v_angebot_trainer WHERE zuordnungsstatus = 'offen') AS angebote_ohne_trainer,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM kursplan.v_angebot_trainer WHERE zuordnungsstatus = 'eindeutig') AS angebote_eindeutig,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM kursplan.v_angebot_trainer WHERE zuordnungsstatus = 'mehrfach') AS angebote_mehrfach,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM kursplan.v_angebot_trainer WHERE historische_trainer_anzahl > 0) AS angebote_historischer_trainer;

-- Vollstaendiger Katalog der Preiskategorien als Grundlage fuer die Regeltabelle.
-- Nur lesend.
WITH pos AS (
    SELECT
        p.position_id, p.booking_id,
        coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.pricecategory_name), ''), '(ohne namen)') AS kat,
        coalesce(p.amount_net, 0) AS betrag,
        coalesce(p.quantity, 0)   AS menge,
        s.status, s.netto AS buchung_netto,
        extract(year FROM s.booking_time)::int AS jahr
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
    JOIN kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s ON s.booking_id = p.booking_id
),
roh AS (
    -- A. Jede Preiskategorie mit Betrag null
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Kategorie immer null' AS bereich, kat AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert,
           concat('jahre ', min(jahr), ' bis ', max(jahr),
                  ' / menge ', sum(menge),
                  ' / auf zahlender buchung ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE buchung_netto > 0)) AS hinweis
    FROM pos
    GROUP BY kat
    HAVING max(betrag) = 0

    -- B. Kategorien mit Betrag, vollstaendig
    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Kategorie mit Betrag', kat,
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('netto ', round(sum(betrag * greatest(menge, 1)), 2),
                  ' / spanne ', round(min(betrag) FILTER (WHERE betrag > 0), 2),
                  ' bis ', round(max(betrag), 2),
                  ' / nullzeilen ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE betrag = 0),
                  ' / jahre ', min(jahr), ' bis ', max(jahr))
    FROM pos
    GROUP BY kat
    HAVING max(betrag) > 0

    -- C. Mengen ueber eins, das waeren die zusaetzlichen Personen
    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Menge ueber eins', concat(kat, ' menge ', menge),
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('netto je zeile ', round(min(betrag), 2), ' bis ', round(max(betrag), 2))
    FROM pos WHERE menge > 1
    GROUP BY kat, menge
    HAVING count(*) >= 2

    -- D. Buchungen mit mehreren Positionszeilen
    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Zeilen je Buchung', concat(zeilen::text, ' zeilen'),
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('netto ', round(sum(netto_summe), 2),
                  ' / davon gebucht ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'gebucht'))
    FROM (
        SELECT booking_id, count(*) AS zeilen, status,
               sum(betrag * greatest(menge, 1)) AS netto_summe
        FROM pos GROUP BY booking_id, status
    ) t
    GROUP BY zeilen

    -- E. Kombinationen bei Buchungen mit zwei oder drei Zeilen
    UNION ALL SELECT 50, 'E Kombination', kombination, count(*)::numeric,
           concat('netto ', round(sum(netto_summe), 2))
    FROM (
        SELECT booking_id,
               string_agg(left(kat, 34), ' + ' ORDER BY kat) AS kombination,
               sum(betrag * greatest(menge, 1)) AS netto_summe
        FROM pos GROUP BY booking_id HAVING count(*) BETWEEN 2 AND 3
    ) t
    GROUP BY kombination
    HAVING count(*) >= 3
)
SELECT
    'S32' AS schritt,
    count(*) AS zeilen,
    string_agg(
        concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')),
                  coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
        chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl
    ) AS bericht
FROM roh;

-- Verwaltungsschritt: Betragsvorrang, Zusatzregeln und Rechte fuer n8n_writer.
INSERT INTO kursplan.preiskategorie_regel
    (regel_id, reihenfolge, muster, bezeichnung, ist_erloes, ist_teilnehmer, ist_aktiv, bemerkung)
VALUES
    (15, 15, '^storno|kursumbuchung differenz nach storno',
     'Storno oder Umbuchungsdifferenz', true, false, true, 'Erloes ohne Teilnehmerplatz.'),
    (65, 65, 'nicht anwesend',
     'Gebucht, nicht anwesend', true, true, true, 'Fuer geplante Auslastung als belegter Platz behandelt.'),
    (115, 115, 'rabatt|kombi|paketpreis|angebotspreis|sonderpreis|spezialpreis|special|aktionspreis|early bird|folgebuchung|behordentarif|studenten',
     'Weitere Rabatt- oder Sonderpreise', true, true, true, 'Sammelt historische Schreibvarianten.'),
    (125, 125, 'coaching|unterrichtseinheiten|videokonferenz',
     'Coaching oder Zeiteinheit', true, true, true, NULL),
    (135, 135, 'grundpreis|listenpreis|sondertarif|testtarif|pilotphase|temporar|^neu$',
     'Weitere Preisbezeichnung', true, true, true, NULL)
ON CONFLICT (regel_id) DO UPDATE SET
    reihenfolge = EXCLUDED.reihenfolge,
    muster = EXCLUDED.muster,
    bezeichnung = EXCLUDED.bezeichnung,
    ist_erloes = EXCLUDED.ist_erloes,
    ist_teilnehmer = EXCLUDED.ist_teilnehmer,
    ist_aktiv = EXCLUDED.ist_aktiv,
    bemerkung = EXCLUDED.bemerkung;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION kursplan.einstufung(
    bezeichnung text,
    betrag numeric
)
RETURNS TABLE (ist_erloes boolean, ist_teilnehmer boolean, quelle text)
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
AS $$
    WITH n AS (
        SELECT kursplan.normalisiere(coalesce(bezeichnung, '')) AS wert
    ),
    treffer AS (
        SELECT r.ist_erloes, r.ist_teilnehmer, r.bezeichnung
        FROM kursplan.preiskategorie_regel r, n
        WHERE r.ist_aktiv
          AND n.wert <> ''
          AND n.wert ~ r.muster
        ORDER BY r.reihenfolge
        LIMIT 1
    )
    SELECT CASE WHEN betrag IS NOT NULL AND betrag <> 0 THEN true ELSE t.ist_erloes END,
           t.ist_teilnehmer,
           'regel: ' || t.bezeichnung
    FROM treffer t
    UNION ALL
    SELECT true, true, 'betrag ungleich null'
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM treffer)
      AND betrag IS NOT NULL AND betrag <> 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT false, true, 'betrag ist null'
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM treffer)
      AND betrag IS NOT NULL AND betrag = 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT NULL, NULL, 'ungeklaert'
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM treffer)
      AND betrag IS NULL;
$$;

GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA kursplan TO n8n_writer;
GRANT SELECT ON kursplan.preiskategorie_regel, kursplan.preiskategorie_ausnahme TO n8n_writer;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION kursplan.normalisiere(text) TO n8n_writer;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION kursplan.einstufung(text, numeric) TO n8n_writer;

WITH eingestuft AS (
    SELECT p.position_id, p.pricecategory_name, p.amount_net,
           e.ist_erloes, e.ist_teilnehmer, e.quelle
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL kursplan.einstufung(p.pricecategory_name, p.amount_net) e
),
roh AS (
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Regeln' AS bereich, 'aktive Regeln' AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert, 'erwartet 18' AS hinweis
    FROM kursplan.preiskategorie_regel WHERE ist_aktiv
    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Einstufung', quelle, count(*)::numeric,
           concat('netto ', round(sum(coalesce(amount_net, 0)), 2))
    FROM eingestuft GROUP BY 3
    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Kontrolle', 'positive Betraege ohne Erloeskennzeichen',
           count(*)::numeric, concat('netto ', round(sum(coalesce(amount_net, 0)), 2))
    FROM eingestuft
    WHERE coalesce(amount_net, 0) <> 0 AND ist_erloes IS DISTINCT FROM true
    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Kontrolle', 'ungeklaerte Positionen',
           count(*)::numeric, 'erwartet 0, sofern amount_net nie NULL ist'
    FROM eingestuft WHERE ist_erloes IS NULL OR ist_teilnehmer IS NULL
)
SELECT 'S43a' AS schritt, count(*) AS zeilen,
       string_agg(concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')), coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
                  chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl) AS bericht
FROM roh;

-- Prueft Kategorien, bei denen Name und Betrag widersprechen. Nur lesend.
WITH eingestuft AS (
    SELECT p.position_id,
           coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.pricecategory_name), ''), '(ohne namen)') AS kat,
           coalesce(p.amount_net, 0) AS betrag,
           coalesce(p.quantity, 0) AS menge,
           e.ist_erloes, e.ist_teilnehmer, e.quelle
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL kursplan.einstufung(p.pricecategory_name, p.amount_net) e
),
roh AS (
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Betrag trotz Nichterloesregel' AS bereich,
           kat AS kennzahl, count(*)::numeric AS wert,
           concat('netto ', round(sum(betrag), 2), ' / quelle ', min(quelle),
                  ' / menge ', sum(menge)) AS hinweis
    FROM eingestuft
    WHERE betrag <> 0 AND ist_erloes IS FALSE
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Ungeklaert mit Betrag', kat, count(*)::numeric,
           concat('netto ', round(sum(betrag), 2), ' / menge ', sum(menge))
    FROM eingestuft
    WHERE betrag <> 0 AND ist_erloes IS NULL
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Nullbetrag ohne Regel', kat, count(*)::numeric,
           concat('menge ', sum(menge), ' / quelle ', min(quelle))
    FROM eingestuft
    WHERE betrag = 0 AND quelle = 'betrag ist null'
    GROUP BY 3
)
SELECT 'S43' AS schritt, count(*) AS zeilen,
       string_agg(concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')), coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
                  chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl) AS bericht
FROM roh;

-- Verwaltungsschritt: pflegbare Terminausnahmen und produktive Sicht.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kursplan.termin_ausnahme (
    offer_id text PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES edoobox_raw.offer(offer_id),
    auswertung_ausschliessen boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    grund text NOT NULL,
    erfasst_am timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

INSERT INTO kursplan.termin_ausnahme (offer_id, auswertung_ausschliessen, grund)
SELECT o.offer_id, true,
       CASE WHEN o.offer_number LIKE 'test%' THEN 'Testtermin'
            WHEN o.offer_number = 'office-5er-paket' THEN 'Kontingentkauf, kein Kurstermin'
            ELSE 'Fehl- oder Testtermin laut manueller Pruefung' END
FROM edoobox_raw.offer o
WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
  AND (o.offer_number LIKE 'test%'
       OR o.offer_number = 'office-5er-paket'
       OR (o.offer_number = 'ppt-am-0325' AND o.date_start::date = date '2027-03-27'))
ON CONFLICT (offer_id) DO UPDATE SET
    auswertung_ausschliessen = EXCLUDED.auswertung_ausschliessen,
    grund = EXCLUDED.grund;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW kursplan.v_termin_erloes_produktiv AS
SELECT v.*
FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes v
LEFT JOIN kursplan.termin_ausnahme a ON a.offer_id = v.offer_id
WHERE coalesce(a.auswertung_ausschliessen, false) IS FALSE;

COMMENT ON TABLE kursplan.termin_ausnahme IS
'Manuell gepflegte Angebote, die keine produktiven Kurstermine sind. Rohdaten bleiben erhalten.';
COMMENT ON VIEW kursplan.v_termin_erloes_produktiv IS
'Produktive Teilmenge von v_termin_erloes ohne Testtermine, Kontingentkaeufe und bestaetigte Fehleintraege.';

GRANT SELECT ON kursplan.termin_ausnahme, kursplan.v_termin_erloes_produktiv TO n8n_writer;

WITH roh AS (
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Ausnahme' AS bereich,
           concat(to_char(v.date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ' ', left(v.name, 42)) AS kennzahl,
           coalesce(v.netto_gebucht, 0)::numeric AS wert,
           concat(a.grund, ' / nummer ', v.offer_number) AS hinweis
    FROM kursplan.termin_ausnahme a
    JOIN kursplan.v_termin_erloes v ON v.offer_id = a.offer_id
    WHERE a.auswertung_ausschliessen

    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Kontrolle', 'ausgeschlossene Termine',
           count(*)::numeric, concat('netto ', round(sum(coalesce(v.netto_gebucht, 0)), 2))
    FROM kursplan.termin_ausnahme a
    JOIN kursplan.v_termin_erloes v ON v.offer_id = a.offer_id
    WHERE a.auswertung_ausschliessen

    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Produktive Sicht', 'Termine',
           count(*)::numeric, 'vollstaendige Historie, Erloes erst ab 2023'
    FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes_produktiv

    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Produktive Sicht', 'Netto ab 2023',
           round(coalesce(sum(netto_gebucht), 0), 2),
           'ohne ausgeschlossene Test- und Sondertermine'
    FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes_produktiv
    WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01'
)
SELECT 'S45a' AS schritt, count(*) AS zeilen,
       string_agg(concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')), coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
                  chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, kennzahl) AS bericht
FROM roh;

-- Prueft Teilnehmer je Zahlungsvorgang, damit Preis- und Teilnehmerbuchungen nicht doppelt zaehlen. Nur lesend.
WITH pos AS (
    SELECT p.booking_id,
           coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.pricecategory_name), ''), '(ohne namen)') AS kat,
           coalesce(p.quantity, 0) AS menge,
           CASE
             WHEN p.pricecategory_name ~* '(bis zu|max\\.?|f\\.|fuer|für)[^0-9]{0,12}[0-9]+[[:space:]]*person'
             THEN (substring(p.pricecategory_name from '(?i)(?:bis zu|max\\.?|f\\.|fuer|für)[^0-9]{0,12}([0-9]+)[[:space:]]*person'))::int
           END AS basis_n,
           CASE
             WHEN p.pricecategory_name ~* '[0-9]+[[:space:]]*(personen|person|teiln|teilnehmer)'
             THEN (substring(p.pricecategory_name from '(?i)([0-9]+)[[:space:]]*(?:personen|person|teiln|teilnehmer)'))::int
           END AS text_n,
           (p.pricecategory_name ~* '(jede|je|pro)[[:space:]]+weitere|preis[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*für[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*jede[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*weitere') AS ist_zusatz
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
),
je_buchung AS (
    SELECT b.booking_id, b.offer_id, s.status, coalesce(s.netto, 0) AS netto,
           max(pos.basis_n) AS basis_n,
           max(pos.text_n) AS text_n,
           coalesce(sum(pos.menge) FILTER (WHERE pos.ist_zusatz), 0) AS zusatz_n,
           coalesce(sum(pos.menge) FILTER (WHERE pos.kat = 'Inklusive'), 0) AS inklusive_n,
           bool_or(pos.kat = 'Inklusive') AS hat_inklusive
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
    JOIN kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s ON s.booking_id = b.booking_id
    LEFT JOIN pos ON pos.booking_id = b.booking_id
    GROUP BY b.booking_id, b.offer_id, s.status, 4
),
kopf AS (
    SELECT j.*,
           CASE
             WHEN basis_n IS NOT NULL THEN basis_n + zusatz_n
             WHEN text_n IS NOT NULL THEN text_n
             WHEN hat_inklusive THEN 1 + inklusive_n + zusatz_n
             ELSE 1
           END AS gruppengroesse
    FROM je_buchung j
),
buchung_vorgang AS (
    SELECT k.*,
           coalesce(min(t.transaction_number), 'B:' || k.booking_id::text) AS vorgang
    FROM kopf k
    LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.booking_transaction t ON t.booking_id = k.booking_id
    GROUP BY k.booking_id, k.offer_id, k.status, k.netto, k.basis_n, k.text_n,
             k.zusatz_n, k.inklusive_n, k.hat_inklusive, k.gruppengroesse
),
je_vorgang AS (
    SELECT offer_id, vorgang,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'gebucht') AS buchungen,
           coalesce(max(gruppengroesse) FILTER (WHERE status = 'gebucht'), 0) AS gruppengroesse,
           greatest(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'gebucht'),
                    coalesce(max(gruppengroesse) FILTER (WHERE status = 'gebucht'), 0)) AS plaetze,
           round(coalesce(sum(netto) FILTER (WHERE status = 'gebucht'), 0), 2) AS netto
    FROM buchung_vorgang
    GROUP BY offer_id, vorgang
),
je_termin AS (
    SELECT o.offer_id, o.name, o.date_start, o.user_maximum,
           sum(v.buchungen) AS buchungen,
           sum(v.plaetze) AS plaetze,
           round(sum(v.netto), 2) AS netto,
           count(*) AS vorgaenge
    FROM edoobox_raw.offer o
    JOIN je_vorgang v ON v.offer_id = o.offer_id
    WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
    GROUP BY o.offer_id, o.name, o.date_start, o.user_maximum
),
roh AS (
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Vorgangsgroesse' AS bereich,
           CASE
             WHEN buchungen > 1 AND gruppengroesse > buchungen THEN 'gruppe groesser als buchungszahl'
             WHEN buchungen > 1 AND gruppengroesse = buchungen THEN 'gruppe gleich buchungszahl'
             WHEN buchungen > 1 THEN 'buchungszahl groesser als gruppe'
             WHEN gruppengroesse > 1 THEN 'eine sammelbuchung'
             ELSE 'eine einzelbuchung'
           END AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert,
           concat('buchungen ', sum(buchungen), ' / plaetze ', sum(plaetze), ' / netto ', round(sum(netto), 2)) AS hinweis
    FROM je_vorgang
    WHERE buchungen > 0
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Ueberbuchung Vorgangsregel',
           concat(to_char(date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ' ', left(name, 38)),
           plaetze::numeric,
           concat('hoechstzahl ', user_maximum, ' / buchungen ', buchungen,
                  ' / vorgaenge ', vorgaenge, ' / netto ', netto)
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE user_maximum > 0 AND plaetze > user_maximum

    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Auslastung ab 2023',
           CASE
             WHEN user_maximum IS NULL OR user_maximum = 0 THEN 'ohne hoechstzahl'
             WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum > 1 THEN 'ueber 100 prozent'
             WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum >= 0.75 THEN '75 bis 100 prozent'
             WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum >= 0.5 THEN '50 bis 75 prozent'
             WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum >= 0.25 THEN '25 bis 50 prozent'
             ELSE 'unter 25 prozent'
           END,
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('plaetze ', sum(plaetze), ' / netto ', round(sum(netto), 2))
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE date_start >= '2023-01-01' AND buchungen > 0
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Jahresmittel',
           concat('jahr ', extract(year FROM date_start)::int),
           round(avg(plaetze::numeric / user_maximum) * 100, 1),
           concat('termine ', count(*), ' / plaetze ', sum(plaetze),
                  ' / hoechstzahl ', sum(user_maximum), ' / netto ', round(sum(netto), 2))
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE user_maximum > 0 AND buchungen > 0
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 50, 'E Kontrolltermin',
           concat(to_char(date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ' ', left(name, 38)),
           plaetze::numeric,
           concat('hoechstzahl ', user_maximum, ' / buchungen ', buchungen,
                  ' / vorgaenge ', vorgaenge, ' / netto ', netto)
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE date_start IN ('2022-11-21', '2022-11-22', '2022-11-28', '2022-12-01',
                         '2023-07-19', '2024-02-02', '2024-11-05', '2026-05-21')
)
SELECT 'S39' AS schritt, count(*) AS zeilen,
       string_agg(concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')), coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
                  chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl) AS bericht
FROM roh;

-- Sucht eine belastbare Brücke zwischen Rechnung und Buchung.
WITH eingang AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoJson${{ $json.datenJson }}$edoJson$::jsonb)
         AS t(
            invoice_id       text,
            paytrans         text,
            user_ref_roh     text,
            invoice_number   text,
            amount           numeric,
            status           integer,
            date_create      text,
            offer_start_date text
         )
)
SELECT 'Praefixe unserer transaction_id' AS befund,
       string_agg(DISTINCT split_part(transaction_id, '_', 1), ', ') AS wert
  FROM edoobox_raw.booking_transaction
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Praefixe unserer booking_id',
       string_agg(DISTINCT split_part(booking_id, '_', 1), ', ')
  FROM edoobox_raw.booking
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Praefixe unserer offer_id',
       string_agg(DISTINCT split_part(offer_id, '_', 1), ', ')
  FROM edoobox_raw.offer
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Rechnungsnummer trifft transaction_number',
       count(*)::text
  FROM eingang e
  JOIN edoobox_raw.booking_transaction t ON t.transaction_number = e.invoice_number
UNION ALL
SELECT 'md5(user) trifft booking.user_ref',
       count(DISTINCT e.invoice_id)::text
  FROM eingang e
  JOIN edoobox_raw.booking b ON b.user_ref = md5(e.user_ref_roh)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'davon eindeutig auf genau eine Buchung',
       count(*)::text
  FROM (
    SELECT e.invoice_id
      FROM eingang e
      JOIN edoobox_raw.booking b ON b.user_ref = md5(e.user_ref_roh)
     GROUP BY e.invoice_id
    HAVING count(*) = 1
  ) x
UNION ALL
SELECT 'md5(user) und Kursbeginn treffen zusammen',
       count(DISTINCT e.invoice_id)::text
  FROM eingang e
  JOIN edoobox_raw.booking b ON b.user_ref = md5(e.user_ref_roh)
  JOIN edoobox_raw.offer o   ON o.offer_id = b.offer_id
 WHERE o.date_start = e.offer_start_date::timestamptz
UNION ALL
SELECT 'davon eindeutig auf genau eine Buchung',
       count(*)::text
  FROM (
    SELECT e.invoice_id
      FROM eingang e
      JOIN edoobox_raw.booking b ON b.user_ref = md5(e.user_ref_roh)
      JOIN edoobox_raw.offer o   ON o.offer_id = b.offer_id
     WHERE o.date_start = e.offer_start_date::timestamptz
     GROUP BY e.invoice_id
    HAVING count(*) = 1
  ) y
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Rechnungsbetrag trifft Betrag eines Zahlungsvorgangs',
       count(DISTINCT e.invoice_id)::text
  FROM eingang e
  JOIN edoobox_raw.booking_transaction t ON round(t.amount, 2) = round(e.amount, 2)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Beispiel transaction_id (gekuerzt)',
       string_agg(kurz, ' | ')
  FROM (
    SELECT split_part(transaction_id, '_', 1) || '_…' AS kurz
      FROM edoobox_raw.booking_transaction
     LIMIT 3
  ) z;

-- Verwaltungsschritt: fuellt kursplan.preiskategorie_regel.
-- Hierfuer das Verwaltungscredential verwenden.
INSERT INTO kursplan.preiskategorie_regel

VALUES
    (10, 10, 'stornogebuehr|stornogebuhr|diff nach verrechnung',
     'Stornoausgleich', true, false, true, 'Erloes ohne belegten Teilnehmerplatz.'),
    (20, 20, 'nachhol|ersatztermin|ersatzkurs|wiederhol',

     'Extern verrechnet', false, true, true, 'Buchungsposition ohne eigenen Betrag, Teilnehmer zaehlt.'),
    (40, 40, 'inklusive',
     'Im Gruppenpreis enthalten', false, true, true, 'Teil der Gruppengroesse, nicht nochmals als Erloes.'),
    (50, 50, 'kostenlos|gratis|gast|nulltarif',
     'Kostenlose Teilnahme', false, true, true, 'Teilnehmer ohne Erloes.'),
    (60, 60, '^intern$|organisator|^-$|^--$|^---$|trainerausfall',

    (70, 70, 'kombibuchung|kombirabatt',

    (80, 80, 'last ?-? ?mi[a-z]*te|last minute',

    (90, 90, 'standard ?-? ?preis|^standard$',
     'Standardpreis', true, true, true, NULL),
    (100, 100, 'partner',
     'Partnerrabatt', true, true, true, NULL),
    (110, 110, 'privatbucher|behoerdenrabatt|behordenrabatt|kundenrabatt|vereinsrabatt|rabatt fuer schulen|anschluss|paketrabatt|gruppenrabatt',
     'Sonstiger Rabatt', true, true, true, NULL),
    (120, 120, 'weitere person|weitere teilnehmer|pro person|personen|teiln|gruppenpreis|gruppenanmeldung|workshop|webinarpreis|firmenwebinar',
     'Personen- oder Gruppenpreis', true, true, true, 'Gruppenpreise werden in der Platzsicht gesondert behandelt.'),
    (130, 130, 'kurspreis|kursgebuehr|kursgebuhr|gesamtpreis|^preis$|^preis ',

ON CONFLICT (regel_id) DO UPDATE SET
    reihenfolge = EXCLUDED.reihenfolge,
    muster = EXCLUDED.muster,
    bezeichnung = EXCLUDED.bezeichnung,
    ist_erloes = EXCLUDED.ist_erloes,
    ist_teilnehmer = EXCLUDED.ist_teilnehmer,
    ist_aktiv = EXCLUDED.ist_aktiv,
    bemerkung = EXCLUDED.bemerkung;

GRANT SELECT ON kursplan.preiskategorie_regel TO n8n_writer;

WITH eingestuft AS (
    SELECT p.position_id, p.pricecategory_name, p.amount_net,
           e.ist_erloes, e.ist_teilnehmer, e.quelle
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL kursplan.einstufung(p.pricecategory_name, p.amount_net) e
),
roh AS (
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Regeln' AS bereich, 'aktive Regeln' AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert, 'erwartet 13' AS hinweis
    FROM kursplan.preiskategorie_regel WHERE ist_aktiv

    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Einstufung', quelle, count(*)::numeric,
           concat('netto ', round(sum(coalesce(amount_net, 0)), 2))
    FROM eingestuft
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Ungeklaert mit Betrag',
           coalesce(nullif(btrim(pricecategory_name), ''), '(ohne namen)'),
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('netto ', round(sum(coalesce(amount_net, 0)), 2))
    FROM eingestuft
    WHERE quelle = 'ungeklaert' AND coalesce(amount_net, 0) <> 0
    GROUP BY 3
    HAVING count(*) >= 2
)
SELECT 'S42a' AS schritt, count(*) AS zeilen,
       string_agg(concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')), coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
                  chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl) AS bericht
FROM roh;

WITH vorherige_laeufe AS (

        status = 'abgebrochen',

)

data.name: S63 Kostenkonfiguration schliessen und neue Trainer/Kurscodes anlegen

parameters.query:
-- S63: letzte offene Kostenkonfiguration schliessen und O-10 (Teilumfang)
-- neue Trainer/Kurscodes vollstaendig anlegen, ohne historische Platzhalter
-- zu erfinden. Wiederholbar (idempotent) als Pflegeschritt nach P01/P03.

-- 1) Neue Trainerprofile vollstaendig anlegen (nur aktuelle Admin-Liste).
INSERT INTO kursplan.trainer_kostenprofil_admin
    (admin_id, trainer_code, kostenrolle, tarif_1, tarif_2, standard_tarif, ist_aktiv, bemerkung, geaendert_am)
SELECT
    ta.admin_id,
    coalesce(nullif(btrim(ta.shortcut), ''), ta.admin_id),
    'fremd',
    270.00,
    370.00,
    NULL,
    true,
    'S63: neu angelegt; Kostenrolle und Tarife vor Verwendung pruefen',
    now()
FROM edoobox_raw.trainer_admin ta
WHERE ta.is_deleted = false
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM kursplan.trainer_kostenprofil_admin p WHERE p.admin_id = ta.admin_id
  )
ON CONFLICT (admin_id) DO NOTHING;

-- 2) Offene Fremdtrainer-Kurs-Kombinationen vollstaendig regeln.
INSERT INTO kursplan.trainer_kurs_tarifregel
    (admin_id, kurscode, tarif, trainerkosten_override, ist_aktiv, bemerkung, geaendert_am)
SELECT
    k.admin_id,
    k.kurscode,
    'tarif_1',
    NULL,
    true,
    'S63: neu angelegte Regel; Tarif pruefen (Standard tarif_1)',
    now()
FROM kursplan.v_angebot_trainerkosten k
WHERE k.date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01'
  AND k.kostenkonfiguration_fehlt
  AND k.kostenrolle = 'fremd'
  AND k.standard_tarif IS NULL
  AND k.verwendeter_tarif IS NULL
  AND k.verwendeter_override IS NULL
GROUP BY k.admin_id, k.kurscode
ON CONFLICT (admin_id, kurscode) DO UPDATE
SET tarif = 'tarif_1',
    trainerkosten_override = NULL,
    ist_aktiv = true,
    bemerkung = EXCLUDED.bemerkung,
    geaendert_am = now();

-- 3) Kontrolle
WITH offen AS (
    SELECT count(*) AS anzahl, round(coalesce(sum(netto_gebucht), 0), 2) AS netto
    FROM kursplan.v_termin_db1
    WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01'
      AND kosten_aktiv
      AND kostenkonfiguration_fehlt
),
neue_profile AS (
    SELECT count(*) AS anzahl FROM kursplan.trainer_kostenprofil_admin
    WHERE bemerkung LIKE '%S63%'
),
neue_regeln AS (
    SELECT count(*) AS anzahl FROM kursplan.trainer_kurs_tarifregel
    WHERE bemerkung LIKE '%S63%'
)
SELECT
    'S63'::text AS schritt,
    'A Kontrolle'::text AS bereich,
    'offene Kostenkonfigurationen nach Fix'::text AS kennzahl,
    o.anzahl::numeric AS wert,
    concat('Netto ', o.netto) AS hinweis
FROM offen o
UNION ALL SELECT 'S63', 'B Neue Profile', 'neu angelegte Trainerprofile', p.anzahl, 'idempotent' FROM neue_profile p
UNION ALL SELECT 'S63', 'C Neue Regeln', 'neu angelegte Trainer-Kurs-Regeln', r.anzahl, 'tarif_1 als Standard' FROM neue_regeln r
ORDER BY bereich;

-- Klaert, was die 82 Termine ohne Erloes und die 435 Buchungen darauf sind.
-- Nutzt die Merkmalsfelder der Angebotstabelle. Nur lesend.
WITH je_termin AS (
    SELECT
        s.offer_id,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'gebucht')                       AS gebucht,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'gebucht' AND coalesce(s.netto, 0) = 0) AS gebucht_null,
        round(coalesce(sum(s.netto) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'gebucht'), 0), 2)   AS netto
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s
    WHERE s.offer_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY s.offer_id
),
gruppe AS (
    SELECT
        o.*,
        t.gebucht, t.gebucht_null, t.netto,
        CASE
            WHEN t.gebucht = 0 THEN 'ohne gebuchte buchung'
            WHEN t.netto = 0 THEN 'nur nullbuchungen'
            WHEN t.gebucht_null > 0 THEN 'gemischt'
            ELSE 'nur zahlende'
        END::text AS art,
        EXISTS (SELECT 1
                  FROM kursplan.v_buchung_rechnung vr
                  JOIN edoobox_raw.booking bb ON bb.booking_id = vr.booking_id
                 WHERE bb.offer_id = o.offer_id) AS hat_rechnung,
        o.payload ->> 'mustpay'       AS p_mustpay,
        o.payload ->> 'internal_code'  AS p_internal_code
    FROM edoobox_raw.offer o
    JOIN je_termin t ON t.offer_id = o.offer_id
    WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
),
roh AS (
    -- A. Merkmale der Termine, gruppiert nach Art
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Merkmale je Art' AS bereich,
           concat(art, ' | mustpay ', coalesce(p_mustpay, 'leer'),
                  ' | modus ', coalesce(mode, 'leer'),
                  ' | typ ', coalesce(offer_type, 'leer')) AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert,
           concat('mit rechnung ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE hat_rechnung),
                  ' / netto ', round(sum(netto), 2)) AS hinweis
    FROM gruppe
    GROUP BY art, p_mustpay, mode, offer_type
    HAVING count(*) >= 3

    -- B. Nur die Nulltermine, weitere Merkmale
    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Nulltermin Merkmale',
           concat('vat_rate ', coalesce(vat_rate::text, 'leer'),
                  ' | land ', coalesce(country, 'leer'),
                  ' | status ', coalesce(status, 'leer'),
                  ' | multi ', coalesce(is_multi_offer::text, 'leer')),
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('interner code gesetzt bei ',
                  count(*) FILTER (WHERE nullif(p_internal_code, '') IS NOT NULL))
    FROM gruppe WHERE art = 'nur nullbuchungen'
    GROUP BY 3

    -- C. Zum Vergleich: Termine mit Erloes
    UNION ALL SELECT 21, 'C Vergleich zahlende Termine',
           concat('vat_rate ', coalesce(vat_rate::text, 'leer'),
                  ' | land ', coalesce(country, 'leer'),
                  ' | multi ', coalesce(is_multi_offer::text, 'leer')),
           count(*)::numeric, NULL
    FROM gruppe WHERE art IN ('nur zahlende', 'gemischt')
    GROUP BY 3
    HAVING count(*) >= 5

    -- D. Die Nulltermine einzeln
    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'D Nulltermin einzeln',
           concat(coalesce(to_char(date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'ohne datum'), ' ',
                  left(coalesce(name, 'ohne name'), 46)),
           gebucht::numeric,
           concat('nr ', coalesce(offer_number, '-'),
                  ' / max ', coalesce(user_maximum::text, '-'),
                  ' / rechnung ', hat_rechnung::text,
                  ' / code ', coalesce(nullif(p_internal_code, ''), '-'))
    FROM gruppe WHERE art = 'nur nullbuchungen'

    -- E. Kennzeichen is_multi_offer auf der Buchung selbst
    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'E Buchungskennzeichen',
           concat('nullbuchung multi ', coalesce(b.is_multi_offer::text, 'leer'),
                  ' quelle ', coalesce(b.source, 'leer')),
           count(*)::numeric, NULL
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s
    JOIN edoobox_raw.booking b ON b.booking_id = s.booking_id
    WHERE s.status = 'gebucht' AND coalesce(s.netto, 0) = 0
    GROUP BY 3
    UNION ALL SELECT 41, 'E Buchungskennzeichen',
           concat('zahlende buchung multi ', coalesce(b.is_multi_offer::text, 'leer'),
                  ' quelle ', coalesce(b.source, 'leer')),
           count(*)::numeric, NULL
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s
    JOIN edoobox_raw.booking b ON b.booking_id = s.booking_id
    WHERE s.status = 'gebucht' AND s.netto > 0
    GROUP BY 3

    -- F. Positionszeilen mit Betrag null
    UNION ALL SELECT 50, 'F Nullposition',
           left(coalesce(p.pricecategory_name, 'ohne name'), 60),
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('davon auf zahlenden buchungen ',
                  count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.netto > 0))
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
    JOIN kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s ON s.booking_id = p.booking_id
    WHERE coalesce(p.amount_net, 0) = 0
    GROUP BY 3
    HAVING count(*) >= 10

    -- G. Welche Rohfelder liefert die Schnittstelle je Termin
    UNION ALL SELECT 60, 'G Rohfeld im Nulltermin', schluessel, count(*)::numeric,
           NULL
    FROM gruppe g2, jsonb_object_keys(g2.payload) AS schluessel
    WHERE g2.art = 'nur nullbuchungen' AND jsonb_typeof(g2.payload) = 'object'
    GROUP BY schluessel
    HAVING count(*) >= 20
)
SELECT
    'S31' AS schritt,
    count(*) AS zeilen,
    string_agg(
        concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')),
                  coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
        chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl
    ) AS bericht
FROM roh;

-- Abnahme der drei Sichten. Nur lesend.
SELECT * FROM (
    -- A. Steuerfall je Buchung
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Steuerfall' AS bereich, steuerfall AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert,
           concat('netto ', round(coalesce(sum(netto), 0), 2),
                  ' / steuer ', round(coalesce(sum(steuerbetrag), 0), 2),
                  ' / b2b ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_b2b)) AS hinweis
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer
    GROUP BY steuerfall

    -- B. Steuerfall nur fuer gebuchte Buchungen
    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Steuerfall nur gebucht', steuerfall,
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('netto ', round(coalesce(sum(netto), 0), 2),
                  ' / brutto ', round(coalesce(sum(brutto), 0), 2))
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer WHERE status = 'gebucht'
    GROUP BY steuerfall

    -- C. Nominalsatz gegen Steuerfall, nur wo es auseinandergeht
    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Nominal gegen gemessen',
           concat('nominal ', coalesce(nominalsatz::text, 'ohne'), ' / ', steuerfall),
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('b2b ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_b2b),
                  ' / nicht b2b ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_b2b IS NOT TRUE))
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer
    GROUP BY nominalsatz, steuerfall
    HAVING count(*) >= 3

    -- D. Die abweichenden Faktoren einzeln
    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Abweichende Faktoren',
           concat('faktor ', coalesce(faktor::text, 'ohne'),
                  ' bei nominal ', coalesce(nominalsatz::text, 'ohne')),
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('netto ', round(sum(netto), 2), ' / brutto ', round(sum(brutto), 2),
                  ' / status ', string_agg(DISTINCT status, ' '))
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer
    WHERE steuerfall = 'abweichend'
    GROUP BY faktor, nominalsatz

    -- E. Buchungen ohne Betrag
    UNION ALL SELECT 50, 'E Ohne Betrag',
           concat(status, ' netto ',
                  CASE WHEN netto IS NULL THEN 'leer' WHEN netto = 0 THEN 'null' ELSE 'vorhanden' END,
                  ' brutto ',
                  CASE WHEN brutto IS NULL THEN 'leer' WHEN brutto = 0 THEN 'null' ELSE 'vorhanden' END),
           count(*)::numeric, NULL
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer
    WHERE netto IS NULL OR netto = 0 OR brutto IS NULL OR brutto = 0
    GROUP BY 3

    -- F. Zuordnungsgrad
    UNION ALL SELECT 60, 'F Zuordnungsgrad', zuordnungsgrad,
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat(count(DISTINCT invoice_id), ' Rechnungen / ',
                  count(DISTINCT booking_id), ' Buchungen')
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_rechnung
    GROUP BY zuordnungsgrad
    UNION ALL SELECT 61, 'F Zuordnungsgrad', 'buchungen mit mehreren rechnungen',
           count(DISTINCT booking_id)::numeric, NULL
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_rechnung WHERE mehrere_rechnungen

    -- G. Termine und Erloes
    UNION ALL SELECT 70, 'G Termine', 'termine gesamt',
           count(*)::numeric, NULL FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes
    UNION ALL SELECT 71, 'G Termine', 'termine mit buchung',
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE buchungen_gebucht > 0)::numeric, NULL
    FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes
    UNION ALL SELECT 72, 'G Termine', 'summe netto gebucht',
           round(sum(netto_gebucht), 2),
           'Vergleich Schritt 18: 784854.84' FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes
    UNION ALL SELECT 73, 'G Termine', 'summe brutto gebucht',
           round(sum(brutto_gebucht), 2),
           'Vergleich Zahlungsvorgaenge: 848037.44' FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes
    UNION ALL SELECT 74, 'G Termine', 'summe plaetze gebucht',
           sum(plaetze_gebucht)::numeric, NULL FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes
    UNION ALL SELECT 75, 'G Termine', 'auslastung ueber 100 prozent',
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE auslastung_prozent > 100)::numeric,
           concat('hoechstwert ', max(auslastung_prozent)) FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes
    UNION ALL SELECT 76, 'G Termine', 'ohne hoechstteilnehmerzahl',
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE user_maximum IS NULL OR user_maximum = 0)::numeric,
           NULL FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes

    -- H. Gegenprobe Nettoerloes aus zwei Quellen
    UNION ALL SELECT 80, 'H Gegenprobe', 'netto aus v_buchung_steuer gebucht',
           (SELECT round(sum(netto), 2) FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer
             WHERE status = 'gebucht')::numeric,
           'ohne Bezug auf einen Termin enthalten'
    UNION ALL SELECT 81, 'H Gegenprobe', 'netto aus booking_position gebucht',
           (SELECT round(sum(p.amount_net * coalesce(p.quantity, 1)), 2)
              FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
              JOIN edoobox_raw.booking b ON b.booking_id = p.booking_id
             WHERE b.status = 'gebucht')::numeric, NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 82, 'H Gegenprobe', 'netto aller buchungen',
           (SELECT round(sum(netto), 2) FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer)::numeric, NULL
) x
ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl;

-- Prueft einen eigenen Kurscode aus offer_number. Nur lesend.
WITH codes AS (
    SELECT v.*,
           nullif(regexp_replace(
               regexp_replace(lower(v.offer_number), '^[0-9]+-', ''),
               '-[0-9]{4}(-[0-9]+)?$', ''
           ), '') AS kurscode
    FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes_produktiv v
),
je_code AS (
    SELECT kurscode, count(*) AS termine, count(DISTINCT name) AS namen,
           min(name) AS beispielname,
           round(sum(coalesce(netto_gebucht, 0)), 2) AS netto,
           sum(plaetze_gebucht) AS plaetze
    FROM codes
    GROUP BY kurscode
),
je_name AS (
    SELECT name, count(DISTINCT kurscode) AS codes,
           string_agg(DISTINCT kurscode, ' / ' ORDER BY kurscode) AS codeliste
    FROM codes
    WHERE kurscode IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY name
),
roh AS (
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Kurscode' AS bereich, 'verschiedene Kurscodes' AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert,
           concat('termine ', sum(termine), ' / namen ', sum(namen)) AS hinweis
    FROM je_code
    WHERE kurscode IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Groesste Kursgruppen',
           concat(left(kurscode, 28), ' / ', left(beispielname, 34)),
           termine::numeric,
           concat('namen ', namen, ' / plaetze ', plaetze, ' / netto ab 2023 ', netto)
    FROM je_code
    WHERE kurscode IS NOT NULL AND termine >= 5
),
roh2 AS (
    SELECT * FROM roh
    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Code mit mehreren Namen',
           concat(left(kurscode, 32), ' / ', left(beispielname, 35)),
           namen::numeric,
           concat('termine ', termine, ' / netto ', netto)
    FROM je_code
    WHERE namen > 1

    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Name mit mehreren Codes',
           left(name, 45), codes::numeric, left(codeliste, 150)
    FROM je_name
    WHERE codes > 1

    UNION ALL SELECT 50, 'E Fehlender Kurscode',
           coalesce(left(name, 45), '(ohne name)'), count(*)::numeric,
           'offer_number ist leer oder nicht auswertbar'
    FROM codes
    WHERE kurscode IS NULL
    GROUP BY 3
)
SELECT 'S46' AS schritt, count(*) AS zeilen,
       string_agg(concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')), coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
                  chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl) AS bericht
FROM roh2;

-- S60: rein lesende Entscheidungsgrundlage fuer offene Fremdtrainertarife.
-- Bei kuenftigen Mehrfachzuweisungen erscheint jeder Trainer getrennt.
-- Netto ist deshalb ein Kontextwert und darf dann nicht ueber Trainer summiert werden.
WITH offen AS (
    SELECT
        offer_id,
        admin_id,
        trainer_code,
        kurscode,
        kursbezeichnung,
        date_start,
        kostenphase,
        netto_gebucht,
        tarif_1,
        tarif_2
    FROM kursplan.v_angebot_trainerkosten
    WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01'
      AND kosten_aktiv
      AND kostenkonfiguration_fehlt
),
trainer_gesamt AS (
    SELECT
        admin_id,
        trainer_code,
        count(DISTINCT offer_id) AS angebote_offen,
        count(DISTINCT kurscode) AS kurscodes,
        count(DISTINCT offer_id) FILTER (WHERE kostenphase = 'ist') AS angebote_ist,
        count(DISTINCT offer_id) FILTER (WHERE kostenphase = 'prognose') AS angebote_prognose,
        round(sum(coalesce(netto_gebucht, 0)), 2) AS netto_kontext,
        min(date_start) AS erster_termin,
        max(date_start) AS letzter_termin
    FROM offen
    GROUP BY admin_id, trainer_code
),
trainer_kurs AS (
    SELECT
        admin_id,
        trainer_code,
        kurscode,
        min(kursbezeichnung) AS kursbezeichnung,
        count(DISTINCT offer_id) AS angebote_offen,
        count(DISTINCT offer_id) FILTER (WHERE kostenphase = 'ist') AS angebote_ist,
        count(DISTINCT offer_id) FILTER (WHERE kostenphase = 'prognose') AS angebote_prognose,
        round(sum(coalesce(netto_gebucht, 0)), 2) AS netto_kontext,
        min(tarif_1) AS tarif_1,
        min(tarif_2) AS tarif_2,
        round(count(DISTINCT offer_id) * min(tarif_1), 2) AS kosten_bei_tarif_1,
        round(count(DISTINCT offer_id) * min(tarif_2), 2) AS kosten_bei_tarif_2,
        min(date_start) AS erster_termin,
        max(date_start) AS letzter_termin
    FROM offen
    GROUP BY admin_id, trainer_code, kurscode
),
kontrolle AS (
    SELECT
        count(*) AS angebote_offen,
        round(sum(coalesce(netto_gebucht, 0)), 2) AS netto_offen
    FROM kursplan.v_termin_db1
    WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01'
      AND kosten_aktiv
      AND kostenkonfiguration_fehlt
),
roh AS (
    SELECT
        10 AS sort_bereich,
        'A Trainer gesamt'::text AS bereich,
        g.trainer_code AS trainer,
        g.admin_id,
        NULL::text AS kurscode,
        NULL::text AS kursbezeichnung,
        g.angebote_offen,
        g.kurscodes,
        g.angebote_ist,
        g.angebote_prognose,
        g.netto_kontext,
        NULL::numeric AS tarif_1,
        NULL::numeric AS tarif_2,
        NULL::numeric AS kosten_bei_tarif_1,
        NULL::numeric AS kosten_bei_tarif_2,
        g.erster_termin,
        g.letzter_termin,
        'Netto ist bei Mehrfachtrainern nur ein Kontextwert'::text AS entscheidung
    FROM trainer_gesamt g

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        20,
        'B Trainer x Kurscode',
        k.trainer_code,
        k.admin_id,
        k.kurscode,
        k.kursbezeichnung,
        k.angebote_offen,
        NULL::bigint,
        k.angebote_ist,
        k.angebote_prognose,
        k.netto_kontext,
        k.tarif_1,
        k.tarif_2,
        k.kosten_bei_tarif_1,
        k.kosten_bei_tarif_2,
        k.erster_termin,
        k.letzter_termin,
        'Auswahl: tarif_1, tarif_2 oder individueller Betrag'::text
    FROM trainer_kurs k

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        30,
        'C Kontrolle',
        '(gesamt)',
        NULL,
        NULL,
        NULL,
        k.angebote_offen,
        NULL::bigint,
        NULL::bigint,
        NULL::bigint,
        k.netto_offen,
        NULL::numeric,
        NULL::numeric,
        NULL::numeric,
        NULL::numeric,
        NULL::timestamptz,
        NULL::timestamptz,
        'Erwartet: 350 Angebote und 236552.89 Netto'::text
    FROM kontrolle k
)
SELECT
    'S60' AS schritt,
    bereich,
    trainer,
    admin_id,
    kurscode,
    kursbezeichnung,
    angebote_offen,
    kurscodes,
    angebote_ist,
    angebote_prognose,
    netto_kontext,
    tarif_1,
    tarif_2,
    kosten_bei_tarif_1,
    kosten_bei_tarif_2,
    erster_termin,
    letzter_termin,
    entscheidung
FROM roh
ORDER BY sort_bereich, netto_kontext DESC, trainer, angebote_offen DESC, kurscode;

-- Sichten fuer Zuordnung und Steuer. Version 1.0
-- Auszufuehren mit dem Verwaltungskonto kursplan_user.
-- Sichten statt Tabellen, damit die Zuordnung nicht veralten kann.

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Zuordnung Buchung zu Rechnung
-- Grundlage ist invoice_item.transaction_id, also der harte Verweis.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW kursplan.v_buchung_rechnung AS
WITH paar AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        t.booking_id,
        i.invoice_id
    FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_item i
    JOIN edoobox_raw.booking_transaction t
      ON t.transaction_id = i.transaction_id
),
je_rechnung AS (
    SELECT invoice_id, count(*) AS buchungen FROM paar GROUP BY invoice_id
),
je_buchung AS (
    SELECT booking_id, count(*) AS rechnungen FROM paar GROUP BY booking_id
)
SELECT
    p.booking_id,
    p.invoice_id,
    r.buchungen        AS buchungen_der_rechnung,
    b.rechnungen       AS rechnungen_der_buchung,
    CASE
        WHEN r.buchungen = 1 THEN 'eindeutig'
        WHEN r.buchungen BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN 'geschlossener_kurs'
        ELSE 'sammelrechnung'
    END::text          AS zuordnungsgrad,
    (b.rechnungen > 1) AS mehrere_rechnungen
FROM paar p
JOIN je_rechnung r ON r.invoice_id = p.invoice_id
JOIN je_buchung  b ON b.booking_id = p.booking_id;

COMMENT ON VIEW kursplan.v_buchung_rechnung IS
'Zuordnung ueber invoice_item.transaction_id. zuordnungsgrad unterscheidet Einzel-, Kurs- und Sammelrechnung.';

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. Steuer und Erloes je Buchung
-- Der gemessene Faktor brutto zu netto ist die Wahrheit,
-- der Nominalsatz aus der Rechnung nur Einordnung.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW kursplan.v_buchung_steuer AS
WITH netto AS (
    SELECT
        booking_id,
        sum(amount_net * coalesce(quantity, 1)) AS netto,
        sum(coalesce(quantity, 1))              AS plaetze,
        count(*)                                AS positionen
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position
    GROUP BY booking_id
),
brutto AS (
    SELECT
        booking_id,
        sum(amount)      AS brutto,
        count(*)         AS vorgaenge,
        min(currency)    AS waehrung
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_transaction
    GROUP BY booking_id
),
nominal AS (
    SELECT
        t.booking_id,
        max(i.vat_percent) AS nominalsatz,
        bool_or(i.item_type = 't_manualtrans') AS hat_manuellen_posten
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_transaction t
    JOIN edoobox_raw.invoice_item i ON i.transaction_id = t.transaction_id
    GROUP BY t.booking_id
)
SELECT
    b.booking_id,
    b.offer_id,
    b.status,
    b.booking_time,
    b.is_b2b,
    coalesce(br.waehrung, 'EUR')::char(3) AS waehrung,
    n.netto,
    n.plaetze,
    n.positionen,
    br.brutto,
    br.vorgaenge,
    nm.nominalsatz,
    CASE WHEN n.netto > 0 AND br.brutto IS NOT NULL
         THEN round(br.brutto / n.netto, 3) END AS faktor,
    CASE WHEN n.netto > 0 AND br.brutto IS NOT NULL
         THEN round((br.brutto / n.netto - 1) * 100, 2) END AS satz_gemessen,
    CASE WHEN br.brutto IS NOT NULL AND n.netto IS NOT NULL
         THEN round(br.brutto - n.netto, 2) END AS steuerbetrag,
    -- Einordnung des gemessenen Satzes
    CASE
        WHEN n.netto IS NULL OR n.netto <= 0 OR br.brutto IS NULL THEN 'unbestimmt'
        WHEN abs(br.brutto / n.netto - 1.000) <= 0.002 THEN 'ohne_steuer'
        WHEN abs(br.brutto / n.netto - 1.250) <= 0.002 THEN 'dk_25'
        WHEN abs(br.brutto / n.netto - 1.190) <= 0.002 THEN 'de_19'
        WHEN abs(br.brutto / n.netto - 1.160) <= 0.002 THEN 'de_16'
        WHEN abs(br.brutto / n.netto - 1.200) <= 0.002 THEN 'at_20'
        WHEN abs(br.brutto / n.netto - 1.081) <= 0.002 THEN 'ch_81'
        WHEN abs(br.brutto / n.netto - 1.077) <= 0.002 THEN 'ch_77'
        ELSE 'abweichend'
    END::text AS steuerfall,
    nm.hat_manuellen_posten
FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
LEFT JOIN netto   n  ON n.booking_id  = b.booking_id
LEFT JOIN brutto  br ON br.booking_id = b.booking_id
LEFT JOIN nominal nm ON nm.booking_id = b.booking_id
WHERE b.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE;

COMMENT ON VIEW kursplan.v_buchung_steuer IS
'Netto aus booking_position, brutto aus booking_transaction. satz_gemessen ist die abgerechnete Steuer, nominalsatz nur der hinterlegte Satz der Preiskategorie.';
COMMENT ON COLUMN kursplan.v_buchung_steuer.steuerfall IS
'ohne_steuer entspricht Reverse Charge oder Nullsatz. abweichend deutet auf Teilzahlung oder Gutschrift.';

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. Erloes je Kurstermin
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW kursplan.v_termin_erloes AS
SELECT
    o.offer_id,
    o.offer_number,
    o.name,
    o.offerdef_ref,
    o.date_start,
    o.date_end,
    o.user_minimal,
    o.user_maximum,
    o.status                                                   AS termin_status,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'gebucht')               AS buchungen_gebucht,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'storniert')             AS buchungen_storniert,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'warteliste')            AS buchungen_warteliste,
    coalesce(sum(s.plaetze) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'gebucht'), 0)      AS plaetze_gebucht,
    round(coalesce(sum(s.netto)  FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'gebucht'), 0), 2) AS netto_gebucht,
    round(coalesce(sum(s.brutto) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'gebucht'), 0), 2) AS brutto_gebucht,
    CASE WHEN o.user_maximum > 0
         THEN round(100.0 * coalesce(sum(s.plaetze) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'gebucht'), 0)
                    / o.user_maximum, 1) END                   AS auslastung_prozent,
    (SELECT count(DISTINCT vr.invoice_id)
       FROM kursplan.v_buchung_rechnung vr
       JOIN edoobox_raw.booking bb ON bb.booking_id = vr.booking_id
      WHERE bb.offer_id = o.offer_id)                          AS rechnungen
FROM edoobox_raw.offer o
LEFT JOIN kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s ON s.offer_id = o.offer_id
WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
GROUP BY o.offer_id, o.offer_number, o.name, o.offerdef_ref,
         o.date_start, o.date_end, o.user_minimal, o.user_maximum, o.status;

COMMENT ON VIEW kursplan.v_termin_erloes IS
'Erloes und Auslastung je Kurstermin. Grundlage fuer die Deckungsbeitragsrechnung.';

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. Rechte
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
GRANT SELECT ON
    kursplan.v_buchung_rechnung,
    kursplan.v_buchung_steuer,
    kursplan.v_termin_erloes
TO n8n_writer;

-- Kontrolle
SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.views
      WHERE table_schema = 'kursplan'
        AND table_name IN ('v_buchung_rechnung','v_buchung_steuer','v_termin_erloes')) AS sichten,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM kursplan.v_buchung_rechnung)  AS zuordnungen,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer)    AS buchungen,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes)     AS termine;

    status                integer,              -- 1 offen, 2 bezahlt, 3 storniert

    tax_basis_total       numeric(12,2),        -- taxBasisTotalAmount
    tax_total             numeric(12,2),        -- taxTotalAmount
    grand_total           numeric(12,2),        -- grandTotalAmount
    due_payable           numeric(12,2),        -- duePayableAmount
    prepaid_total         numeric(12,2),        -- totalPrepaidAmount
    allowance_total       numeric(12,2),        -- allowanceTotalAmount

-- Verwaltungsschritt: ersetzt nur kursplan.v_termin_erloes.
-- Hierfuer das Verwaltungscredential verwenden.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW kursplan.v_termin_erloes AS
WITH pos AS (
    SELECT p.booking_id,
           coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.pricecategory_name), ''), '(ohne namen)') AS kat,
           coalesce(p.quantity, 0) AS menge,
           CASE WHEN p.pricecategory_name ~* '(bis zu|max\\.?|f\\.|fuer|für)[^0-9]{0,12}[0-9]+[[:space:]]*person'
                THEN (substring(p.pricecategory_name from '(?i)(?:bis zu|max\\.?|f\\.|fuer|für)[^0-9]{0,12}([0-9]+)[[:space:]]*person'))::int END AS basis_n,
           CASE WHEN p.pricecategory_name ~* '[0-9]+[[:space:]]*(personen|person|teiln|teilnehmer)'
                THEN (substring(p.pricecategory_name from '(?i)([0-9]+)[[:space:]]*(?:personen|person|teiln|teilnehmer)'))::int END AS text_n,
           (p.pricecategory_name ~* '(jede|je|pro)[[:space:]]+weitere|preis[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*für[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*jede[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*weitere') AS ist_zusatz
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
),
je_buchung AS (
    SELECT b.booking_id, b.offer_id, b.status,
           coalesce(s.netto, 0) AS netto,
           coalesce(s.brutto, 0) AS brutto,
           max(pos.basis_n) AS basis_n,
           max(pos.text_n) AS text_n,
           coalesce(sum(pos.menge) FILTER (WHERE pos.ist_zusatz), 0) AS zusatz_n,
           coalesce(sum(pos.menge) FILTER (WHERE pos.kat = 'Inklusive'), 0) AS inklusive_n,
           coalesce(bool_or(pos.kat = 'Inklusive'), false) AS hat_inklusive
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
    LEFT JOIN kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s ON s.booking_id = b.booking_id
    LEFT JOIN pos ON pos.booking_id = b.booking_id
    WHERE b.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
    GROUP BY b.booking_id, b.offer_id, b.status, s.netto, s.brutto
),
kopf AS (
    SELECT j.*,
           CASE WHEN basis_n IS NOT NULL THEN basis_n + zusatz_n
                WHEN text_n IS NOT NULL THEN text_n
                WHEN hat_inklusive THEN 1 + inklusive_n + zusatz_n
                ELSE 1 END AS abgeleitet
    FROM je_buchung j
),
je_termin AS (
    SELECT o.offer_id,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht') AS buchungen_gebucht,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'storniert') AS buchungen_storniert,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'warteliste') AS buchungen_warteliste,
           greatest(
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht'),
               coalesce(sum(k.abgeleitet) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht' AND k.netto <> 0), 0),
               coalesce(max(k.abgeleitet) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht' AND k.netto = 0), 0)
           )::numeric AS plaetze_gebucht,
           round(coalesce(sum(k.netto) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht'), 0), 2) AS netto,
           round(coalesce(sum(k.brutto) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht'), 0), 2) AS brutto
    FROM edoobox_raw.offer o
    LEFT JOIN kopf k ON k.offer_id = o.offer_id
    WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
    GROUP BY o.offer_id
)
SELECT o.offer_id,
       o.offer_number,
       o.name,
       o.offerdef_ref,
       o.date_start,
       o.date_end,
       o.user_minimal,
       o.user_maximum,
       o.status AS termin_status,
       t.buchungen_gebucht,
       t.buchungen_storniert,
       t.buchungen_warteliste,
       t.plaetze_gebucht,
       CASE WHEN o.date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01' THEN t.netto ELSE NULL::numeric END AS netto_gebucht,
       CASE WHEN o.date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01' THEN t.brutto ELSE NULL::numeric END AS brutto_gebucht,
       CASE WHEN o.user_maximum > 0
            THEN round(100.0 * t.plaetze_gebucht / o.user_maximum, 1) END AS auslastung_prozent,
       CASE WHEN o.date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01'
            THEN (SELECT count(DISTINCT vr.invoice_id)
                    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_rechnung vr
                    JOIN edoobox_raw.booking bb ON bb.booking_id = vr.booking_id
                   WHERE bb.offer_id = o.offer_id)
            ELSE NULL::bigint END AS rechnungen
FROM edoobox_raw.offer o
JOIN je_termin t ON t.offer_id = o.offer_id
WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE;

COMMENT ON VIEW kursplan.v_termin_erloes IS
'Auslastung aus Buchungsanzahl, bezahlten Gruppengroessen und groesster kostenloser Gruppe. Erloes und Rechnungszahl werden nur fuer Termine ab 2023 ausgewiesen.';

GRANT SELECT ON kursplan.v_termin_erloes TO n8n_writer;

WITH roh AS (
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Sicht' AS bereich, 'zeilen' AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert, 'erwartet Anzahl nicht geloeschter Angebote' AS hinweis
    FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes
    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Erloeszeitraum', 'termine vor 2023 ohne netto',
           count(*)::numeric, 'netto_gebucht muss NULL sein'
    FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes
    WHERE date_start < timestamp '2023-01-01' AND netto_gebucht IS NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Erloeszeitraum', 'netto ab 2023',
           round(coalesce(sum(netto_gebucht), 0), 2), 'nur gebuchte Buchungen nach Termindatum'
    FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes
    WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01'
    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Auslastung', 'termine ueber 100 prozent ab 2023',
           count(*)::numeric, 'erwartet 11'
    FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes
    WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01' AND auslastung_prozent > 100
)
SELECT 'S41a' AS schritt, count(*) AS zeilen,
       string_agg(concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')), hinweis),
                  chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung) AS bericht
FROM roh;

-- Spiegelt ein Paket Rechnungen samt Posten, Zeilen, Zahlungen und Belegen.
-- Die Kindeintraege verbinden sich mit kopf_geschrieben, damit PostgreSQL
-- den Kopf zwingend vor den Kindern schreibt und der Fremdschluessel haelt.
WITH kopf_eingang AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoKopf${{ $json.kopfJson }}$edoKopf$::jsonb)
         AS t(
            invoice_id       text,
            invoice_number   text,
            user_ref_roh     text,
            status           integer,
            status_text      text,
            currency         text,
            amount           numeric,
            amount_pay       numeric,
            line_total       numeric,
            tax_basis_total  numeric,
            tax_total        numeric,
            grand_total      numeric,
            due_payable      numeric,
            prepaid_total    numeric,
            allowance_total  numeric,
            charge_total     numeric,
            date_create      text,
            date_pay         text,
            date_payuntil    text,
            date_cancelled   text,
            offer_start_date text,
            address_country  text,
            address_postcode text,
            buyer_reference  text,
            language         text
         )
),
kopf_neu AS (
    SELECT
        e.invoice_id,
        e.invoice_number,
        CASE WHEN e.user_ref_roh IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE md5(e.user_ref_roh) END AS user_ref,
        e.status,
        e.status_text,
        upper(coalesce(nullif(e.currency, ''), 'EUR'))::char(3) AS currency,
        e.amount, e.amount_pay, e.line_total, e.tax_basis_total, e.tax_total,
        e.grand_total, e.due_payable, e.prepaid_total, e.allowance_total, e.charge_total,
        e.date_create::timestamptz      AS date_create,
        e.date_pay::timestamptz        AS date_pay,
        e.date_payuntil::timestamptz   AS date_payuntil,
        e.date_cancelled::timestamptz  AS date_cancelled,
        e.offer_start_date::timestamptz AS offer_start_date,
        e.address_country, e.address_postcode, e.buyer_reference, e.language,
        md5(concat_ws('|', e.invoice_number, e.status::text, e.amount::text,
                      e.amount_pay::text, e.tax_total::text, e.grand_total::text,
                      e.date_pay, e.date_cancelled)) AS payload_hash
    FROM kopf_eingang e
    WHERE e.invoice_id IS NOT NULL
),
kopf_vorher AS (
    SELECT n.invoice_id, a.payload_hash AS alt
    FROM kopf_neu n
    LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.invoice a ON a.invoice_id = n.invoice_id
),
kopf_geschrieben AS (
    INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.invoice AS z (
        invoice_id, invoice_number, user_ref, status, status_text, currency,
        amount, amount_pay, line_total, tax_basis_total, tax_total,
        grand_total, due_payable, prepaid_total, allowance_total, charge_total,
        date_create, date_pay, date_payuntil, date_cancelled, offer_start_date,
        address_country, address_postcode, buyer_reference, language,
        payload_hash, last_synced_at, last_changed_at, is_deleted
    )
    SELECT
        n.invoice_id, n.invoice_number, n.user_ref, n.status, n.status_text, n.currency,
        n.amount, n.amount_pay, n.line_total, n.tax_basis_total, n.tax_total,
        n.grand_total, n.due_payable, n.prepaid_total, n.allowance_total, n.charge_total,
        n.date_create, n.date_pay, n.date_payuntil, n.date_cancelled, n.offer_start_date,
        n.address_country, n.address_postcode, n.buyer_reference, n.language,
        n.payload_hash, now(), now(), false
    FROM kopf_neu n
    ON CONFLICT (invoice_id) DO UPDATE SET
        invoice_number   = EXCLUDED.invoice_number,
        user_ref         = EXCLUDED.user_ref,
        status           = EXCLUDED.status,
        status_text      = EXCLUDED.status_text,
        currency         = EXCLUDED.currency,
        amount           = EXCLUDED.amount,
        amount_pay       = EXCLUDED.amount_pay,
        line_total       = EXCLUDED.line_total,
        tax_basis_total  = EXCLUDED.tax_basis_total,
        tax_total        = EXCLUDED.tax_total,
        grand_total      = EXCLUDED.grand_total,
        due_payable      = EXCLUDED.due_payable,
        prepaid_total    = EXCLUDED.prepaid_total,
        allowance_total  = EXCLUDED.allowance_total,
        charge_total     = EXCLUDED.charge_total,
        date_create      = EXCLUDED.date_create,
        date_pay         = EXCLUDED.date_pay,
        date_payuntil    = EXCLUDED.date_payuntil,
        date_cancelled   = EXCLUDED.date_cancelled,
        offer_start_date = EXCLUDED.offer_start_date,
        address_country  = EXCLUDED.address_country,
        address_postcode = EXCLUDED.address_postcode,
        buyer_reference  = EXCLUDED.buyer_reference,
        language         = EXCLUDED.language,
        payload_hash     = EXCLUDED.payload_hash,
        last_synced_at   = now(),
        last_changed_at  = CASE WHEN z.payload_hash IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.payload_hash
                                THEN now() ELSE z.last_changed_at END,
        is_deleted       = false
    RETURNING z.invoice_id
),
posten_eingang AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoPosten${{ $json.postenJson }}$edoPosten$::jsonb)
         AS t(
            invoice_id            text,
            item_key              text,
            item_type             text,
            transaction_id        text,
            transaction_number    text,
            description           text,
            amount                numeric,
            vat_percent           numeric,
            vat_ref               text,
            promotion_name        text,
            promotion_amount      numeric,
            promotion_vat_percent numeric,
            pricecategory_count   integer
         )
),
posten_geschrieben AS (
    INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.invoice_item AS z (
        invoice_id, item_key, item_type, transaction_id, transaction_number,
        description, amount, vat_percent, vat_ref,
        promotion_name, promotion_amount, promotion_vat_percent,
        pricecategory_count, last_synced_at
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.invoice_id, p.item_key)
        p.invoice_id, p.item_key, p.item_type, p.transaction_id, p.transaction_number,
        p.description, p.amount, p.vat_percent, p.vat_ref,
        p.promotion_name, p.promotion_amount, p.promotion_vat_percent,
        p.pricecategory_count, now()
    FROM posten_eingang p
    JOIN kopf_geschrieben k ON k.invoice_id = p.invoice_id
    WHERE p.item_key IS NOT NULL
    ON CONFLICT (invoice_id, item_key) DO UPDATE SET
        item_type             = EXCLUDED.item_type,
        transaction_id        = EXCLUDED.transaction_id,
        transaction_number    = EXCLUDED.transaction_number,
        description           = EXCLUDED.description,
        amount                = EXCLUDED.amount,
        vat_percent           = EXCLUDED.vat_percent,
        vat_ref               = EXCLUDED.vat_ref,
        promotion_name        = EXCLUDED.promotion_name,
        promotion_amount      = EXCLUDED.promotion_amount,
        promotion_vat_percent = EXCLUDED.promotion_vat_percent,
        pricecategory_count   = EXCLUDED.pricecategory_count,
        last_synced_at        = now()
    RETURNING 1
),
zeilen_eingang AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoZeilen${{ $json.zeilenJson }}$edoZeilen$::jsonb)
         AS t(
            invoice_id          text,
            position            integer,
            quantity            numeric,
            price_net           numeric,
            price_net_summation numeric,
            vat_type            text,
            vat_percent         numeric,
            transaction_number  text,
            details             text
         )
),
zeilen_geschrieben AS (
    INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.invoice_line AS z (
        invoice_id, position, quantity, price_net, price_net_summation,
        vat_type, vat_percent, transaction_number, details, last_synced_at
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.invoice_id, l.position)
        l.invoice_id, l.position, l.quantity, l.price_net, l.price_net_summation,
        l.vat_type, l.vat_percent, l.transaction_number, l.details, now()
    FROM zeilen_eingang l
    JOIN kopf_geschrieben k ON k.invoice_id = l.invoice_id
    WHERE l.position IS NOT NULL
    ON CONFLICT (invoice_id, position) DO UPDATE SET
        quantity            = EXCLUDED.quantity,
        price_net           = EXCLUDED.price_net,
        price_net_summation = EXCLUDED.price_net_summation,
        vat_type            = EXCLUDED.vat_type,
        vat_percent         = EXCLUDED.vat_percent,
        transaction_number  = EXCLUDED.transaction_number,
        details             = EXCLUDED.details,
        last_synced_at      = now()
    RETURNING 1
),
zahlung_eingang AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoZahlung${{ $json.zahlungJson }}$edoZahlung$::jsonb)
         AS t(
            pay_id     text,
            invoice_id text,
            amount     numeric,
            currency   text,
            status     integer,
            date_pay   text,
            system     text,
            system_id  text
         )
),
zahlung_geschrieben AS (
    INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.invoice_payment AS z (
        pay_id, invoice_id, amount, currency, status, date_pay, system, system_id, last_synced_at
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.pay_id)
        p.pay_id, p.invoice_id, p.amount,
        upper(coalesce(nullif(p.currency, ''), 'EUR'))::char(3),
        p.status, p.date_pay::timestamptz, p.system, p.system_id, now()
    FROM zahlung_eingang p
    JOIN kopf_geschrieben k ON k.invoice_id = p.invoice_id
    WHERE p.pay_id IS NOT NULL
    ON CONFLICT (pay_id) DO UPDATE SET
        invoice_id     = EXCLUDED.invoice_id,
        amount         = EXCLUDED.amount,
        currency       = EXCLUDED.currency,
        status         = EXCLUDED.status,
        date_pay       = EXCLUDED.date_pay,
        system         = EXCLUDED.system,
        system_id      = EXCLUDED.system_id,
        last_synced_at = now()
    RETURNING 1
),
beleg_eingang AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoBeleg${{ $json.belegJson }}$edoBeleg$::jsonb)
         AS t(
            receipt_id     text,
            invoice_id     text,
            receipt_number text,
            amount         numeric,
            currency       text,
            date_create    text
         )
),
beleg_geschrieben AS (
    INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.invoice_receipt AS z (
        receipt_id, invoice_id, receipt_number, amount, currency, date_create, last_synced_at
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (b.receipt_id)
        b.receipt_id, b.invoice_id, b.receipt_number, b.amount,
        upper(coalesce(nullif(b.currency, ''), 'EUR'))::char(3),
        b.date_create::timestamptz, now()
    FROM beleg_eingang b
    JOIN kopf_geschrieben k ON k.invoice_id = b.invoice_id
    WHERE b.receipt_id IS NOT NULL
    ON CONFLICT (receipt_id) DO UPDATE SET
        invoice_id     = EXCLUDED.invoice_id,
        receipt_number = EXCLUDED.receipt_number,
        amount         = EXCLUDED.amount,
        currency       = EXCLUDED.currency,
        date_create    = EXCLUDED.date_create,
        last_synced_at = now()
    RETURNING 1
)
SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM kopf_geschrieben)                                     AS koepfe,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM kopf_vorher WHERE alt IS NULL)                        AS neu,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM posten_geschrieben)                                   AS posten,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM zeilen_geschrieben)                                   AS zeilen,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM zahlung_geschrieben)                                  AS zahlungen,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM beleg_geschrieben)                                    AS belege,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM posten_eingang WHERE transaction_id IS NOT NULL)      AS posten_mit_vorgang;

WITH abgebrochen AS (
    UPDATE edoobox_raw.sync_run
    SET status = 'abgebrochen',
        finished_at = now(),
        error_text = 'Durch neuen Lauf (P05) ersetzt'
    WHERE run_type = 'P05'
      AND status = 'laeuft'
)
INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.sync_run (run_type, status, abgleichsart, hinweis)
VALUES ('P05', 'laeuft', $1, $2)
RETURNING run_id, started_at, status;

SELECT resource, gemeldet, gelesen, neu, geaendert, geloescht, api_calls
FROM edoobox_raw.sync_run_resource
WHERE run_id = $1
ORDER BY resource;

UPDATE edoobox_raw.sync_run
SET
    status = $1,
    finished_at = now(),
    resources_total = $2,
    resources_failed = $3,
    records_seen = $4,
    records_new = $5,
    records_changed = $6,
    records_deleted = $7,
    api_calls_total = $8,
    error_text = $9
WHERE run_id = $10
RETURNING run_id, status, finished_at, resources_total, resources_failed,
          records_seen, records_new, records_changed, records_deleted, api_calls_total;

options.systemMessage:
Du bist ein n8n-Workflow-Reviewer und Validator.

Aufgabe:
Prüfe das erhaltene n8n-Workflow-JSON auf:
- syntaktische Korrektheit
- Importierbarkeit
- korrekte Node-Typen
- gültige Verbindungen

Regeln:

-- Angebotstabelle, einmalig mit dem Eigentuemerkonto anzulegen.
-- Kernfelder sind typisiert, die vollstaendige Antwort wird zusaetzlich
-- als payload abgelegt. So sind spaetere Auswertungen moeglich, ohne
-- die Struktur erneut aendern zu muessen.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS edoobox_raw.offer (
    offer_id            text        PRIMARY KEY,
    offer_number        text,
    name                text,
    category_ref        text,
    offerdef_ref        text,
    place_ref           text,
    date_start          timestamptz,
    date_end            timestamptz,
    date_signupstart    timestamptz,
    date_close          timestamptz,
    user_minimal        integer,
    user_maximum        integer,
    status              text,
    mode                text,
    offer_type          text,
    vat_rate            numeric(6,3),
    country             text,
    internal_code       text,
    is_archived         boolean     NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    is_trash            boolean     NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    has_waiting_list    boolean,
    mustpay             boolean,
    is_multi_offer      boolean,
    is_multi_offer_child boolean,
    payload             jsonb,
    first_seen_at       timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    last_synced_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    last_changed_at     timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    payload_hash        text,
    is_deleted          boolean     NOT NULL DEFAULT false
);

COMMENT ON TABLE edoobox_raw.offer IS
    'Spiegelung von GET /v2/offer/list. Ein Satz je Kursangebot bzw Termin.';

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS offer_start_idx     ON edoobox_raw.offer (date_start);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS offer_category_idx  ON edoobox_raw.offer (category_ref);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS offer_aktiv_idx     ON edoobox_raw.offer (is_deleted, is_archived, is_trash);
