parameters.query:
-- Klaert die sechs gebuchten Buchungen ohne aktives Angebot. Nur lesend, ohne Klardaten.
WITH kandidaten AS (
    SELECT b.booking_id, b.offer_id, b.booking_time, b.status,
           coalesce(s.netto, 0) AS netto,
           o.offer_id AS vorhandenes_offer, o.is_deleted AS offer_geloescht,
           string_agg(DISTINCT left(coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.pricecategory_name), ''), '(ohne namen)'), 45), ' + ') AS kategorien
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
    LEFT JOIN kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s ON s.booking_id = b.booking_id
    LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.offer o ON o.offer_id = b.offer_id
    LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.booking_position p ON p.booking_id = b.booking_id
    WHERE b.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE AND b.status = 'gebucht'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM edoobox_raw.offer oa
          WHERE oa.offer_id = b.offer_id AND oa.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
      )
    GROUP BY b.booking_id, b.offer_id, b.booking_time, b.status, s.netto,
             o.offer_id, o.is_deleted
),
rechnung AS (
    SELECT vr.booking_id,
           count(DISTINCT vr.invoice_id) AS rechnungen,
           min(i.offer_start_date) AS erster_rechnungstermin,
           max(i.offer_start_date) AS letzter_rechnungstermin,
           round(sum(DISTINCT i.grand_total), 2) AS rechnungssumme
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_rechnung vr
    JOIN edoobox_raw.invoice i ON i.invoice_id = vr.invoice_id
    GROUP BY vr.booking_id
),
termin_treffer AS (
    SELECT k.booking_id, r.erster_rechnungstermin,
           count(o.offer_id) AS angebote_am_datum,
           string_agg(left(o.offer_number, 28), ' / ' ORDER BY o.offer_number) AS nummern
    FROM kandidaten k
    JOIN rechnung r ON r.booking_id = k.booking_id
    LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.offer o
      ON o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
     AND o.date_start::date = r.erster_rechnungstermin::date
    GROUP BY k.booking_id, r.erster_rechnungstermin
),
roh AS (
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Buchung ohne Angebot' AS bereich,
           concat(to_char(k.booking_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ' b', right(k.booking_id::text, 5)) AS kennzahl,
           k.netto::numeric AS wert,
           concat('offer ', left(coalesce(k.offer_id, '-'), 24),
                  ' / in Tabelle ', CASE WHEN k.vorhandenes_offer IS NULL THEN 'nein' ELSE 'ja' END,
                  ' / geloescht ', coalesce(k.offer_geloescht::text, '-'),
                  ' / ', left(coalesce(k.kategorien, '-'), 90)) AS hinweis
    FROM kandidaten k

    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Rechnungsbezug',
           concat('b', right(k.booking_id::text, 5)),
           coalesce(r.rechnungen, 0)::numeric,
           concat('termin ', coalesce(to_char(r.erster_rechnungstermin, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '-'),
                  ' / letzter ', coalesce(to_char(r.letzter_rechnungstermin, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '-'),
                  ' / rechnungssumme ', coalesce(r.rechnungssumme::text, '-'))
    FROM kandidaten k
    LEFT JOIN rechnung r ON r.booking_id = k.booking_id

    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Angebote am Rechnungsdatum',
           concat('b', right(k.booking_id::text, 5)),
           coalesce(t.angebote_am_datum, 0)::numeric,
           concat('datum ', coalesce(to_char(t.erster_rechnungstermin, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '-'),
                  ' / nummern ', left(coalesce(t.nummern, '-'), 120))
    FROM kandidaten k
    LEFT JOIN termin_treffer t ON t.booking_id = k.booking_id
)
SELECT 'S45' AS schritt, count(*) AS zeilen,
       string_agg(concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')), coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
                  chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, kennzahl) AS bericht
FROM roh;

-- Prueft Buchungen ohne Angebot und Test-/Zukunftstermine. Nur lesend.
WITH basis AS (
    SELECT b.booking_id, b.offer_id, b.status, b.booking_time,
           coalesce(s.netto, 0) AS netto,
           o.offer_id AS gefunden, o.date_start, o.name, o.offer_number
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
    LEFT JOIN kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s ON s.booking_id = b.booking_id
    LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.offer o ON o.offer_id = b.offer_id AND o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
    WHERE b.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
),
roh AS (
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Ohne Angebot' AS bereich,
           concat(coalesce(extract(year FROM booking_time)::int::text, 'ohne jahr'), ' ', status) AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert,
           concat('netto ', round(sum(netto), 2), ' / verschiedene offer_id ', count(DISTINCT offer_id)) AS hinweis
    FROM basis
    WHERE gefunden IS NULL
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Nettozuordnung gebucht',
           CASE WHEN gefunden IS NULL THEN 'ohne angebot'
                WHEN date_start IS NULL THEN 'angebot ohne terminstart'
                WHEN date_start < timestamp '2023-01-01' THEN 'termin vor 2023'
                ELSE 'termin ab 2023' END,
           round(sum(netto), 2),
           concat('buchungen ', count(*))
    FROM basis
    WHERE status = 'gebucht'
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Sichtabgleich', 'netto v_termin_erloes ab 2023',
           round(coalesce(sum(netto_gebucht), 0), 2),
           concat('termine ', count(*))
    FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes
    WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01'

    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Verdaechtiger Termin',
           concat(to_char(date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ' ', left(coalesce(name, 'ohne name'), 38)),
           round(sum(netto), 2),
           concat('buchungen ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'gebucht'),
                  ' / nummer ', left(coalesce(min(offer_number), '-'), 35))
    FROM basis
    WHERE gefunden IS NOT NULL
      AND (name ~* '(^|[^a-z])test([^a-z]|$)|office-kurse 5er-paket' OR date_start >= timestamp '2027-01-01')
    GROUP BY date_start, name

    UNION ALL SELECT 50, 'E Zukunft mit Buchung',
           concat(to_char(date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ' ', left(coalesce(name, 'ohne name'), 38)),
           round(sum(netto) FILTER (WHERE status = 'gebucht'), 2),
           concat('gebucht ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'gebucht'),
                  ' / storniert ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'storniert'))
    FROM basis
    WHERE gefunden IS NOT NULL AND date_start > current_timestamp
    GROUP BY date_start, name
    HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'gebucht') > 0
)
SELECT 'S44' AS schritt, count(*) AS zeilen,
       string_agg(concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')), coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
                  chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl) AS bericht
FROM roh;

-- Einmaliger Verwaltungsschritt fuer die edoobox-Trainerzuordnung.
-- Mehrere Trainer je Datumszeile und je Gesamtangebot sind ausdruecklich erlaubt.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS edoobox_raw.trainer_admin (
    admin_id       text PRIMARY KEY,
    shortcut       text,
    permission     text,
    is_active      boolean,
    first_seen_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    last_synced_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    is_deleted     boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
);

COMMENT ON TABLE edoobox_raw.trainer_admin IS
    'Datenschutzarme Referenz auf edoobox /admin/list; keine Namen oder Kontaktdaten.';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS edoobox_raw.offer_date (
    date_id        text PRIMARY KEY,
    offer_id       text NOT NULL,
    date_start     timestamptz,
    date_end       timestamptz,
    place_ref      text,
    room_ref       text,
    first_seen_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    last_synced_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    is_deleted     boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS offer_date_offer_idx
    ON edoobox_raw.offer_date (offer_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS offer_date_start_idx
    ON edoobox_raw.offer_date (date_start);

COMMENT ON TABLE edoobox_raw.offer_date IS
    'Spiegelung von edoobox /date/list; mehrere Datums- oder Modulzeilen je Angebot sind erlaubt.';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS edoobox_raw.date_leader (
    date_id        text NOT NULL REFERENCES edoobox_raw.offer_date(date_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    admin_id       text NOT NULL,
    last_synced_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (date_id, admin_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS date_leader_admin_idx
    ON edoobox_raw.date_leader (admin_id);

COMMENT ON TABLE edoobox_raw.date_leader IS
    'n:m-Zuordnung zwischen Datumszeilen und Trainern; historische Admin-IDs bleiben erhalten.';

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW kursplan.v_angebot_trainer AS
SELECT
    o.offer_id,
    count(DISTINCT dl.admin_id)::integer AS trainer_anzahl,
    array_agg(DISTINCT dl.admin_id ORDER BY dl.admin_id)
        FILTER (WHERE dl.admin_id IS NOT NULL) AS admin_ids,
    count(DISTINCT dl.admin_id) FILTER (WHERE a.admin_id IS NULL)::integer
        AS historische_trainer_anzahl,
    CASE
        WHEN count(DISTINCT dl.admin_id) = 0 THEN 'offen'
        WHEN count(DISTINCT dl.admin_id) = 1 THEN 'eindeutig'
        ELSE 'mehrfach'
    END::text AS zuordnungsstatus
FROM edoobox_raw.offer o
LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.offer_date d
  ON d.offer_id = o.offer_id
 AND d.is_deleted = false
LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.date_leader dl
  ON dl.date_id = d.date_id
LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.trainer_admin a
  ON a.admin_id = dl.admin_id
 AND a.is_deleted = false
WHERE o.is_deleted = false
GROUP BY o.offer_id;

TO n8n_writer;

WITH abgebrochen AS (
    UPDATE edoobox_raw.sync_run
    SET status = 'abgebrochen',
        finished_at = now(),
        error_text = 'Durch neuen Lauf (P02) ersetzt'
    WHERE run_type = 'P02'
      AND status = 'laeuft'
)
INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.sync_run (run_type, status, abgleichsart)
VALUES ('P02', 'laeuft', 'normal')
RETURNING run_id, started_at, status;

WITH erwartet AS (
    SELECT * FROM (VALUES
        ('edo_admins'), ('edo_vat'), ('edo_countries'), ('edo_categories'), ('edo_users')
    ) AS v(resource)
),
messung AS (
    SELECT
        coalesce(sum(gelesen), 0)   AS records_seen,
        coalesce(sum(neu), 0)       AS records_new,
        coalesce(sum(geaendert), 0) AS records_changed,
        coalesce(sum(geloescht), 0) AS records_deleted,
        coalesce(sum(api_calls), 0) AS api_calls_total,
        count(srr.resource)         AS gelesene_ressourcen,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE srr.gemeldet IS NULL OR srr.gemeldet <> srr.gelesen) AS unvollstaendig
    FROM erwartet e
    LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.sync_run_resource srr
           ON srr.resource = e.resource AND srr.run_id = $1
),
fehlend AS (
    SELECT count(*) AS anz
    FROM erwartet e
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM edoobox_raw.sync_run_resource srr
         WHERE srr.resource = e.resource AND srr.run_id = $1
    )
)
UPDATE edoobox_raw.sync_run
SET
    status = CASE WHEN (f.anz + m.unvollstaendig) = 0 THEN 'erfolgreich' ELSE 'fehler' END,
    finished_at = now(),
    resources_total = (SELECT count(*) FROM erwartet),
    resources_failed = f.anz + m.unvollstaendig,
    records_seen = m.records_seen,
    records_new = m.records_new,
    records_changed = m.records_changed,
    records_deleted = m.records_deleted,
    api_calls_total = m.api_calls_total,
    error_text = CASE
        WHEN (f.anz + m.unvollstaendig) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE 'Ressourcen fehlend: ' || f.anz || ', unvollstaendig: ' || m.unvollstaendig
    END
FROM messung m, fehlend f
WHERE run_id = $1
RETURNING run_id, status, finished_at, resources_total, resources_failed,
          sync_run.records_seen, sync_run.records_new, sync_run.records_changed, sync_run.records_deleted, sync_run.api_calls_total;

-- Prueft, ob die Summe der Mengen die Teilnehmerzahl ist.
-- Grundlage fuer die Auslastung. Nur lesend.
WITH pos AS (
    SELECT
        p.booking_id,
        coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.pricecategory_name), ''), '(ohne namen)') AS kat,
        coalesce(p.quantity, 0)   AS menge,
        coalesce(p.amount_net, 0) AS betrag
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
),
je_buchung AS (
    SELECT
        b.booking_id, b.offer_id, s.status,
        extract(year FROM s.booking_time)::int AS jahr,
        coalesce(s.netto, 0) AS netto,
        count(*)                                                    AS zeilen,
        sum(pos.menge)                                              AS plaetze,
        sum(pos.menge) FILTER (WHERE pos.kat = 'Inklusive')          AS inklusive,
        sum(pos.menge) FILTER (WHERE pos.kat ~ 'weitere[ns]? Person') AS weitere,
        max((substring(pos.kat from '([0-9]+) Person'))::int)
            FILTER (WHERE pos.kat !~ 'weitere[ns]? Person')          AS basis_n
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
    JOIN kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s ON s.booking_id = b.booking_id
    JOIN pos ON pos.booking_id = b.booking_id
    GROUP BY b.booking_id, b.offer_id, s.status, 4, 5
),
je_termin AS (
    SELECT
        o.offer_id, o.name, o.date_start, o.user_maximum,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.status = 'gebucht')                       AS buchungen,
        coalesce(sum(j.plaetze) FILTER (WHERE j.status = 'gebucht'), 0)    AS plaetze,
        round(coalesce(sum(j.netto) FILTER (WHERE j.status = 'gebucht'), 0), 2) AS netto
    FROM edoobox_raw.offer o
    JOIN je_buchung j ON j.offer_id = o.offer_id
    WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
    GROUP BY o.offer_id, o.name, o.date_start, o.user_maximum
),
roh AS (
    -- A. Plaetze je Buchung
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Plaetze je Buchung' AS bereich,
           concat(coalesce(plaetze::text, 'leer'), ' plaetze') AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert,
           concat('zeilen im schnitt ', round(avg(zeilen), 2),
                  ' / netto ', round(sum(netto), 2)) AS hinweis
    FROM je_buchung WHERE status = 'gebucht'
    GROUP BY 3

    -- B. Paketmodell: Basiszahl gegen eins plus inklusive
    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Paketmodell',
           CASE
               WHEN basis_n IS NULL THEN 'keine basiszahl im namen'
               WHEN coalesce(inklusive, 0) = 0 THEN 'basiszahl ohne inklusive'
               WHEN basis_n = 1 + inklusive THEN 'basiszahl gleich eins plus inklusive'
               ELSE concat('abweichung basis ', basis_n, ' gegen ', 1 + inklusive)
           END,
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('plaetze im schnitt ', round(avg(plaetze), 2),
                  ' / weitere im schnitt ', round(avg(coalesce(weitere, 0)), 2))
    FROM je_buchung WHERE status = 'gebucht'
    GROUP BY 3

    -- C. Auslastung in Klassen, nur Termine ab 2023
    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Auslastung ab 2023',
           CASE
               WHEN user_maximum IS NULL OR user_maximum = 0 THEN 'ohne hoechstzahl'
               WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum > 1 THEN 'ueber 100 prozent'
               WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum >= 0.75 THEN '75 bis 100 prozent'
               WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum >= 0.5 THEN '50 bis 75 prozent'
               WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum >= 0.25 THEN '25 bis 50 prozent'
               ELSE 'unter 25 prozent'
           END,
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('plaetze ', sum(plaetze), ' / netto ', round(sum(netto), 2))
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE date_start >= '2023-01-01' AND buchungen > 0
    GROUP BY 3

    -- D. Die Termine ueber 100 Prozent einzeln
    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Ueberbuchung',
           concat(coalesce(to_char(date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'ohne datum'), ' ',
                  left(coalesce(name, 'ohne name'), 42)),
           plaetze::numeric,
           concat('hoechstzahl ', user_maximum,
                  ' / buchungen ', buchungen,
                  ' / netto ', netto)
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE user_maximum > 0 AND plaetze > user_maximum AND buchungen > 0

    -- E. Zeilen je Buchung gegen Plaetze
    UNION ALL SELECT 50, 'E Zeilen gegen Plaetze',
           concat(zeilen, ' zeilen'), count(*)::numeric,
           concat('plaetze ', sum(plaetze),
                  ' / mit inklusive ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(inklusive, 0) > 0),
                  ' / mit weiterer person ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(weitere, 0) > 0))
    FROM je_buchung WHERE status = 'gebucht'
    GROUP BY 3
)
SELECT
    'S34' AS schritt,
    count(*) AS zeilen,
    string_agg(
        concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')),
                  coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
        chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl
    ) AS bericht
FROM roh;

-- Finale Platzregel: Buchungsanzahl, bezahlte Koepfe und groesste kostenlose Gruppe. Nur lesend.
WITH pos AS (
    SELECT p.booking_id,
           coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.pricecategory_name), ''), '(ohne namen)') AS kat,
           coalesce(p.quantity, 0) AS menge,
           CASE WHEN p.pricecategory_name ~* '(bis zu|max\\.?|f\\.|fuer|für)[^0-9]{0,12}[0-9]+[[:space:]]*person'
                THEN (substring(p.pricecategory_name from '(?i)(?:bis zu|max\\.?|f\\.|fuer|für)[^0-9]{0,12}([0-9]+)[[:space:]]*person'))::int END AS basis_n,
           CASE WHEN p.pricecategory_name ~* '[0-9]+[[:space:]]*(personen|person|teiln|teilnehmer)'
                THEN (substring(p.pricecategory_name from '(?i)([0-9]+)[[:space:]]*(?:personen|person|teiln|teilnehmer)'))::int END AS text_n,
           (p.pricecategory_name ~* '(jede|je|pro)[[:space:]]+weitere|preis[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*für[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*jede[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*weitere') AS ist_zusatz
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
),
je_buchung AS (
    SELECT b.booking_id, b.offer_id, s.status, coalesce(s.netto, 0) AS netto,
           max(pos.basis_n) AS basis_n, max(pos.text_n) AS text_n,
           coalesce(sum(pos.menge) FILTER (WHERE pos.ist_zusatz), 0) AS zusatz_n,
           coalesce(sum(pos.menge) FILTER (WHERE pos.kat = 'Inklusive'), 0) AS inklusive_n,
           bool_or(pos.kat = 'Inklusive') AS hat_inklusive
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
    JOIN kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s ON s.booking_id = b.booking_id
    LEFT JOIN pos ON pos.booking_id = b.booking_id
    GROUP BY b.booking_id, b.offer_id, s.status, 4
),
kopf AS (
    SELECT j.*,
           CASE WHEN basis_n IS NOT NULL THEN basis_n + zusatz_n
                WHEN text_n IS NOT NULL THEN text_n
                WHEN hat_inklusive THEN 1 + inklusive_n + zusatz_n
                ELSE 1 END AS abgeleitet
    FROM je_buchung j
),
je_termin AS (
    SELECT o.offer_id, o.name, o.date_start, o.user_maximum,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht') AS buchungen,
           coalesce(sum(k.abgeleitet) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht' AND k.netto <> 0), 0) AS bezahlt,
           coalesce(max(k.abgeleitet) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht' AND k.netto = 0), 0) AS groesste_gratisgruppe,
           greatest(
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht'),
               coalesce(sum(k.abgeleitet) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht' AND k.netto <> 0), 0),
               coalesce(max(k.abgeleitet) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht' AND k.netto = 0), 0)
           ) AS plaetze,
           round(coalesce(sum(k.netto) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht'), 0), 2) AS netto
    FROM edoobox_raw.offer o
    JOIN kopf k ON k.offer_id = o.offer_id
    WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
    GROUP BY o.offer_id, o.name, o.date_start, o.user_maximum
),
roh AS (
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Regelentscheidung' AS bereich,
           CASE WHEN plaetze = buchungen THEN 'buchungsanzahl'
                WHEN plaetze = bezahlt THEN 'bezahlte koepfe'
                ELSE 'groesste gratisgruppe' END AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert,
           concat('buchungen ', sum(buchungen), ' / bezahlt ', sum(bezahlt),
                  ' / gratismaximum ', sum(groesste_gratisgruppe), ' / plaetze ', sum(plaetze)) AS hinweis
    FROM je_termin WHERE buchungen > 0
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Ueberbuchung final',
           concat(to_char(date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ' ', left(name, 40)),
           plaetze::numeric,
           concat('hoechstzahl ', user_maximum, ' / buchungen ', buchungen,
                  ' / bezahlt ', bezahlt, ' / gratismaximum ', groesste_gratisgruppe,
                  ' / netto ', netto)
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE user_maximum > 0 AND plaetze > user_maximum

    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Auslastung ab 2023',
           CASE WHEN user_maximum IS NULL OR user_maximum = 0 THEN 'ohne hoechstzahl'
                WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum > 1 THEN 'ueber 100 prozent'
                WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum >= 0.75 THEN '75 bis 100 prozent'
                WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum >= 0.5 THEN '50 bis 75 prozent'
                WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum >= 0.25 THEN '25 bis 50 prozent'
                ELSE 'unter 25 prozent' END,
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('plaetze ', sum(plaetze), ' / netto ', round(sum(netto), 2))
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE date_start >= '2023-01-01' AND buchungen > 0
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Jahresmittel final',
           concat('jahr ', extract(year FROM date_start)::int),
           round(avg(plaetze::numeric / user_maximum) * 100, 1),
           concat('termine ', count(*), ' / plaetze ', sum(plaetze),
                  ' / hoechstzahl ', sum(user_maximum), ' / netto ', round(sum(netto), 2))
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE user_maximum > 0 AND buchungen > 0
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 50, 'E Kontrolltermin',
           concat(to_char(date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ' ', left(name, 40)),
           plaetze::numeric,
           concat('hoechstzahl ', user_maximum, ' / buchungen ', buchungen,
                  ' / bezahlt ', bezahlt, ' / gratismaximum ', groesste_gratisgruppe,
                  ' / netto ', netto)
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE date_start IN ('2022-11-21', '2022-11-22', '2022-11-28', '2022-12-01',
                         '2023-05-05', '2023-07-19', '2024-02-02', '2024-11-05', '2026-05-21')
)
SELECT 'S41' AS schritt, count(*) AS zeilen,
       string_agg(concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')), coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
                  chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl) AS bericht
FROM roh;

-- Sucht die Rechnungen der Nulltermine ueber das Terminstartdatum statt ueber
-- die Vorgangskennung. Vergleicht ausserdem Buchungs- und Rechnungsseite je Jahr.
-- Nur lesend.
WITH je_termin AS (
    SELECT s.offer_id,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'gebucht') AS gebucht,
           round(coalesce(sum(s.netto) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'gebucht'), 0), 2) AS netto
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s
    WHERE s.offer_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY s.offer_id
),
nulltermin AS (
    SELECT o.offer_id, o.name, o.offer_number, o.date_start, o.offerdef_ref, t.gebucht
    FROM edoobox_raw.offer o
    JOIN je_termin t ON t.offer_id = o.offer_id
    WHERE t.gebucht > 0 AND t.netto = 0 AND o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
),
treffer AS (
    SELECT nt.offer_id, nt.gebucht,
           count(DISTINCT i.invoice_id)                        AS rechnungen,
           round(coalesce(sum(i.amount), 0), 2)                AS summe
    FROM nulltermin nt
    LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.invoice i
           ON i.offer_start_date IS NOT NULL
          AND nt.date_start IS NOT NULL
          AND date_trunc('day', i.offer_start_date) = date_trunc('day', nt.date_start)
          AND i.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
    GROUP BY nt.offer_id, nt.gebucht
),
roh AS (
    -- A. Rechnungen fuer Nulltermine ueber das Startdatum gefunden
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Nulltermin Rechnungssuche' AS bereich,
           CASE WHEN rechnungen = 0 THEN 'keine rechnung am termindatum'
                WHEN rechnungen = 1 THEN 'eine rechnung am termindatum'
                ELSE 'mehrere rechnungen am termindatum' END AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert,
           concat('buchungen ', sum(gebucht), ' / rechnungssumme ', round(sum(summe), 2)) AS hinweis
    FROM treffer
    GROUP BY 3

    -- B. Buchungsseite gegen Rechnungsseite je Jahr
    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Jahr Buchung', extract(year FROM s.booking_time)::int::text,
           round(coalesce(sum(s.netto) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'gebucht'), 0), 2),
           concat('gebuchte buchungen ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'gebucht'),
                  ' / brutto ', round(coalesce(sum(s.brutto) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'gebucht'), 0), 2))
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 21, 'C Jahr Rechnung', extract(year FROM i.date_create)::int::text,
           round(coalesce(sum(i.amount), 0), 2),
           concat('rechnungen ', count(*),
                  ' / mit zahlung ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.date_pay IS NOT NULL),
                  ' / zahlsumme ', round(coalesce(sum(i.amount_pay), 0), 2))
    FROM edoobox_raw.invoice i
    WHERE i.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
    GROUP BY 3

    -- D. Rechnungen ohne Verbindung zu einer Buchung
    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'D Rechnung ohne Buchung',
           concat('jahr ', coalesce(extract(year FROM i.date_create)::int::text, 'ohne')),
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('summe ', round(coalesce(sum(i.amount), 0), 2),
                  ' / mit startdatum ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.offer_start_date IS NOT NULL))
    FROM edoobox_raw.invoice i
    WHERE i.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kursplan.v_buchung_rechnung vr
                       WHERE vr.invoice_id = i.invoice_id)
    GROUP BY 3

    -- E. Deckung des Feldes offer_start_date
    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'E Feld offer_start_date',
           concat('jahr ', coalesce(extract(year FROM i.date_create)::int::text, 'ohne')),
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('mit startdatum ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.offer_start_date IS NOT NULL),
                  ' / anteil ', round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.offer_start_date IS NOT NULL)
                                      / count(*), 1), ' prozent')
    FROM edoobox_raw.invoice i
    WHERE i.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
    GROUP BY 3

    -- F. Nullbuchungen, deren Teilnehmerkennung irgendeine Rechnung hat
    UNION ALL SELECT 50, 'F Nullbuchung Teilnehmerkennung',
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edoobox_raw.invoice i
                              WHERE i.user_ref = b.user_ref AND i.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE)
                THEN 'kennung hat rechnung' ELSE 'kennung ohne rechnung' END,
           count(*)::numeric, NULL
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s
    JOIN edoobox_raw.booking b ON b.booking_id = s.booking_id
    WHERE s.status = 'gebucht' AND coalesce(s.netto, 0) = 0
    GROUP BY 3
)
SELECT
    'S33' AS schritt,
    count(*) AS zeilen,
    string_agg(
        concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')),
                  coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
        chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, kennzahl, wert DESC
    ) AS bericht
FROM roh;

-- Wie vollstaendig ist die Datengrundlage inzwischen?
SELECT 'Buchungen gesamt' AS kennzahl,
       count(*)::text AS wert
  FROM edoobox_raw.booking WHERE is_deleted = false
UNION ALL
SELECT 'davon mit Detailstand',
       count(*)::text FROM edoobox_raw.booking
 WHERE is_deleted = false AND detail_synced_at IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'davon ohne passendes Angebot',
       count(*)::text FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
 WHERE b.is_deleted = false
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edoobox_raw.offer o WHERE o.offer_id = b.offer_id)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Zeitraum dieser Buchungen',
       coalesce(to_char(min(b.booking_time), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' bis ' ||
                to_char(max(b.booking_time), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'keine')
  FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
 WHERE b.is_deleted = false
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edoobox_raw.offer o WHERE o.offer_id = b.offer_id)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Angebote gesamt', count(*)::text FROM edoobox_raw.offer WHERE is_deleted = false

SELECT 'davon mit Buchung',
       count(DISTINCT o.offer_id)::text

UNION ALL
SELECT 'Zahlungsvorgaenge', count(*)::text FROM edoobox_raw.booking_transaction

SELECT 'Nettoerloes aller Positionen',
       to_char(coalesce(sum(amount_net * quantity), 0), 'FM999G999G990D00')
  FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position;

-- Erste Auswertung: die 25 umsatzstaerksten Kurstermine.
-- Stornierte Buchungen bleiben aussen vor.
SELECT
    o.offer_number                                   AS kursnummer,
    o.name                                           AS kurs,
    to_char(o.date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')      AS beginn,
    o.user_minimal                                   AS min_tn,
    o.user_maximum                                   AS max_tn,
    count(DISTINCT b.booking_id)                     AS buchungen,
    coalesce(sum(p.quantity), 0)                     AS teilnehmer,
    CASE WHEN o.user_maximum > 0
         THEN round(100.0 * coalesce(sum(p.quantity), 0) / o.user_maximum, 1)
    END                                              AS auslastung_prozent,
    round(coalesce(sum(p.amount_net * p.quantity), 0), 2) AS erloes_netto
FROM edoobox_raw.offer o
JOIN edoobox_raw.booking b
     ON b.offer_id = o.offer_id
    AND b.is_deleted = false
    AND b.status = 'gebucht'
LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.booking_position p
     ON p.booking_id = b.booking_id
WHERE o.is_deleted = false
  AND o.is_trash   = false
GROUP BY o.offer_id, o.offer_number, o.name, o.date_start, o.user_minimal, o.user_maximum
ORDER BY erloes_netto DESC
LIMIT 25;

-- Prueft die endgueltige Kopfregel und die Termindubletten. Nur lesend.
WITH pos AS (
    SELECT
        p.booking_id,
        coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.pricecategory_name), ''), '(ohne namen)') AS kat,
        coalesce(p.quantity, 0) AS menge,
        coalesce(p.amount_net, 0) AS betrag,
        CASE
            WHEN p.pricecategory_name ~* '(bis zu|max\\.?|fuer|für)[^0-9]{0,12}[0-9]+[[:space:]]*person'
            THEN (substring(p.pricecategory_name from '(?i)(?:bis zu|max\\.?|fuer|für)[^0-9]{0,12}([0-9]+)[[:space:]]*person'))::int
        END AS basis_n,
        (p.pricecategory_name ~* '(jede|je|pro)[[:space:]]+weitere|preis[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*für[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*jede[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*weitere') AS ist_zusatz
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
),
je_buchung AS (
    SELECT
        b.booking_id,
        b.offer_id,
        s.status,
        coalesce(s.netto, 0) AS netto,
        max(pos.basis_n) AS basis_n,
        coalesce(sum(pos.menge) FILTER (WHERE pos.ist_zusatz), 0) AS zusatz_n,
        bool_or(pos.kat = 'Inklusive') AS hat_inklusive,
        coalesce(sum(pos.menge) FILTER (WHERE pos.kat = 'Inklusive'), 0) AS inklusive_n,
        sum(pos.menge) AS menge_alt,
        string_agg(concat(left(pos.kat, 35), ' x', pos.menge), ' + ' ORDER BY pos.betrag DESC, pos.kat) AS zeilen_text
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
    JOIN kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s ON s.booking_id = b.booking_id
    JOIN pos ON pos.booking_id = b.booking_id
    GROUP BY b.booking_id, b.offer_id, s.status, 4
),
mit_plaetzen AS (
    SELECT j.*,
           CASE
               WHEN basis_n IS NOT NULL THEN basis_n + zusatz_n
               WHEN hat_inklusive THEN NULL
               ELSE 1
           END AS plaetze,
           CASE
               WHEN basis_n IS NOT NULL THEN 'paket sicher'
               WHEN hat_inklusive THEN 'paket basis unklar'
               ELSE 'einzelbuchung'
           END AS regel
    FROM je_buchung j
),
je_termin AS (
    SELECT
        o.offer_id, o.offer_number, o.name, o.date_start, o.user_maximum,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'gebucht') AS buchungen,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'gebucht' AND m.plaetze IS NULL) AS unklare_buchungen,
        coalesce(sum(m.plaetze) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'gebucht'), 0) AS plaetze_sicher,
        round(coalesce(sum(m.netto) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'gebucht'), 0), 2) AS netto
    FROM edoobox_raw.offer o
    JOIN mit_plaetzen m ON m.offer_id = o.offer_id
    WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
    GROUP BY o.offer_id, o.offer_number, o.name, o.date_start, o.user_maximum
),
dublettenschluessel AS (
    SELECT name, date_start
    FROM edoobox_raw.offer
    WHERE is_deleted IS NOT TRUE AND date_start IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY name, date_start
    HAVING count(*) > 1
),
roh AS (
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Regelabdeckung' AS bereich,
           regel AS kennzahl, count(*)::numeric AS wert,
           concat('netto ', round(sum(netto), 2),
                  ' / inklusive-menge ', sum(inklusive_n),
                  ' / alte mengensumme ', sum(menge_alt)) AS hinweis
    FROM mit_plaetzen
    WHERE status = 'gebucht'
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Sichere Paketgroesse',
           concat(plaetze, ' plaetze'), count(*)::numeric,
           concat('basis im schnitt ', round(avg(basis_n), 2),
                  ' / zusatz im schnitt ', round(avg(zusatz_n), 2),
                  ' / netto ', round(sum(netto), 2))
    FROM mit_plaetzen
    WHERE status = 'gebucht' AND regel = 'paket sicher'
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Ueberbuchung sicher',
           concat(to_char(t.date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ' ', left(t.name, 36)),
           t.plaetze_sicher::numeric,
           concat('hoechstzahl ', t.user_maximum,
                  ' / buchungen ', t.buchungen,
                  ' / unklar ', t.unklare_buchungen,
                  ' / netto ', t.netto)
    FROM je_termin t
    WHERE t.user_maximum > 0
      AND t.unklare_buchungen = 0
      AND t.plaetze_sicher > t.user_maximum

    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Unklare Paketbuchung',
           concat('b', right(booking_id::text, 5)),
           inklusive_n::numeric,
           left(zeilen_text, 170)
    FROM mit_plaetzen
    WHERE status = 'gebucht' AND regel = 'paket basis unklar'

    UNION ALL SELECT 50, 'E Dublettenbelegung',
           concat(to_char(t.date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ' ', left(t.name, 30)),
           t.buchungen::numeric,
           concat('nummer ', left(coalesce(t.offer_number, '-'), 35),
                  ' / plaetze sicher ', t.plaetze_sicher,
                  ' / unklar ', t.unklare_buchungen,
                  ' / netto ', t.netto)
    FROM je_termin t
    JOIN dublettenschluessel d ON d.name = t.name AND d.date_start = t.date_start

    UNION ALL SELECT 60, 'F offerdef_ref',
           'verschiedene werte', count(DISTINCT offerdef_ref)::numeric,
           concat('nicht leer ', count(offerdef_ref),
                  ' / termine ', count(*),
                  ' / groesste gruppe ', max(gruppengroesse))
    FROM (
        SELECT offerdef_ref, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY offerdef_ref) AS gruppengroesse
        FROM edoobox_raw.offer
        WHERE is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
    ) x
)
SELECT
    'S37' AS schritt,
    count(*) AS zeilen,
    string_agg(
        concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')), coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
        chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl
    ) AS bericht
FROM roh;

-- Korrigierte Platzregel: Mengensumme nur bei Paketstruktur, sonst ein Kopf.
-- Nur lesend.
WITH pos AS (
    SELECT
        p.booking_id,
        coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.pricecategory_name), ''), '(ohne namen)') AS kat,
        coalesce(p.quantity, 0) AS menge
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
),
je_buchung AS (
    SELECT
        b.booking_id, b.offer_id, s.status,
        coalesce(s.netto, 0) AS netto,
        count(*) AS zeilen,
        sum(pos.menge) AS menge_summe,
        bool_or(pos.kat = 'Inklusive' OR pos.kat ~ 'weitere[ns]? Person') AS ist_paket
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
    JOIN kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s ON s.booking_id = b.booking_id
    JOIN pos ON pos.booking_id = b.booking_id
    GROUP BY b.booking_id, b.offer_id, s.status, 4
),
mit_plaetzen AS (
    SELECT j.*,
           CASE WHEN j.ist_paket THEN greatest(j.menge_summe, 1) ELSE 1 END AS plaetze
    FROM je_buchung j
),
je_termin AS (
    SELECT
        o.offer_id, o.name, o.date_start, o.user_maximum,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'gebucht')                    AS buchungen,
        coalesce(sum(m.plaetze) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'gebucht'), 0) AS plaetze,
        coalesce(sum(m.menge_summe) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'gebucht'), 0) AS menge_alt,
        round(coalesce(sum(m.netto) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'gebucht'), 0), 2) AS netto
    FROM edoobox_raw.offer o
    JOIN mit_plaetzen m ON m.offer_id = o.offer_id
    WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
    GROUP BY o.offer_id, o.name, o.date_start, o.user_maximum
),
doppelt AS (
    SELECT o.name, o.date_start, count(*) AS saetze,
           string_agg(o.offer_number, ' ' ORDER BY o.offer_number) AS nummern
    FROM edoobox_raw.offer o
    WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE AND o.date_start IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY o.name, o.date_start
    HAVING count(*) > 1
),
roh AS (
    -- A. Plaetze je Buchung nach neuer Regel
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Plaetze neu' AS bereich,
           concat(plaetze, ' plaetze') AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert,
           concat('paket ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE ist_paket),
                  ' / netto ', round(sum(netto), 2)) AS hinweis
    FROM mit_plaetzen WHERE status = 'gebucht'
    GROUP BY 3

    -- B. Wo alte und neue Regel auseinandergehen
    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Regelunterschied',
           CASE
               WHEN ist_paket THEN 'paket, mengensumme gilt'
               WHEN menge_summe = 1 THEN 'einzel, menge war schon eins'
               ELSE concat('einzel, menge ', menge_summe, ' auf eins gesetzt')
           END,
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('zeilen im schnitt ', round(avg(zeilen), 2),
                  ' / netto ', round(sum(netto), 2))
    FROM mit_plaetzen WHERE status = 'gebucht'
    GROUP BY 3

    -- C. Auslastung ab 2023 mit neuer Regel
    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Auslastung ab 2023',
           CASE
               WHEN user_maximum IS NULL OR user_maximum = 0 THEN 'ohne hoechstzahl'
               WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum > 1 THEN 'ueber 100 prozent'
               WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum >= 0.75 THEN '75 bis 100 prozent'
               WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum >= 0.5 THEN '50 bis 75 prozent'
               WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum >= 0.25 THEN '25 bis 50 prozent'
               ELSE 'unter 25 prozent'
           END,
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('plaetze ', sum(plaetze), ' / netto ', round(sum(netto), 2))
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE date_start >= '2023-01-01' AND buchungen > 0
    GROUP BY 3

    -- D. Verbleibende Ueberbuchungen einzeln
    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Ueberbuchung neu',
           concat(to_char(date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ' ',
                  left(coalesce(name, 'ohne name'), 40)),
           plaetze::numeric,
           concat('hoechstzahl ', user_maximum,
                  ' / buchungen ', buchungen,
                  ' / mengensumme alt ', menge_alt,
                  ' / netto ', netto)
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE user_maximum > 0 AND plaetze > user_maximum AND buchungen > 0

    -- E. Auslastung ab 2023 im Mittel je Jahr
    UNION ALL SELECT 50, 'E Auslastung Mittelwert',
           concat('jahr ', extract(year FROM date_start)::int),
           round(avg(plaetze::numeric / user_maximum) * 100, 1),
           concat('termine ', count(*),
                  ' / plaetze ', sum(plaetze),
                  ' / hoechstzahl ', sum(user_maximum),
                  ' / netto ', round(sum(netto), 2))
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE user_maximum > 0 AND buchungen > 0
    GROUP BY 3

    -- F. Termine mit gleichem Namen und gleichem Startdatum
    UNION ALL SELECT 60, 'F Doppelte Termine',
           concat(saetze, ' saetze je name und datum'),
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('beispiel ', left(min(name), 34), ' ', min(nummern))
    FROM doppelt
    GROUP BY 3
)
SELECT
    'S35' AS schritt,
    count(*) AS zeilen,
    string_agg(
        concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')),
                  coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
        chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl
    ) AS bericht
FROM roh;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW kursplan.v_termin_db1 AS
WITH basis AS (
    SELECT t.*,
           r.durchfuehrung AS regel_durchfuehrung,
           r.trainer_code AS regel_trainer_code,
           r.tarif AS regel_tarif,
           r.trainerkosten_override AS regel_trainerkosten_override,
           r.plattform_override AS regel_plattform_override,
           r.vor_nachbereitung_override AS regel_vor_nachbereitung_override,
           a.kosten_aktiv AS ausnahme_kosten_aktiv,
           a.durchfuehrung AS ausnahme_durchfuehrung,
           a.trainer_code AS ausnahme_trainer_code,
           a.tarif AS ausnahme_tarif,
           a.trainerkosten_override AS ausnahme_trainerkosten_override,
           a.plattform_override AS ausnahme_plattform_override,
           a.vor_nachbereitung_override AS ausnahme_vor_nachbereitung_override,
           v.eigenunterricht,
           v.plattform_je_termin,
           v.vor_nachbereitung
    FROM kursplan.v_kursart_termin t
    CROSS JOIN kursplan.kosten_vorgabe v
    LEFT JOIN kursplan.kursart_kostenregel r
      ON r.kurscode = t.kurscode AND r.ist_aktiv
    LEFT JOIN kursplan.termin_kosten_ausnahme a ON a.offer_id = t.offer_id
    WHERE v.vorgabe_id = 'standard'
), aufgeloest AS (
    SELECT b.*,
           coalesce(ausnahme_kosten_aktiv,
                    CASE WHEN termin_status::text = '5' THEN false
                         WHEN termin_status::text IN ('2', '4') THEN true
                         WHEN termin_status::text IN ('0', '1', '3') AND buchungen_gebucht > 0 THEN true
                         ELSE false END) AS kosten_aktiv,
           CASE WHEN date_start::date > current_date THEN 'prognose'
                ELSE 'ist' END::text AS kostenphase,
           coalesce(ausnahme_durchfuehrung, regel_durchfuehrung, 'eigen') AS durchfuehrung,
           coalesce(ausnahme_trainer_code, regel_trainer_code) AS trainer_code,
           coalesce(ausnahme_tarif, regel_tarif) AS tarif,
           coalesce(ausnahme_trainerkosten_override, regel_trainerkosten_override) AS trainerkosten_override,
           coalesce(ausnahme_plattform_override, regel_plattform_override, plattform_je_termin) AS plattform_pauschale,
           coalesce(ausnahme_vor_nachbereitung_override, regel_vor_nachbereitung_override, vor_nachbereitung) AS vor_nachbereitung_pauschale,
           CASE WHEN ausnahme_kosten_aktiv IS NOT NULL THEN 'terminausnahme'
                WHEN termin_status::text = '5' THEN 'abgesagt'
                WHEN termin_status::text IN ('2', '4') THEN 'status'
                WHEN buchungen_gebucht > 0 THEN 'buchung'
                ELSE 'nicht aktiv' END::text AS kostenaktivierung
    FROM basis b
), berechnet AS (
    SELECT a.*,
           CASE WHEN NOT kosten_aktiv OR durchfuehrung = 'keine' THEN 0::numeric
                WHEN durchfuehrung = 'eigen' THEN eigenunterricht
                WHEN durchfuehrung = 'fremd' THEN
                     coalesce(trainerkosten_override,
                              CASE tarif WHEN 'tarif_1' THEN p.tarif_1
                                         WHEN 'tarif_2' THEN p.tarif_2 END)
           END AS trainerkosten,
           CASE WHEN kosten_aktiv THEN plattform_pauschale ELSE 0::numeric END AS plattformkosten,
           CASE WHEN kosten_aktiv THEN vor_nachbereitung_pauschale ELSE 0::numeric END AS vor_nachbereitungskosten
    FROM aufgeloest a
    LEFT JOIN kursplan.trainer_kostenprofil p
      ON p.trainer_code = a.trainer_code AND p.ist_aktiv
)
SELECT b.*,
       CASE WHEN kosten_aktiv
                 AND durchfuehrung = 'fremd'
                 AND trainerkosten IS NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS kostenkonfiguration_fehlt,
       CASE WHEN trainerkosten IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE round(trainerkosten + plattformkosten + vor_nachbereitungskosten, 2) END AS direkte_kosten,
       CASE WHEN netto_gebucht IS NULL OR trainerkosten IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE round(netto_gebucht - trainerkosten - plattformkosten - vor_nachbereitungskosten, 2) END AS db1
FROM berechnet b;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW kursplan.v_kursart_db1 AS
SELECT kurscode,
       min(kursbezeichnung) AS kursbezeichnung,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01') AS termine,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01' AND kosten_aktiv) AS termine_mit_kosten,
       round(sum(netto_gebucht) FILTER (WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01'), 2) AS netto,
       round(sum(direkte_kosten) FILTER (WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01'), 2) AS direkte_kosten,
       round(sum(db1) FILTER (WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01'), 2) AS db1,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01' AND kostenkonfiguration_fehlt) AS konfiguration_fehlt
FROM kursplan.v_termin_db1
GROUP BY kurscode;

COMMENT ON VIEW kursplan.v_termin_db1 IS
'DB-I-Berechnung je produktivem Termin mit Status-/Buchungsaktivierung, Prognosekennzeichen und ueberschreibbaren direkten Kosten.';

WITH stapel AS (
    SELECT booking_id
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoIds${{ $json.alleKennungenJson }}$edoIds$::jsonb)
         AS s(booking_id text)
),
eingang AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoJson${{ $json.datenJson }}$edoJson$::jsonb)
         AS t(
            booking_id     text,
            offer_id       text,
            promotion_id   text,
            is_b2b         boolean,
            is_multi_offer boolean,
            teilnehmer_aktiv integer,
            teilnehmer_gesamt integer,
            positionen     jsonb,
            vorgaenge      jsonb
         )
),
kopf AS (
    UPDATE edoobox_raw.booking b
    SET is_b2b         = e.is_b2b,
        is_multi_offer = e.is_multi_offer,
        offer_id       = coalesce(e.offer_id, b.offer_id),
        last_synced_at = now()
    FROM eingang e
    WHERE b.booking_id = e.booking_id
    RETURNING b.booking_id
),
positionen AS (
    SELECT e.booking_id, p.*
    FROM eingang e
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(e.positionen)
         AS p(
            pricecategory_id   text,
            pricecategory_name text,
            amount_net         numeric(12,2),
            currency           char(3),
            quantity           integer,
            is_default         boolean
         )
),
positionen_geschrieben AS (
    INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.booking_position AS bp (
        booking_id, pricecategory_id, pricecategory_name,
        amount_net, currency, quantity, is_default, last_synced_at
    )
    SELECT booking_id, pricecategory_id, pricecategory_name,
           amount_net, currency, quantity, is_default, now()
    FROM positionen
    ON CONFLICT (booking_id, pricecategory_id) DO UPDATE
    SET pricecategory_name = EXCLUDED.pricecategory_name,
        amount_net         = EXCLUDED.amount_net,
        currency           = EXCLUDED.currency,
        quantity           = EXCLUDED.quantity,
        is_default         = EXCLUDED.is_default,
        last_synced_at     = now()
    RETURNING bp.position_id
),
vorgaenge AS (
    SELECT e.booking_id, v.*
    FROM eingang e
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(e.vorgaenge)
         AS v(
            transaction_id     text,
            transaction_number text,
            amount             numeric(12,2),
            currency           char(3)
         )
),
vorgaenge_geschrieben AS (
    INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.booking_transaction AS bt (
        transaction_id, booking_id, transaction_number,
        amount, currency, last_synced_at
    )
    SELECT transaction_id, booking_id, transaction_number,
           amount, currency, now()
    FROM vorgaenge
    ON CONFLICT (transaction_id) DO UPDATE
    SET booking_id         = EXCLUDED.booking_id,
        transaction_number = EXCLUDED.transaction_number,
        amount             = EXCLUDED.amount,
        currency           = EXCLUDED.currency,
        last_synced_at     = now()
    RETURNING bt.transaction_id
),
-- Der Merker wird fuer den gesamten Stapel gesetzt, auch fuer Buchungen
-- ohne Preiskategorie. Sonst liefe die Schleife endlos.
abgehakt AS (
    UPDATE edoobox_raw.booking b
    SET detail_synced_at = now()
    FROM stapel s
    WHERE b.booking_id = s.booking_id
    RETURNING b.booking_id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM abgehakt)               AS stapel_abgehakt,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM kopf)                   AS kopfsaetze,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM positionen_geschrieben) AS positionen,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM vorgaenge_geschrieben)  AS vorgaenge,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.booking
      WHERE is_deleted = false AND detail_synced_at IS NULL) AS noch_offen;

WITH vorherige_laeufe AS (

    SET status      = 'abgebrochen',
        finished_at = now(),
        error_text  = 'Durch neuen Angebotsabgleich ersetzt'
    WHERE run_type = 'vollabgleich'
      AND status   = 'laeuft'
)
INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.sync_run (run_type, status)
VALUES ('vollabgleich', 'laeuft')
RETURNING run_id, started_at;

WITH eingang AS (
    SELECT
        t.*,
        md5(
            concat_ws('|',
                t.name, t.offer_number, t.category_ref, t.place_ref,
                t.date_start::text, t.date_end::text,
                t.user_minimal::text, t.user_maximum::text,
                t.status, t.mode, t.offer_type, t.vat_rate::text,
                t.is_archived::text, t.is_trash::text)
        ) AS payload_hash
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoJson${{ $json.datenJson }}$edoJson$::jsonb)
         AS t(
            offer_id             text,
            offer_number         text,
            name                 text,
            category_ref         text,
            offerdef_ref         text,
            place_ref            text,
            date_start           timestamptz,
            date_end             timestamptz,
            date_signupstart     timestamptz,
            date_close           timestamptz,
            user_minimal         integer,
            user_maximum         integer,
            status               text,
            mode                 text,
            offer_type           text,
            vat_rate             numeric(6,3),
            country              text,
            internal_code        text,
            is_archived          boolean,
            is_trash             boolean,
            has_waiting_list     boolean,
            mustpay              boolean,
            is_multi_offer       boolean,
            is_multi_offer_child boolean,
            payload              jsonb
         )
),
kennzahlen AS (
    SELECT
        count(*) AS zeilen,
        count(*) FILTER (
            WHERE o.offer_id IS NULL
               OR o.payload_hash IS DISTINCT FROM e.payload_hash
        ) AS geaendert
    FROM eingang e
    LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.offer o ON o.offer_id = e.offer_id
),
geschrieben AS (
    INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.offer AS o (
        offer_id, offer_number, name, category_ref, offerdef_ref, place_ref,
        date_start, date_end, date_signupstart, date_close,
        user_minimal, user_maximum, status, mode, offer_type,
        vat_rate, country, internal_code,
        is_archived, is_trash, has_waiting_list, mustpay,
        is_multi_offer, is_multi_offer_child,
        payload, last_synced_at, last_changed_at, payload_hash, is_deleted
    )
    SELECT
        e.offer_id, e.offer_number, e.name, e.category_ref, e.offerdef_ref, e.place_ref,
        e.date_start, e.date_end, e.date_signupstart, e.date_close,
        e.user_minimal, e.user_maximum, e.status, e.mode, e.offer_type,
        e.vat_rate, e.country, e.internal_code,
        coalesce(e.is_archived, false), coalesce(e.is_trash, false),
        e.has_waiting_list, e.mustpay, e.is_multi_offer, e.is_multi_offer_child,
        e.payload, now(), now(), e.payload_hash, false
    FROM eingang e
    ON CONFLICT (offer_id) DO UPDATE
    SET offer_number         = EXCLUDED.offer_number,
        name                 = EXCLUDED.name,
        category_ref         = EXCLUDED.category_ref,
        offerdef_ref         = EXCLUDED.offerdef_ref,
        place_ref            = EXCLUDED.place_ref,
        date_start           = EXCLUDED.date_start,
        date_end             = EXCLUDED.date_end,
        date_signupstart     = EXCLUDED.date_signupstart,
        date_close           = EXCLUDED.date_close,
        user_minimal         = EXCLUDED.user_minimal,
        user_maximum         = EXCLUDED.user_maximum,
        status               = EXCLUDED.status,
        mode                 = EXCLUDED.mode,
        offer_type           = EXCLUDED.offer_type,
        vat_rate             = EXCLUDED.vat_rate,
        country              = EXCLUDED.country,
        internal_code        = EXCLUDED.internal_code,
        is_archived          = EXCLUDED.is_archived,
        is_trash             = EXCLUDED.is_trash,
        has_waiting_list     = EXCLUDED.has_waiting_list,
        mustpay              = EXCLUDED.mustpay,
        is_multi_offer       = EXCLUDED.is_multi_offer,
        is_multi_offer_child = EXCLUDED.is_multi_offer_child,
        payload              = EXCLUDED.payload,
        last_synced_at       = now(),
        is_deleted           = false,
        last_changed_at      = CASE
                                   WHEN o.payload_hash IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.payload_hash
                                   THEN now() ELSE o.last_changed_at
                               END,
        payload_hash         = EXCLUDED.payload_hash
    RETURNING o.offer_id
),
fehlend AS (
    UPDATE edoobox_raw.offer
    SET is_deleted = true, last_synced_at = now()
    WHERE is_deleted = false
      AND offer_id NOT IN (SELECT offer_id FROM eingang)
    RETURNING offer_id
),
lauf AS (
    UPDATE edoobox_raw.sync_run
    SET status           = 'erfolgreich',
        finished_at      = now(),
        bookings_seen    = (SELECT zeilen    FROM kennzahlen),
        bookings_changed = (SELECT geaendert FROM kennzahlen),
        api_calls        = {{ $json.abrufe }}
    WHERE run_id = {{ $json.run_id }}
    RETURNING run_id, status
)
SELECT
    (SELECT run_id FROM lauf)                 AS run_id,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM geschrieben)        AS angebote_gespeichert,
    (SELECT geaendert FROM kennzahlen)        AS inhaltlich_geaendert,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM fehlend)            AS als_geloescht_markiert,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
      WHERE b.is_deleted = false
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edoobox_raw.offer o
                        WHERE o.offer_id = b.offer_id)) AS buchungen_ohne_angebot;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW kursplan.v_termin_erloes_produktiv AS
SELECT v.*
FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes v
LEFT JOIN kursplan.termin_ausnahme a ON a.offer_id = v.offer_id
WHERE coalesce(a.auswertung_ausschliessen, false) IS FALSE

      SELECT 1
      FROM kursplan.angebot_ausschlussregel r
      WHERE r.ist_aktiv
        AND lower(coalesce(v.offer_number, '')) ~ r.offer_number_muster
  );

COMMENT ON VIEW kursplan.v_termin_erloes_produktiv IS
'Produktive Teilmenge von v_termin_erloes ohne manuelle Terminausnahmen und dauerhaft definierte Nichtkurstermine.';

GRANT SELECT ON kursplan.angebot_ausschlussregel TO n8n_writer;
GRANT SELECT ON kursplan.v_termin_erloes_produktiv TO n8n_writer;

WITH regeltreffer AS (
    SELECT
        r.regel_id,
        r.grund,
        count(v.offer_id) AS angebote,
        round(coalesce(sum(v.netto_gebucht) FILTER (
            WHERE v.date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01'
        ), 0), 2) AS netto_ab_2023
    FROM kursplan.angebot_ausschlussregel r
    LEFT JOIN kursplan.v_termin_erloes v
      ON lower(coalesce(v.offer_number, '')) ~ r.offer_number_muster
    WHERE r.ist_aktiv
    GROUP BY r.regel_id, r.grund
),
roh AS (
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung,
           'A Regel'::text AS bereich,
           regel_id AS kennzahl,
           angebote::numeric AS wert,
           concat(grund, ' / netto ab 2023 ', netto_ab_2023) AS hinweis
    FROM regeltreffer

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 20, 'B Kontrolle', 'aktive dauerhafte Regeln',
           count(*)::numeric,
           'erwartet 3'
    FROM kursplan.angebot_ausschlussregel
    WHERE ist_aktiv

    UNION ALL

           count(*)::numeric,
           'nach manuellen und dauerhaften Ausschluessen'
    FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes_produktiv

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 40, 'D Produktive Sicht', 'Netto ab 2023',
           round(coalesce(sum(netto_gebucht), 0), 2),
           'ohne Feiertage, kontingent-10 und gebuehren'
    FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes_produktiv
    WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01'
)

    'S58a' AS schritt,
    count(*) AS zeilen,
    string_agg(
        concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl,
                  trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')), hinweis),
        chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, kennzahl
    ) AS bericht
FROM roh;

-- Sucht rein lesend nach Trainer- oder Personalangaben im gespeicherten Offer-Payload.
WITH RECURSIVE produktiv AS (
    SELECT t.offer_id, o.payload
    FROM kursplan.v_kursart_termin t
    JOIN edoobox_raw.offer o ON o.offer_id = t.offer_id
    WHERE o.payload IS NOT NULL
), schluesselwerte AS (
    SELECT p.offer_id,
           lower(kv ->> 'key') AS schluessel,
           coalesce(kv -> 'value' #>> '{}', (kv -> 'value')::text) AS wert
    FROM produktiv p
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_path_query(p.payload, '$.**.keyvalue()') kv
), kandidaten AS (
    SELECT schluessel,
           count(DISTINCT offer_id) AS termine,
           count(DISTINCT nullif(wert, '')) AS werte,
           string_agg(DISTINCT left(nullif(wert, ''), 80), ' / '
                      ORDER BY left(nullif(wert, ''), 80)) FILTER (WHERE nullif(wert, '') IS NOT NULL) AS beispiele
    FROM schluesselwerte
    WHERE schluessel ~ '(trainer|teacher|instructor|referent|speaker|lecturer|coach|resource|leader|staff|employee|presenter|host)'
    GROUP BY schluessel
), top_level AS (
    SELECT k AS schluessel, count(*) AS termine
    FROM produktiv p
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_object_keys(p.payload) k
    GROUP BY k
), top_auswahl AS (
    SELECT * FROM top_level
    ORDER BY termine DESC, schluessel
    LIMIT 30
), roh AS (
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Kandidatenfeld' AS bereich,
           schluessel AS kennzahl, termine::numeric AS wert,
           concat('verschiedene Werte ', werte, ' / Beispiele ', coalesce(beispiele, '-')) AS hinweis
    FROM kandidaten

    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Oberster Payload-Schluessel',
           schluessel, termine::numeric, 'Anzahl produktiver Termine mit diesem Feld'
    FROM top_auswahl

    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Kontrolle', 'gefundene Kandidatenfelder',
           count(*)::numeric,
           CASE WHEN count(*) = 0
                THEN 'keine Trainerangabe im gespiegelten Offer-Payload gefunden'
                ELSE 'Kandidaten oben auf Verwendbarkeit pruefen' END
    FROM kandidaten
)
SELECT 'S49' AS schritt, count(*) AS zeilen,
       string_agg(concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl,
                            trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')), coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
                  chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl) AS bericht
FROM roh;

-- Verwaltungsschritt: Kurscode-Korrekturen und Kursart-Sichten.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kursplan.kurscode_korrektur (
    korrektur_id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    reihenfolge integer NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    quellcode_muster text,
    name_muster text,
    zielcode text NOT NULL,
    bezeichnung text,
    ist_aktiv boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    bemerkung text,
    CHECK (quellcode_muster IS NOT NULL OR name_muster IS NOT NULL)
);

COMMENT ON TABLE kursplan.kurscode_korrektur IS
'Geordnete Regeln zum Zusammenfuehren oder Aufteilen automatisch abgeleiteter Kurscodes. Muster arbeiten auf normalisierten Kleinbuchstaben.';

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW kursplan.v_kursart_termin AS
WITH basis AS (
    SELECT v.*,
           nullif(regexp_replace(
               regexp_replace(lower(v.offer_number), '^[0-9]+-', ''),
               '-[0-9]{4}(-[0-9]+)?$', ''
           ), '') AS kurscode_roh,
           kursplan.normalisiere(v.name) AS name_normalisiert
    FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes_produktiv v
)
SELECT b.*,
       coalesce(k.zielcode, b.kurscode_roh, 'ohne-code') AS kurscode,
       coalesce(k.bezeichnung, b.name, 'Ohne Bezeichnung') AS kursbezeichnung,
       CASE WHEN k.korrektur_id IS NULL THEN 'automatisch' ELSE 'korrektur' END::text AS kurscode_quelle
FROM basis b
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT r.korrektur_id, r.zielcode, r.bezeichnung
    FROM kursplan.kurscode_korrektur r
    WHERE r.ist_aktiv
      AND (r.quellcode_muster IS NULL OR b.kurscode_roh ~ r.quellcode_muster)
      AND (r.name_muster IS NULL OR b.name_normalisiert ~ r.name_muster)
    ORDER BY r.reihenfolge
    LIMIT 1
) k ON true;

COMMENT ON VIEW kursplan.v_kursart_termin IS
'Produktive Termine mit automatisch abgeleitetem und regelbasiert korrigierbarem Kurscode.';

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW kursplan.v_kursart_kennzahlen AS
SELECT kurscode,
       min(kursbezeichnung) AS kursbezeichnung,
       count(*) AS termine,
       min(date_start) AS erster_termin,
       max(date_start) AS letzter_termin,
       sum(buchungen_gebucht) AS buchungen_gebucht,
       sum(plaetze_gebucht) AS plaetze_gebucht,
       sum(user_maximum) FILTER (WHERE user_maximum > 0) AS plaetze_maximal,
       round(avg(auslastung_prozent) FILTER (WHERE user_maximum > 0), 1) AS auslastung_mittel_prozent,
       round(sum(netto_gebucht), 2) AS netto_ab_2023,
       round(sum(brutto_gebucht), 2) AS brutto_ab_2023,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE kurscode_quelle = 'korrektur') AS termine_korrigiert
FROM kursplan.v_kursart_termin
GROUP BY kurscode;

COMMENT ON VIEW kursplan.v_kursart_kennzahlen IS
'Kennzahlen je korrigierbarer Kursart. Erloes gemaess v_termin_erloes erst ab 2023.';

GRANT SELECT ON kursplan.kurscode_korrektur, kursplan.v_kursart_termin, kursplan.v_kursart_kennzahlen TO n8n_writer;

WITH roh AS (
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Sicht' AS bereich, 'Termine mit Kurscode' AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert, 'erwartet 2612 produktive Termine' AS hinweis
    FROM kursplan.v_kursart_termin
    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Sicht', 'Kursarten', count(*)::numeric,
           'vor manuellen Korrekturen erwartet 229'
    FROM kursplan.v_kursart_kennzahlen
    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Quelle', kurscode_quelle, count(*)::numeric,
           concat('verschiedene Codes ', count(DISTINCT kurscode))
    FROM kursplan.v_kursart_termin GROUP BY 3
    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Kontrolle', 'Netto ab 2023',
           round(coalesce(sum(netto_ab_2023), 0), 2),
           'muss der produktiven Terminsicht entsprechen'
    FROM kursplan.v_kursart_kennzahlen
)
SELECT 'S46a' AS schritt, count(*) AS zeilen,
       string_agg(concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')), coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
                  chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, kennzahl) AS bericht
FROM roh;

-- Kompatible Nur-Lese-Suche nach Trainer- oder Personalfeldern im Offer-Payload.
WITH produktiv AS (
    SELECT t.offer_id, o.payload
    FROM kursplan.v_kursart_termin t
    JOIN edoobox_raw.offer o ON o.offer_id = t.offer_id
    WHERE o.payload IS NOT NULL
), kandidatentreffer AS (
    SELECT p.offer_id, lower((m.treffer)[1]) AS schluessel
    FROM produktiv p
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_matches(
        p.payload::text,
        '"([^"]*(trainer|teacher|instructor|referent|speaker|lecturer|coach|resource|leader|staff|employee|presenter|host)[^"]*)"[[:space:]]*:',
        'gi'
    ) AS m(treffer)
), kandidaten AS (
    SELECT schluessel, count(DISTINCT offer_id) AS termine
    FROM kandidatentreffer
    GROUP BY schluessel
), top_level AS (
    SELECT k AS schluessel, count(*) AS termine
    FROM produktiv p
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_object_keys(
        CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.payload) = 'object' THEN p.payload ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
    ) k
    GROUP BY k
), top_auswahl AS (
    SELECT * FROM top_level
    ORDER BY termine DESC, schluessel
    LIMIT 30
), roh AS (
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Kandidatenfeld' AS bereich,
           schluessel AS kennzahl, termine::numeric AS wert,
           'Anzahl produktiver Termine mit diesem Feldnamen' AS hinweis
    FROM kandidaten

    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Oberster Payload-Schluessel',
           schluessel, termine::numeric,
           'Anzahl produktiver Termine mit diesem Feld'
    FROM top_auswahl

    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Kontrolle', 'gefundene Kandidatenfelder',
           count(*)::numeric,
           CASE WHEN count(*) = 0
                THEN 'keine Trainerangabe im gespiegelten Offer-Payload gefunden'
                ELSE 'Kandidaten oben auf Verwendbarkeit pruefen' END
    FROM kandidaten
)
SELECT 'S49' AS schritt, count(*) AS zeilen,
       string_agg(concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl,
                            trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')), coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
                  chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl) AS bericht
FROM roh;

    SELECT fehler_text, run_id
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($p90err${{ $json.fehlerJson }}$p90err$::jsonb)
         AS x(fehler_text text, run_id bigint)
)
UPDATE edoobox_raw.sync_run AS r
SET status      = 'fehler',
    finished_at = now(),
    error_text  = f.fehler_text
FROM f
WHERE r.status = 'laeuft'
  AND (f.run_id IS NULL OR r.run_id = f.run_id)
RETURNING r.run_id, r.status;

// ausschliesslich aus dieser festen Konfiguration, NICHT aus Aufrufer-Eingaben
// (E-31c, E-31j: keine dynamischen SQL-/Tabellennamen aus Nutzereingaben).
//
// Stand 07.09.2026: Alle zwoelf Ressourcen sind spiegelbar (O-1/O-2 entschieden).
// Kennungen vereinheitlicht: edo_vat, edo_countries.

  const w = eingabe[name];
  if (w !== undefined && w !== null && w !== '') return w;
  return fallback;

-- Abnahme der drei Sichten. Nur lesend.
-- Ausgabe als ein einziges Textfeld zum Kopieren.
WITH roh AS (
-- Abnahme der drei Sichten. Nur lesend.

    -- A. Steuerfall je Buchung
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Steuerfall' AS bereich, steuerfall AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert,
           concat('netto ', round(coalesce(sum(netto), 0), 2),
                  ' / steuer ', round(coalesce(sum(steuerbetrag), 0), 2),
                  ' / b2b ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_b2b)) AS hinweis
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer
    GROUP BY steuerfall

    -- B. Steuerfall nur fuer gebuchte Buchungen
    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Steuerfall nur gebucht', steuerfall,
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('netto ', round(coalesce(sum(netto), 0), 2),
                  ' / brutto ', round(coalesce(sum(brutto), 0), 2))
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer WHERE status = 'gebucht'
    GROUP BY steuerfall

    -- C. Nominalsatz gegen Steuerfall, nur wo es auseinandergeht
    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Nominal gegen gemessen',
           concat('nominal ', coalesce(nominalsatz::text, 'ohne'), ' / ', steuerfall),
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('b2b ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_b2b),
                  ' / nicht b2b ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_b2b IS NOT TRUE))
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer
    GROUP BY nominalsatz, steuerfall
    HAVING count(*) >= 3

    -- D. Die abweichenden Faktoren einzeln
    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Abweichende Faktoren',
           concat('faktor ', coalesce(faktor::text, 'ohne'),
                  ' bei nominal ', coalesce(nominalsatz::text, 'ohne')),
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('netto ', round(sum(netto), 2), ' / brutto ', round(sum(brutto), 2),
                  ' / status ', string_agg(DISTINCT status, ' '))
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer
    WHERE steuerfall = 'abweichend'
    GROUP BY faktor, nominalsatz

    -- E. Buchungen ohne Betrag
    UNION ALL SELECT 50, 'E Ohne Betrag',
           concat(status, ' netto ',
                  CASE WHEN netto IS NULL THEN 'leer' WHEN netto = 0 THEN 'null' ELSE 'vorhanden' END,
                  ' brutto ',
                  CASE WHEN brutto IS NULL THEN 'leer' WHEN brutto = 0 THEN 'null' ELSE 'vorhanden' END),
           count(*)::numeric, NULL
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer
    WHERE netto IS NULL OR netto = 0 OR brutto IS NULL OR brutto = 0
    GROUP BY 3

    -- F. Zuordnungsgrad
    UNION ALL SELECT 60, 'F Zuordnungsgrad', zuordnungsgrad,
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat(count(DISTINCT invoice_id), ' Rechnungen / ',
                  count(DISTINCT booking_id), ' Buchungen')
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_rechnung
    GROUP BY zuordnungsgrad
    UNION ALL SELECT 61, 'F Zuordnungsgrad', 'buchungen mit mehreren rechnungen',
           count(DISTINCT booking_id)::numeric, NULL
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_rechnung WHERE mehrere_rechnungen

    -- G. Termine und Erloes
    UNION ALL SELECT 70, 'G Termine', 'termine gesamt',
           count(*)::numeric, NULL FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes
    UNION ALL SELECT 71, 'G Termine', 'termine mit buchung',
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE buchungen_gebucht > 0)::numeric, NULL
    FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes
    UNION ALL SELECT 72, 'G Termine', 'summe netto gebucht',
           round(sum(netto_gebucht), 2),
           'Vergleich Schritt 18: 784854.84' FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes
    UNION ALL SELECT 73, 'G Termine', 'summe brutto gebucht',
           round(sum(brutto_gebucht), 2),
           'Vergleich Zahlungsvorgaenge: 848037.44' FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes
    UNION ALL SELECT 74, 'G Termine', 'summe plaetze gebucht',
           sum(plaetze_gebucht)::numeric, NULL FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes
    UNION ALL SELECT 75, 'G Termine', 'auslastung ueber 100 prozent',
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE auslastung_prozent > 100)::numeric,
           concat('hoechstwert ', max(auslastung_prozent)) FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes
    UNION ALL SELECT 76, 'G Termine', 'ohne hoechstteilnehmerzahl',
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE user_maximum IS NULL OR user_maximum = 0)::numeric,
           NULL FROM kursplan.v_termin_erloes

    -- H. Gegenprobe Nettoerloes aus zwei Quellen
    UNION ALL SELECT 80, 'H Gegenprobe', 'netto aus v_buchung_steuer gebucht',
           (SELECT round(sum(netto), 2) FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer
             WHERE status = 'gebucht')::numeric,
           'ohne Bezug auf einen Termin enthalten'
    UNION ALL SELECT 81, 'H Gegenprobe', 'netto aus booking_position gebucht',
           (SELECT round(sum(p.amount_net * coalesce(p.quantity, 1)), 2)
              FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
              JOIN edoobox_raw.booking b ON b.booking_id = p.booking_id
             WHERE b.status = 'gebucht')::numeric, NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 82, 'H Gegenprobe', 'netto aller buchungen',
           (SELECT round(sum(netto), 2) FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer)::numeric, NULL
)
-- Die Reihenfolge muss in string_agg stehen, ein ORDER BY im CTE waere unverbindlich.
SELECT
    'S29' AS schritt,
    count(*) AS zeilen,
    string_agg(
        concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')),
                  coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
        chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl
    ) AS bericht
FROM roh;

-- Merker, bis wann die Detailangaben einer Buchung geholt wurden.
-- Ohne diesen Merker liesse sich ein abgebrochener Lauf nicht fortsetzen.
ALTER TABLE edoobox_raw.booking
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS detail_synced_at timestamptz;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS booking_detail_offen_idx
    ON edoobox_raw.booking (detail_synced_at)
    WHERE detail_synced_at IS NULL;

SELECT
    count(*)                                          AS buchungen,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE detail_synced_at IS NULL)  AS noch_offen
FROM edoobox_raw.booking
WHERE is_deleted = false;

-- Naechster Stapel. Liefert die Abfrage keine Zeile, endet der Ablauf
-- von selbst, weil n8n Knoten ohne Eingang ueberspringt.
SELECT booking_id
FROM edoobox_raw.booking
WHERE is_deleted = false
  AND detail_synced_at IS NULL
ORDER BY booking_time DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 200;

WITH stapel AS (
    SELECT booking_id
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoIds${{ $json.alleKennungenJson }}$edoIds$::jsonb)
         AS s(booking_id text)
),
eingang AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoJson${{ $json.datenJson }}$edoJson$::jsonb)
         AS t(
            booking_id     text,
            offer_id       text,
            promotion_id   text,
            is_b2b         boolean,
            is_multi_offer boolean,
            teilnehmer     integer,
            positionen     jsonb,
            vorgaenge      jsonb
         )
),
kopf AS (
    UPDATE edoobox_raw.booking b
    SET is_b2b         = e.is_b2b,
        is_multi_offer = e.is_multi_offer,
        offer_id       = coalesce(e.offer_id, b.offer_id),
        last_synced_at = now()
    FROM eingang e
    WHERE b.booking_id = e.booking_id
    RETURNING b.booking_id
),
positionen AS (
    SELECT e.booking_id, p.*
    FROM eingang e
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(e.positionen)
         AS p(
            pricecategory_id   text,
            pricecategory_name text,
            amount_net         numeric(12,2),
            currency           char(3),
            quantity           integer,
            is_default         boolean
         )
),
positionen_geschrieben AS (
    INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.booking_position AS bp (
        booking_id, pricecategory_id, pricecategory_name,
        amount_net, currency, quantity, is_default, last_synced_at
    )
    SELECT booking_id, pricecategory_id, pricecategory_name,
           amount_net, currency, quantity, is_default, now()
    FROM positionen
    ON CONFLICT (booking_id, pricecategory_id) DO UPDATE
    SET pricecategory_name = EXCLUDED.pricecategory_name,
        amount_net         = EXCLUDED.amount_net,
        currency           = EXCLUDED.currency,
        quantity           = EXCLUDED.quantity,
        is_default         = EXCLUDED.is_default,
        last_synced_at     = now()
    RETURNING bp.position_id
),
vorgaenge AS (
    SELECT e.booking_id, v.*
    FROM eingang e
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(e.vorgaenge)
         AS v(
            transaction_id     text,
            transaction_number text,
            amount             numeric(12,2),
            currency           char(3)
         )
),
vorgaenge_geschrieben AS (
    INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.booking_transaction AS bt (
        transaction_id, booking_id, transaction_number,
        amount, currency, last_synced_at
    )
    SELECT transaction_id, booking_id, transaction_number,
           amount, currency, now()
    FROM vorgaenge
    ON CONFLICT (transaction_id) DO UPDATE
    SET booking_id         = EXCLUDED.booking_id,
        transaction_number = EXCLUDED.transaction_number,
        amount             = EXCLUDED.amount,
        currency           = EXCLUDED.currency,
        last_synced_at     = now()
    RETURNING bt.transaction_id
),
-- Der Merker wird fuer den gesamten Stapel gesetzt, auch fuer Buchungen
-- ohne Preiskategorie. Sonst liefe die Schleife endlos.
abgehakt AS (
    UPDATE edoobox_raw.booking b
    SET detail_synced_at = now()
    FROM stapel s
    WHERE b.booking_id = s.booking_id
    RETURNING b.booking_id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM abgehakt)               AS stapel_abgehakt,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM kopf)                   AS kopfsaetze,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM positionen_geschrieben) AS positionen,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM vorgaenge_geschrieben)  AS vorgaenge,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.booking
      WHERE is_deleted = false AND detail_synced_at IS NULL) AS noch_offen;

-- Nur lesen. Die Spalte detail_synced_at wird vorher einmalig
-- mit dem Verwaltungskonto ueber S14a angelegt.
