),
vorgaenge AS (
    SELECT e.booking_id, v.*
    FROM eingang e
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(e.vorgaenge)
         AS v(
            transaction_id     text,
            transaction_number text,
            amount             numeric(12,2),
            currency           char(3)
         )
),
vorgaenge_geschrieben AS (
    INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.booking_transaction AS bt (
        transaction_id, booking_id, transaction_number,
        amount, currency, last_synced_at
    )
    SELECT transaction_id, booking_id, transaction_number,
           amount, currency, now()
    FROM vorgaenge
    ON CONFLICT (transaction_id) DO UPDATE
    SET booking_id         = EXCLUDED.booking_id,
        transaction_number = EXCLUDED.transaction_number,
        amount             = EXCLUDED.amount,
        currency           = EXCLUDED.currency,
        last_synced_at     = now()
    RETURNING bt.transaction_id
),
-- Der Merker wird fuer den gesamten Stapel gesetzt, auch fuer Buchungen
-- ohne Preiskategorie. Sonst liefe die Schleife endlos.
abgehakt AS (
    UPDATE edoobox_raw.booking b
    SET detail_synced_at = now()
    FROM stapel s
    WHERE b.booking_id = s.booking_id
    RETURNING b.booking_id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM abgehakt)               AS stapel_abgehakt,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM kopf)                   AS kopfsaetze,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM positionen_geschrieben) AS positionen,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM vorgaenge_geschrieben)  AS vorgaenge,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.booking
      WHERE is_deleted = false AND detail_synced_at IS NULL) AS noch_offen;

-- Stimmt die Formel Nettopreis mal Menge?
-- Verglichen wird die eigene Rechnung mit dem gemeldeten Zahlungsbetrag.
WITH je_buchung AS (
    SELECT
        b.booking_id,
        b.status,
        (SELECT round(sum(p.amount_net * p.quantity), 2)
           FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
          WHERE p.booking_id = b.booking_id)      AS netto_mal_menge,
        (SELECT round(sum(p.amount_net), 2)
           FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
          WHERE p.booking_id = b.booking_id)      AS netto_ohne_menge,
        (SELECT round(sum(t.amount), 2)
           FROM edoobox_raw.booking_transaction t
          WHERE t.booking_id = b.booking_id)      AS brutto_gemeldet
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
    WHERE b.is_deleted = false
    GROUP BY b.booking_id, b.status
),
bewertet AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN netto_mal_menge  > 0 THEN round(brutto_gemeldet / netto_mal_menge,  4) END AS faktor_mit_menge,
        CASE WHEN netto_ohne_menge > 0 THEN round(brutto_gemeldet / netto_ohne_menge, 4) END AS faktor_ohne_menge
    FROM je_buchung
    WHERE brutto_gemeldet IS NOT NULL
      AND brutto_gemeldet > 0
)
SELECT 'Buchungen mit Preis und Zahlung' AS befund, count(*)::text AS anzahl, '' AS anteil
  FROM bewertet
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Faktor mit Menge liegt bei 1.19',
       count(*)::text,
       to_char(100.0 * count(*) / nullif((SELECT count(*) FROM bewertet), 0), 'FM990D0') || ' %'
  FROM bewertet WHERE faktor_mit_menge BETWEEN 1.185 AND 1.195
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Faktor ohne Menge liegt bei 1.19',
       count(*)::text,
       to_char(100.0 * count(*) / nullif((SELECT count(*) FROM bewertet), 0), 'FM990D0') || ' %'
  FROM bewertet WHERE faktor_ohne_menge BETWEEN 1.185 AND 1.195
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Faktor mit Menge liegt bei 1.00',
       count(*)::text,
       to_char(100.0 * count(*) / nullif((SELECT count(*) FROM bewertet), 0), 'FM990D0') || ' %'
  FROM bewertet WHERE faktor_mit_menge BETWEEN 0.995 AND 1.005
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Faktor mit Menge sonst',
       count(*)::text,
       to_char(100.0 * count(*) / nullif((SELECT count(*) FROM bewertet), 0), 'FM990D0') || ' %'
  FROM bewertet
 WHERE faktor_mit_menge IS NULL
    OR (faktor_mit_menge NOT BETWEEN 1.185 AND 1.195
    AND faktor_mit_menge NOT BETWEEN 0.995 AND 1.005);

-- Buchungen mit mehr als einem Platz, zum Nachrechnen von Hand.
SELECT
    right(b.booking_id, 12)                                AS buchung_kurz,
    b.status,
    p.pricecategory_name                                   AS preiskategorie,
    p.quantity                                             AS menge,
    p.amount_net                                           AS preis_netto,
    round(p.amount_net * p.quantity, 2)                    AS netto_mal_menge,
    (SELECT round(sum(t.amount), 2)
       FROM edoobox_raw.booking_transaction t
      WHERE t.booking_id = b.booking_id)                   AS brutto_gemeldet,
    CASE WHEN p.amount_net > 0 THEN
        round((SELECT sum(t.amount) FROM edoobox_raw.booking_transaction t
                WHERE t.booking_id = b.booking_id) / (p.amount_net * p.quantity), 3)
    END                                                    AS faktor
FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
JOIN edoobox_raw.booking_position p ON p.booking_id = b.booking_id
WHERE b.is_deleted = false
  AND p.quantity > 1
  AND p.amount_net > 0
ORDER BY p.quantity DESC, p.amount_net DESC
LIMIT 20;

-- Nullfaelle auf allen drei Ebenen: Buchung, Rechnungsposition, Rechnung.
-- Prueft ausserdem die Erklaerung kostenloser Nachholtermin.
-- Nur lesend. Ausgabe als ein Textfeld zum Kopieren.
WITH bezahlt AS (
    -- Alle Buchungen mit Erloes, mit Teilnehmerkennung und Kursdefinition
    SELECT b.user_ref, o.offerdef_ref
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s
    JOIN edoobox_raw.booking b ON b.booking_id = s.booking_id
    LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.offer o ON o.offer_id = s.offer_id
    WHERE s.netto > 0 AND b.user_ref IS NOT NULL
),
null_buchung AS (
    -- Gebuchte Buchungen ohne jeden Betrag
    SELECT s.booking_id, b.user_ref, o.offerdef_ref
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s
    JOIN edoobox_raw.booking b ON b.booking_id = s.booking_id
    LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.offer o ON o.offer_id = s.offer_id
    WHERE coalesce(s.netto, 0) = 0 AND coalesce(s.brutto, 0) = 0
      AND s.status = 'gebucht'
),
roh AS (
    -- A. Nullfaelle je Ebene
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Ebenen' AS bereich, 'buchungen netto und brutto null' AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert, NULL::text AS hinweis
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer WHERE coalesce(netto, 0) = 0 AND coalesce(brutto, 0) = 0
    UNION ALL SELECT 11, 'A Ebenen', 'buchungen ganz ohne positionszeile',
           count(*)::numeric, NULL
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p WHERE p.booking_id = b.booking_id)
    UNION ALL SELECT 12, 'A Ebenen', 'positionszeilen mit amount_net null',
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('von ', (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position), ' zeilen')
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position WHERE coalesce(amount_net, 0) = 0
    UNION ALL SELECT 13, 'A Ebenen', 'rechnungen mit betrag null',
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('von ', (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.invoice), ' rechnungen')
    FROM edoobox_raw.invoice WHERE coalesce(amount, 0) = 0
    UNION ALL SELECT 14, 'A Ebenen', 'rechnungszeilen mit price_net null',
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('von ', (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_line), ' zeilen')
    FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_line WHERE coalesce(price_net, 0) = 0
    UNION ALL SELECT 15, 'A Ebenen', 'vorgaenge mit betrag null',
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('von ', (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.booking_transaction), ' vorgaengen')
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_transaction WHERE coalesce(amount, 0) = 0

    -- B. Nullbuchungen nach Jahr und Status
    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Nullbuchung je Jahr',
           concat(s.status, ' ', extract(year FROM s.booking_time)::int::text),
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('mit rechnungsposten ', count(s.nominalsatz))
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s
    WHERE coalesce(s.netto, 0) = 0 AND coalesce(s.brutto, 0) = 0
    GROUP BY 3

    -- C. Nachholtermin-Test: derselbe Teilnehmer hat denselben Kurs schon bezahlt
    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Nachholtermin-Test',
           CASE
               WHEN g.user_ref IS NOT NULL THEN 'gleicher kurs schon bezahlt'
               WHEN a.user_ref IS NOT NULL THEN 'anderer kurs bezahlt'
               ELSE 'nie etwas bezahlt'
           END,
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('von ', (SELECT count(*) FROM null_buchung), ' gebuchten nullbuchungen')
    FROM null_buchung nb
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT user_ref, offerdef_ref FROM bezahlt) g
           ON g.user_ref = nb.user_ref AND g.offerdef_ref = nb.offerdef_ref
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT user_ref FROM bezahlt) a
           ON a.user_ref = nb.user_ref
    GROUP BY 3

    -- D. Kursnamen der Nullbuchungen
    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Kurs der Nullbuchung',
           left(coalesce(o.name, 'ohne angebot'), 60),
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('jahre ', min(extract(year FROM s.booking_time)::int), ' bis ',
                  max(extract(year FROM s.booking_time)::int))
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s
    LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.offer o ON o.offer_id = s.offer_id
    WHERE coalesce(s.netto, 0) = 0 AND coalesce(s.brutto, 0) = 0
      AND s.status = 'gebucht'
    GROUP BY 3
    HAVING count(*) >= 5

    -- E. Termine, die ausschliesslich Nullbuchungen haben
    UNION ALL SELECT 50, 'E Termin nur Nullbuchungen', 'termine', count(*)::numeric,
           'Hinweis auf Testtermine oder reine Gratisangebote'
    FROM (
        SELECT s.offer_id
        FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s
        WHERE s.status = 'gebucht' AND s.offer_id IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY s.offer_id
        HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(s.netto, 0) > 0) = 0
           AND count(*) > 0
    ) t

    -- F. Nullbuchungen auf Terminen, die auch zahlende Buchungen haben
    UNION ALL SELECT 51, 'F Gemischte Termine', 'nullbuchungen auf bezahlten terminen',
           count(*)::numeric,
           'diese belegen einen Platz ohne Erloes'
    FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s
    WHERE s.status = 'gebucht' AND coalesce(s.netto, 0) = 0 AND s.offer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kursplan.v_buchung_steuer z
                   WHERE z.offer_id = s.offer_id AND z.netto > 0 AND z.status = 'gebucht')

    -- G. Rechnungen mit Betrag null naeher betrachtet
    UNION ALL SELECT 60, 'G Rechnung mit null',
           concat('status ', coalesce(status::text, 'ohne'), ' jahr ',
                  coalesce(extract(year FROM date_create)::int::text, 'ohne')),
           count(*)::numeric, NULL
    FROM edoobox_raw.invoice WHERE coalesce(amount, 0) = 0
    GROUP BY 3
)
SELECT
    'S30' AS schritt,
    count(*) AS zeilen,
    string_agg(
        concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')),
                  coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
        chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl
    ) AS bericht
FROM roh;

WITH lr AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT max(finished_at) FROM edoobox_raw.sync_run WHERE run_type = 'P01' AND status = 'erfolgreich') AS last_p01,
        (SELECT max(finished_at) FROM edoobox_raw.sync_run WHERE run_type = 'P02' AND status = 'erfolgreich') AS last_p02,
        (SELECT max(finished_at) FROM edoobox_raw.sync_run WHERE run_type IN ('vollabgleich','P03') AND status = 'erfolgreich') AS last_p03
)
SELECT
    lr.last_p01,

    lr.last_p02,
    round(extract(epoch from (now() - lr.last_p02)))::numeric AS p02_alter_sek,
    lr.last_p03,
    round(extract(epoch from (now() - lr.last_p03)))::numeric AS p03_alter_sek,
    extract(isodow from now() at time zone 'Europe/Berlin')::int AS wochentag,
    extract(hour   from now() at time zone 'Europe/Berlin')::int AS stunde,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.offer_date d
       LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.offer o ON o.offer_id = d.offer_id
      WHERE d.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE AND o.offer_id IS NULL) AS date_ohne_offer,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
       LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.booking b ON b.booking_id = p.booking_id
      WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL) AS position_ohne_buchung,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.booking_transaction t
       LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.booking b ON b.booking_id = t.booking_id
      WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL) AS trans_ohne_buchung,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
       LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.offer o ON o.offer_id = b.offer_id
      WHERE b.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE AND b.offer_id IS NOT NULL AND o.offer_id IS NULL) AS buchung_ohne_offer,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.date_leader dl
       LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.trainer_admin a ON a.admin_id = dl.admin_id
      WHERE a.admin_id IS NULL) AS leader_ohne_trainer,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.attendance a
       LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.offer_date d ON d.date_id = a.date_id
      WHERE a.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE AND a.date_id IS NOT NULL AND d.date_id IS NULL) AS attendance_ohne_termin,
    (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE kostenkonfiguration_fehlt)

    (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT kostenkonfiguration_fehlt)

      WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01') AS berechenbare_angebote,
    (SELECT round(sum(netto_gebucht), 2)

      WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01' AND NOT kostenkonfiguration_fehlt) AS netto,
    (SELECT round(sum(trainerkosten), 2)
       FROM kursplan.v_termin_db1
      WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01' AND NOT kostenkonfiguration_fehlt) AS trainerkosten,
    (SELECT round(sum(plattformkosten), 2)
       FROM kursplan.v_termin_db1
      WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01' AND NOT kostenkonfiguration_fehlt) AS plattformkosten,
    (SELECT round(sum(direkte_kosten), 2)
       FROM kursplan.v_termin_db1
      WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01' AND NOT kostenkonfiguration_fehlt) AS direkte_kosten,
    (SELECT round(sum(db1), 2)
       FROM kursplan.v_termin_db1
      WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01' AND NOT kostenkonfiguration_fehlt) AS db1,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM kursplan.v_termin_db1 t

        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM edoobox_raw.offer_date d

       FROM kursplan.v_termin_db1

      WHERE t.date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01'
        AND t.kosten_aktiv
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM edoobox_raw.offer_date d
            JOIN edoobox_raw.date_leader dl ON dl.date_id = d.date_id
            WHERE d.offer_id = t.offer_id AND d.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
        )) AS angebote_ohne_trainer
FROM lr;

UPDATE edoobox_raw.sync_run
SET
    status = $1,
    finished_at = now(),
    error_text = $2
WHERE run_id = $3
RETURNING run_id, status, finished_at, error_text;

WITH vorherige_laeufe AS (
    UPDATE edoobox_raw.sync_run
    SET status      = 'abgebrochen',
        finished_at = now(),
        error_text  = 'Durch neuen Angebotsabgleich ersetzt'
    WHERE run_type = 'vollabgleich'
      AND status   = 'laeuft'
)
INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.sync_run (run_type, status)
VALUES ('vollabgleich', 'laeuft')
RETURNING run_id, started_at;

WITH eingang AS (
    SELECT
        t.*,
        md5(
            concat_ws('|',
                t.name, t.offer_number, t.category_ref, t.place_ref,
                t.date_start::text, t.date_end::text,
                t.user_minimal::text, t.user_maximum::text,
                t.status, t.mode, t.offer_type, t.vat_rate::text,
                t.is_archived::text, t.is_trash::text)
        ) AS payload_hash
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoJson${{ $json.datenJson }}$edoJson$::jsonb)
         AS t(
            offer_id             text,
            offer_number         text,
            name                 text,
            category_ref         text,
            offerdef_ref         text,
            place_ref            text,
            date_start           timestamptz,
            date_end             timestamptz,
            date_signupstart     timestamptz,
            date_close           timestamptz,
            user_minimal         integer,
            user_maximum         integer,
            status               text,
            mode                 text,
            offer_type           text,
            vat_rate             numeric(6,3),
            country              text,
            internal_code        text,
            is_archived          boolean,
            is_trash             boolean,
            has_waiting_list     boolean,
            mustpay              boolean,
            is_multi_offer       boolean,
            is_multi_offer_child boolean,
            payload              jsonb
         )
),
kennzahlen AS (
    SELECT
        count(*) AS zeilen,
        count(*) FILTER (
            WHERE o.offer_id IS NULL
               OR o.payload_hash IS DISTINCT FROM e.payload_hash
        ) AS geaendert
    FROM eingang e
    LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.offer o ON o.offer_id = e.offer_id
),
geschrieben AS (
    INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.offer AS o (
        offer_id, offer_number, name, category_ref, offerdef_ref, place_ref,
        date_start, date_end, date_signupstart, date_close,
        user_minimal, user_maximum, status, mode, offer_type,
        vat_rate, country, internal_code,
        is_archived, is_trash, has_waiting_list, mustpay,
        is_multi_offer, is_multi_offer_child,
        payload, last_synced_at, last_changed_at, payload_hash, is_deleted
    )
    SELECT
        e.offer_id, e.offer_number, e.name, e.category_ref, e.offerdef_ref, e.place_ref,
        e.date_start, e.date_end, e.date_signupstart, e.date_close,
        e.user_minimal, e.user_maximum, e.status, e.mode, e.offer_type,
        e.vat_rate, e.country, e.internal_code,
        coalesce(e.is_archived, false), coalesce(e.is_trash, false),
        e.has_waiting_list, e.mustpay, e.is_multi_offer, e.is_multi_offer_child,
        e.payload, now(), now(), e.payload_hash, false
    FROM eingang e
    ON CONFLICT (offer_id) DO UPDATE
    SET offer_number         = EXCLUDED.offer_number,
        name                 = EXCLUDED.name,
        category_ref         = EXCLUDED.category_ref,
        offerdef_ref         = EXCLUDED.offerdef_ref,
        place_ref            = EXCLUDED.place_ref,
        date_start           = EXCLUDED.date_start,
        date_end             = EXCLUDED.date_end,

-- Rein lesende Einzelliste der echten Kursangebote ohne Trainerzuordnung.
-- Bestaetigte Nichtkurstermine werden bereits fuer diese Pruefung ausgeblendet.
WITH kandidaten AS (
    SELECT
        t.offer_id,
        t.offer_number,
        t.date_start,
        t.date_end,
        t.kurscode,
        t.kursbezeichnung,
        t.termin_status,
        t.buchungen_gebucht,
        t.buchungen_storniert,
        t.plaetze_gebucht,
        t.user_maximum,
        coalesce(t.netto_gebucht, 0)::numeric AS netto_gebucht,
        CASE
            WHEN t.date_start::date > current_date THEN 'zukuenftig'
            ELSE 'vergangen'
        END::text AS zeitlage
    FROM kursplan.v_kursart_termin t
    WHERE t.date_start >= timestamptz '2023-01-01 00:00:00 Europe/Berlin'
      AND t.kurscode !~ '^ft-'
      AND t.kurscode NOT IN ('kontingent-10', 'gebuehren')
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM edoobox_raw.offer_date d
          JOIN edoobox_raw.date_leader dl ON dl.date_id = d.date_id
          WHERE d.offer_id = t.offer_id
            AND d.is_deleted = false
      )
)
SELECT
    'S57'::text AS schritt,
    row_number() OVER (
        ORDER BY (netto_gebucht > 0) DESC, netto_gebucht DESC, date_start, offer_id
    ) AS nr,
    offer_id,
    offer_number,
    date_start,
    date_end,
    kurscode,
    kursbezeichnung,
    termin_status,
    zeitlage,
    buchungen_gebucht,
    buchungen_storniert,
    plaetze_gebucht,
    user_maximum,
    round(netto_gebucht, 2) AS netto_gebucht,
    count(*) OVER () AS angebote_ohne_trainer,
    round(sum(netto_gebucht) OVER (), 2) AS netto_gesamt
FROM kandidaten
ORDER BY nr;

-- Die 200 bereits geholten Buchungen wurden mit der falschen
-- Teilnehmerzaehlung geschrieben. Sie werden erneut zum Abruf freigegeben.
UPDATE edoobox_raw.booking
SET detail_synced_at = NULL
WHERE is_deleted = false;

SELECT count(*) AS wieder_offen
FROM edoobox_raw.booking
WHERE is_deleted = false AND detail_synced_at IS NULL;

-- Alle offenen Buchungen auf einmal. Keine Schleife.
SELECT booking_id
FROM edoobox_raw.booking
WHERE is_deleted = false
  AND detail_synced_at IS NULL
ORDER BY booking_time DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH stapel AS (
    SELECT booking_id
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoIds${{ $json.alleKennungenJson }}$edoIds$::jsonb)
         AS s(booking_id text)
),
eingang AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoJson${{ $json.datenJson }}$edoJson$::jsonb)
         AS t(
            booking_id     text,
            offer_id       text,
            promotion_id   text,
            is_b2b         boolean,
            is_multi_offer boolean,
            teilnehmer_aktiv integer,
            teilnehmer_gesamt integer,
            positionen     jsonb,
            vorgaenge      jsonb
         )
),
positionen AS (
    SELECT e.booking_id, p.*
    FROM eingang e
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(e.positionen)
         AS p(
            pricecategory_id   text,
            pricecategory_name text,
            amount_net         numeric(12,2),
            currency           char(3),
            quantity           integer,
            is_default         boolean
         )
),
positionen_geschrieben AS (
    INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.booking_position AS bp (
        booking_id, pricecategory_id, pricecategory_name,
        amount_net, currency, quantity, is_default, last_synced_at
    )
    SELECT booking_id, pricecategory_id, pricecategory_name,
           amount_net, currency, quantity, is_default, now()
    FROM positionen
    ON CONFLICT (booking_id, pricecategory_id) DO UPDATE
    SET pricecategory_name = EXCLUDED.pricecategory_name,
        amount_net         = EXCLUDED.amount_net,
        currency           = EXCLUDED.currency,
        quantity           = EXCLUDED.quantity,
        is_default         = EXCLUDED.is_default,
        last_synced_at     = now()
    RETURNING bp.position_id
),
vorgaenge AS (
    SELECT e.booking_id, v.*
    FROM eingang e
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(e.vorgaenge)
         AS v(
            transaction_id     text,
            transaction_number text,
            amount             numeric(12,2),
            currency           char(3)
         )
),
vorgaenge_geschrieben AS (
    INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.booking_transaction AS bt (
        transaction_id, booking_id, transaction_number,
        amount, currency, last_synced_at
    )
    SELECT transaction_id, booking_id, transaction_number,
           amount, currency, now()
    FROM vorgaenge
    ON CONFLICT (transaction_id) DO UPDATE
    SET booking_id         = EXCLUDED.booking_id,
        transaction_number = EXCLUDED.transaction_number,
        amount             = EXCLUDED.amount,
        currency           = EXCLUDED.currency,
        last_synced_at     = now()
    RETURNING bt.transaction_id
),
-- Der Merker wird fuer den gesamten Stapel gesetzt, auch fuer Buchungen
-- ohne Preiskategorie. Sonst liefe die Schleife endlos.
abgehakt AS (
    -- Eine einzige Aktualisierung der Tabelle booking. Zwei getrennte
    -- Bloecke auf dieselbe Zeile werden von PostgreSQL nicht nacheinander
    -- ausgefuehrt, einer davon bliebe wirkungslos.
    UPDATE edoobox_raw.booking b
    SET detail_synced_at = now(),
        last_synced_at   = now(),
        is_b2b           = coalesce(e.is_b2b,         b.is_b2b),
        is_multi_offer   = coalesce(e.is_multi_offer, b.is_multi_offer),
        offer_id         = coalesce(e.offer_id,       b.offer_id)
    FROM stapel s
    LEFT JOIN eingang e ON e.booking_id = s.booking_id
    WHERE b.booking_id = s.booking_id
    RETURNING b.booking_id, (e.booking_id IS NOT NULL) AS mit_detail
)
SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM abgehakt)                            AS stapel_abgehakt,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM abgehakt WHERE mit_detail)           AS mit_detail,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM positionen_geschrieben)              AS positionen,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM vorgaenge_geschrieben)               AS vorgaenge;

-- Klaert, welcher Steuersatz der abgerechnete ist.
-- Vergleicht den Satz aus items.contained gegen invoice_data.items
-- und gegen das Verhaeltnis brutto zu netto auf der Buchungsseite.
-- Nur lesend.
WITH paar AS (
    -- Rechnungsposten und gedruckte Zeile ueber die Vorgangsnummer verbunden
    SELECT
        i.invoice_id,
        i.transaction_number,
        i.vat_percent  AS satz_posten,
        l.vat_percent  AS satz_zeile,
        l.vat_type,
        l.price_net,
        l.quantity
    FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_item i
    JOIN edoobox_raw.invoice_line l
      ON l.invoice_id = i.invoice_id
     AND l.transaction_number = i.transaction_number
    WHERE i.transaction_number IS NOT NULL
),
netto_je_buchung AS (
    SELECT booking_id, sum(amount_net * coalesce(quantity, 1)) AS netto
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position
    GROUP BY booking_id
    HAVING sum(amount_net * coalesce(quantity, 1)) > 0
),
faktor AS (
    SELECT
        t.booking_id,
        b.is_b2b,
        i.vat_percent AS satz_posten,
        round(t.amount / n.netto, 3) AS faktor
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_transaction t
    JOIN netto_je_buchung n ON n.booking_id = t.booking_id
    JOIN edoobox_raw.booking b ON b.booking_id = t.booking_id
    JOIN edoobox_raw.invoice_item i ON i.transaction_id = t.transaction_id
    WHERE t.amount IS NOT NULL AND t.amount > 0
),
ohne_rechnung AS (
    SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, extract(year FROM b.booking_time)::int AS jahr, b.is_b2b
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_item i
        JOIN edoobox_raw.booking_transaction t ON t.transaction_id = i.transaction_id
        WHERE t.booking_id = b.booking_id)
)
SELECT * FROM (
    -- A. Steuerart aus der gedruckten Zeile
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Steuerart aus invoice_line' AS bereich,
           concat(coalesce(vat_type, 'ohne art'), ' bei ',
                  coalesce(vat_percent::text, 'ohne'), ' Prozent') AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert,
           concat('zeilen in ', count(DISTINCT invoice_id), ' Rechnungen') AS hinweis
    FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_line
    GROUP BY vat_type, vat_percent

    -- B. Posten gegen gedruckte Zeile
    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Posten gegen Zeile',
           concat('posten ', satz_posten::text, ' / zeile ', coalesce(satz_zeile::text, 'ohne')),
           count(*)::numeric,
           CASE WHEN satz_posten = satz_zeile THEN 'gleich' ELSE 'abweichend' END
    FROM paar GROUP BY satz_posten, satz_zeile

    -- C. Postensatz gegen Verhaeltnis brutto zu netto der Buchung
    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Postensatz gegen Faktor',
           concat('satz ', coalesce(satz_posten::text, 'ohne'), ' / faktor ',
                  coalesce(faktor::text, 'ohne')),
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('b2b ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_b2b), ' / nicht b2b ',
                  count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_b2b IS NOT TRUE))
    FROM faktor
    GROUP BY satz_posten, faktor
    HAVING count(*) >= 5

    -- D. Vorzeichen der Postenbetraege
    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Vorzeichen',
           concat(item_type, ' ',
                  CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN 'negativ' WHEN amount > 0 THEN 'positiv'
                       WHEN amount = 0 THEN 'null' ELSE 'leer' END),
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('summe ', round(sum(amount), 2), ' / betrag ohne vorzeichen ',
                  round(sum(abs(amount)), 2))
    FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_item
    GROUP BY item_type, 3

    -- E. Buchungen ohne Rechnung
    UNION ALL SELECT 50, 'E Buchung ohne Rechnung', concat(status, ' ', jahr::text),
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('b2b ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_b2b))
    FROM ohne_rechnung GROUP BY status, jahr

    -- F. Rechnungen ohne Buchung
    UNION ALL SELECT 60, 'F Rechnung ohne Buchung',
           concat(coalesce(r.invoice_number, 'ohne nummer'), ' status ', coalesce(r.status::text, 'ohne')),
           coalesce(r.amount, 0),
           concat('erstellt ', coalesce(to_char(r.date_create, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'ohne'),
                  ' / posten ', (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_item q WHERE q.invoice_id = r.invoice_id))
    FROM edoobox_raw.invoice r
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_item i
        JOIN edoobox_raw.booking_transaction t ON t.transaction_id = i.transaction_id
        WHERE i.invoice_id = r.invoice_id)

    -- G. Deckung der Nettobetraege
    UNION ALL SELECT 70, 'G Netto', 'summe price_net_summation aus invoice_line',
           (SELECT round(sum(price_net_summation), 2) FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_line)::numeric,
           'nur Rechnungen ab 2023'
    UNION ALL SELECT 71, 'G Netto', 'summe taxBasisTotalAmount',
           (SELECT round(sum(tax_basis_total), 2) FROM edoobox_raw.invoice)::numeric, NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 72, 'G Netto', 'summe rechnungsbetrag ab 2023',
           (SELECT round(sum(amount), 2) FROM edoobox_raw.invoice WHERE tax_total IS NOT NULL)::numeric,
           NULL
) x
ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl;

-- Kombiniert Buchungsanzahl und kostenpflichtige Gruppengroessen. Nur lesend.
WITH pos AS (
    SELECT p.booking_id,
           coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.pricecategory_name), ''), '(ohne namen)') AS kat,
           coalesce(p.quantity, 0) AS menge,
           CASE WHEN p.pricecategory_name ~* '(bis zu|max\\.?|f\\.|fuer|für)[^0-9]{0,12}[0-9]+[[:space:]]*person'
                THEN (substring(p.pricecategory_name from '(?i)(?:bis zu|max\\.?|f\\.|fuer|für)[^0-9]{0,12}([0-9]+)[[:space:]]*person'))::int END AS basis_n,
           CASE WHEN p.pricecategory_name ~* '[0-9]+[[:space:]]*(personen|person|teiln|teilnehmer)'
                THEN (substring(p.pricecategory_name from '(?i)([0-9]+)[[:space:]]*(?:personen|person|teiln|teilnehmer)'))::int END AS text_n,
           (p.pricecategory_name ~* '(jede|je|pro)[[:space:]]+weitere|preis[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*für[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*jede[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*weitere') AS ist_zusatz
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
),
je_buchung AS (
    SELECT b.booking_id, b.offer_id, s.status, coalesce(s.netto, 0) AS netto,
           max(pos.basis_n) AS basis_n, max(pos.text_n) AS text_n,
           coalesce(sum(pos.menge) FILTER (WHERE pos.ist_zusatz), 0) AS zusatz_n,
           coalesce(sum(pos.menge) FILTER (WHERE pos.kat = 'Inklusive'), 0) AS inklusive_n,
           bool_or(pos.kat = 'Inklusive') AS hat_inklusive
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
    JOIN kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s ON s.booking_id = b.booking_id
    LEFT JOIN pos ON pos.booking_id = b.booking_id
    GROUP BY b.booking_id, b.offer_id, s.status, 4
),
kopf AS (
    SELECT j.*,
           CASE WHEN basis_n IS NOT NULL THEN basis_n + zusatz_n
                WHEN text_n IS NOT NULL THEN text_n
                WHEN hat_inklusive THEN 1 + inklusive_n + zusatz_n
                ELSE 1 END AS abgeleitet,
           CASE WHEN (netto <> 0 OR hat_inklusive) AND
                          (CASE WHEN basis_n IS NOT NULL THEN basis_n + zusatz_n
                                WHEN text_n IS NOT NULL THEN text_n
                                WHEN hat_inklusive THEN 1 + inklusive_n + zusatz_n
                                ELSE 1 END) > 1
                THEN CASE WHEN basis_n IS NOT NULL THEN basis_n + zusatz_n
                          WHEN text_n IS NOT NULL THEN text_n
                          ELSE 1 + inklusive_n + zusatz_n END
                WHEN netto <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS kommerzielle_plaetze
    FROM je_buchung j
),
je_termin AS (
    SELECT o.offer_id, o.name, o.date_start, o.user_maximum,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht') AS buchungen,
           coalesce(sum(k.kommerzielle_plaetze) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht'), 0) AS kommerzielle_plaetze,
           greatest(count(*) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht'),
                    coalesce(sum(k.kommerzielle_plaetze) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht'), 0)) AS plaetze,
           round(coalesce(sum(k.netto) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht'), 0), 2) AS netto
    FROM edoobox_raw.offer o
    JOIN kopf k ON k.offer_id = o.offer_id
    WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
    GROUP BY o.offer_id, o.name, o.date_start, o.user_maximum
),
roh AS (
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Regelentscheidung' AS bereich,
           CASE WHEN buchungen >= kommerzielle_plaetze THEN 'buchungsanzahl verwendet'
                ELSE 'gruppengroesse verwendet' END AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert,
           concat('buchungen ', sum(buchungen), ' / kommerzielle plaetze ', sum(kommerzielle_plaetze),
                  ' / endplaetze ', sum(plaetze), ' / netto ', round(sum(netto), 2)) AS hinweis
    FROM je_termin WHERE buchungen > 0
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Ueberbuchung kombiniert',
           concat(to_char(date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ' ', left(name, 38)),
           plaetze::numeric,
           concat('hoechstzahl ', user_maximum, ' / buchungen ', buchungen,
                  ' / gruppe+bezahlt ', kommerzielle_plaetze, ' / netto ', netto)
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE user_maximum > 0 AND plaetze > user_maximum

    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Auslastung ab 2023',
           CASE WHEN user_maximum IS NULL OR user_maximum = 0 THEN 'ohne hoechstzahl'
                WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum > 1 THEN 'ueber 100 prozent'
                WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum >= 0.75 THEN '75 bis 100 prozent'
                WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum >= 0.5 THEN '50 bis 75 prozent'
                WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum >= 0.25 THEN '25 bis 50 prozent'
                ELSE 'unter 25 prozent' END,
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('plaetze ', sum(plaetze), ' / netto ', round(sum(netto), 2))
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE date_start >= '2023-01-01' AND buchungen > 0
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Jahresmittel',
           concat('jahr ', extract(year FROM date_start)::int),
           round(avg(plaetze::numeric / user_maximum) * 100, 1),
           concat('termine ', count(*), ' / plaetze ', sum(plaetze),
                  ' / hoechstzahl ', sum(user_maximum), ' / netto ', round(sum(netto), 2))
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE user_maximum > 0 AND buchungen > 0
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 50, 'E Kontrolltermin',
           concat(to_char(date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ' ', left(name, 38)),
           plaetze::numeric,
           concat('hoechstzahl ', user_maximum, ' / buchungen ', buchungen,
                  ' / gruppe+bezahlt ', kommerzielle_plaetze, ' / netto ', netto)
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE date_start IN ('2022-11-21', '2022-11-22', '2022-11-28', '2022-12-01',
                         '2023-07-19', '2024-02-02', '2024-11-05', '2026-05-21')
)
SELECT 'S40' AS schritt, count(*) AS zeilen,
       string_agg(concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')), coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
                  chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl) AS bericht
FROM roh;

-- Prueft die Bruecke Rechnung zu Buchung ueber invoice_item.transaction_id.
-- Nur lesend. Ausgabe als Kennzahlenliste.
WITH bruecke AS (
    SELECT
        i.item_key,
        i.invoice_id,
        i.item_type,
        i.vat_percent,
        i.amount,
        t.transaction_id,
        t.booking_id
    FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_item i
    LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.booking_transaction t
           ON t.transaction_id = i.transaction_id
),
je_rechnung AS (
    SELECT invoice_id, count(DISTINCT booking_id) AS buchungen
    FROM bruecke
    WHERE booking_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY invoice_id
),
je_buchung AS (
    SELECT booking_id, count(DISTINCT invoice_id) AS rechnungen
    FROM bruecke
    WHERE booking_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY booking_id
),
abdeckung AS (
    SELECT
        extract(year FROM r.date_create)::int AS jahr,
        count(*)                                                        AS rechnungen,
        count(r.tax_total)                                              AS mit_counts,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.anzahl > 0)                            AS mit_zeilen,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.anzahl > 0)                            AS mit_zahlung
    FROM edoobox_raw.invoice r
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT invoice_id, count(*) AS anzahl FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_line    GROUP BY 1) l ON l.invoice_id = r.invoice_id
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT invoice_id, count(*) AS anzahl FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_payment GROUP BY 1) p ON p.invoice_id = r.invoice_id
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT * FROM (
    -- A. Grundzahlen der Brücke
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Bruecke' AS bereich, 'posten gesamt' AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert, NULL::text AS hinweis FROM bruecke
    UNION ALL SELECT 11, 'A Bruecke', 'posten mit vorgangskennung',
           count(transaction_id)::numeric, NULL FROM bruecke
    UNION ALL SELECT 12, 'A Bruecke', 'posten mit treffer in booking_transaction',
           count(booking_id)::numeric, NULL FROM bruecke
    UNION ALL SELECT 13, 'A Bruecke', 'posten mit kennung aber ohne treffer',
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND booking_id IS NULL)::numeric,
           'verweist auf gelöschte oder fremde Buchung' FROM bruecke
    UNION ALL SELECT 14, 'A Bruecke', 'posten ganz ohne kennung',
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_id IS NULL)::numeric,
           (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT item_type, ', ') FROM bruecke WHERE transaction_id IS NULL)
           FROM bruecke

    -- B. Reichweite
    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Reichweite', 'rechnungen gesamt',
           count(*)::numeric, NULL FROM edoobox_raw.invoice
    UNION ALL SELECT 21, 'B Reichweite', 'rechnungen mit mindestens einer buchung',
           count(*)::numeric, NULL FROM je_rechnung
    UNION ALL SELECT 22, 'B Reichweite', 'rechnungen ohne jede buchung',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.invoice r
             WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM je_rechnung j WHERE j.invoice_id = r.invoice_id))::numeric,
           NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 23, 'B Reichweite', 'buchungen erreicht',
           count(*)::numeric, NULL FROM je_buchung
    UNION ALL SELECT 24, 'B Reichweite', 'buchungen gesamt',
           count(*)::numeric, NULL FROM edoobox_raw.booking
    UNION ALL SELECT 25, 'B Reichweite', 'buchungen ohne rechnung',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
             WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM je_buchung j WHERE j.booking_id = b.booking_id))::numeric,
           NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 26, 'B Reichweite', 'davon storniert oder warteliste',
           (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
             WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM je_buchung j WHERE j.booking_id = b.booking_id)
               AND b.status <> 'gebucht')::numeric,
           NULL

    -- C. Buchungen je Rechnung
    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Buchungen je Rechnung', 'genau eine',
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE buchungen = 1)::numeric, 'eindeutig' FROM je_rechnung
    UNION ALL SELECT 31, 'C Buchungen je Rechnung', 'zwei bis fuenf',
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE buchungen BETWEEN 2 AND 5)::numeric, 'geschlossener Kurs' FROM je_rechnung
    UNION ALL SELECT 32, 'C Buchungen je Rechnung', 'sechs und mehr',
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE buchungen >= 6)::numeric, 'Sammelrechnung' FROM je_rechnung
    UNION ALL SELECT 33, 'C Buchungen je Rechnung', 'hoechstwert',
           max(buchungen)::numeric, NULL FROM je_rechnung

    -- D. Rechnungen je Buchung
    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Rechnungen je Buchung', 'genau eine',
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE rechnungen = 1)::numeric, NULL FROM je_buchung
    UNION ALL SELECT 41, 'D Rechnungen je Buchung', 'zwei und mehr',
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE rechnungen >= 2)::numeric,
           'Teilzahlung, Storno mit Neuausstellung' FROM je_buchung
    UNION ALL SELECT 42, 'D Rechnungen je Buchung', 'hoechstwert',
           max(rechnungen)::numeric, NULL FROM je_buchung

    -- E. Postenart
    UNION ALL SELECT 50, 'E Postenart', coalesce(item_type, 'ohne angabe'),
           count(*)::numeric, NULL FROM bruecke GROUP BY item_type

    -- F. Steuersatz aus der Rechnung gegen B2B-Kennzeichen der Buchung
    UNION ALL SELECT 60, 'F Steuersatz', concat(coalesce(b.vat_percent::text, 'ohne'), ' Prozent'),
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('b2b ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE k.is_b2b), ' / nicht b2b ',
                  count(*) FILTER (WHERE k.is_b2b IS NOT TRUE))
           FROM bruecke b
           LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.booking k ON k.booking_id = b.booking_id
           GROUP BY b.vat_percent

    -- G. Betragsabgleich
    UNION ALL SELECT 70, 'G Betraege', 'summe posten brutto',
           round(sum(amount), 2), NULL FROM bruecke
    UNION ALL SELECT 71, 'G Betraege', 'summe rechnungsbetrag',
           (SELECT round(sum(amount), 2) FROM edoobox_raw.invoice)::numeric, NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 72, 'G Betraege', 'summe steuer aus counts',
           (SELECT round(sum(tax_total), 2) FROM edoobox_raw.invoice)::numeric,
           'nur neuere Rechnungen'
    UNION ALL SELECT 73, 'G Betraege', 'summe belege',
           (SELECT round(sum(amount), 2) FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_receipt)::numeric, NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 74, 'G Betraege', 'summe zahlungen',
           (SELECT round(sum(amount), 2) FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_payment)::numeric, NULL

    -- H. Abdeckung der Detailstruktur je Jahr
    UNION ALL SELECT 80, 'H Abdeckung je Jahr', coalesce(jahr::text, 'ohne datum'),
           rechnungen::numeric,
           concat('counts ', mit_counts, ' / zeilen ', mit_zeilen, ' / zahlung ', mit_zahlung)
           FROM abdeckung
) x
ORDER BY ordnung, kennzahl;

-- Drei moeglichst unterschiedliche Buchungen: eine bezahlte,
-- eine stornierte und eine mit mehreren Teilnehmern.
(SELECT booking_id FROM edoobox_raw.booking
  WHERE is_deleted = false AND status = 'gebucht'
  ORDER BY booking_time DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
(SELECT booking_id FROM edoobox_raw.booking
  WHERE is_deleted = false AND status = 'storniert'
  ORDER BY booking_time DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
(SELECT b.booking_id FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
  JOIN edoobox_raw.booking_position p ON p.booking_id = b.booking_id
  WHERE b.is_deleted = false
  GROUP BY b.booking_id, b.booking_time
  ORDER BY sum(p.quantity) DESC, b.booking_time DESC LIMIT 1);

DROP VIEW IF EXISTS kursplan.v_kursart_db1;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS kursplan.v_termin_db1;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS kursplan.v_angebot_trainerkosten;

CREATE VIEW kursplan.v_angebot_trainerkosten AS
WITH vorgabe AS (
    SELECT eigenunterricht, plattform_je_termin, vor_nachbereitung
    FROM kursplan.kosten_vorgabe
    WHERE vorgabe_id = 'standard'
),
zuordnung AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.offer_id, dl.admin_id
    FROM edoobox_raw.offer_date d
    JOIN edoobox_raw.date_leader dl ON dl.date_id = d.date_id
    WHERE d.is_deleted = false
),
basis AS (
    SELECT
        t.offer_id,
        t.kurscode,
        t.kursbezeichnung,
        t.date_start,
        t.termin_status,
        t.buchungen_gebucht,
        t.netto_gebucht,
        z.admin_id,
        p.trainer_code,
        p.kostenrolle,
        p.tarif_1,
        p.tarif_2,
        p.standard_tarif,
        r.tarif AS regel_tarif,
        r.trainerkosten_override AS regel_override,
        x.tarif AS ausnahme_tarif,
        x.trainerkosten_override AS ausnahme_override,
        coalesce(x.ist_kostenrelevant, true) AS ist_kostenrelevant,
        coalesce(a.kosten_aktiv,
            CASE
                WHEN t.termin_status::text = '5' THEN false
                WHEN t.termin_status::text IN ('2', '4') THEN true
                WHEN t.termin_status::text IN ('0', '1', '3')
                     AND t.buchungen_gebucht > 0 THEN true
                ELSE false
            END
        ) AS kosten_aktiv,
        CASE
            WHEN t.date_start::date > current_date THEN 'prognose'
            ELSE 'ist'
        END::text AS kostenphase,
        CASE
            WHEN a.kosten_aktiv IS NOT NULL THEN 'angebotsausnahme'
            WHEN t.termin_status::text = '5' THEN 'abgesagt'
            WHEN t.termin_status::text IN ('2', '4') THEN 'status'
            WHEN t.buchungen_gebucht > 0 THEN 'buchung'
            ELSE 'nicht aktiv'
        END::text AS kostenaktivierung,
        coalesce(a.plattform_override, v.plattform_je_termin) AS plattform_pauschale,
        coalesce(a.vor_nachbereitung_override, v.vor_nachbereitung) AS vor_nachbereitung_pauschale,
        v.eigenunterricht
    FROM kursplan.v_kursart_termin t
    CROSS JOIN vorgabe v
    LEFT JOIN zuordnung z ON z.offer_id = t.offer_id
    LEFT JOIN kursplan.trainer_kostenprofil_admin p
      ON p.admin_id = z.admin_id AND p.ist_aktiv
    LEFT JOIN kursplan.trainer_kurs_tarifregel r
      ON r.admin_id = z.admin_id
     AND r.kurscode = t.kurscode
     AND r.ist_aktiv
    LEFT JOIN kursplan.angebot_trainer_kostenausnahme x
      ON x.offer_id = t.offer_id AND x.admin_id = z.admin_id
    LEFT JOIN kursplan.angebot_kostenausnahme a
      ON a.offer_id = t.offer_id
),
aufgeloest AS (
    SELECT b.*,
           coalesce(ausnahme_tarif, regel_tarif, standard_tarif) AS verwendeter_tarif,
           coalesce(ausnahme_override, regel_override) AS verwendeter_override
    FROM basis b
),
berechnet AS (
    SELECT a.*,
           CASE
               WHEN NOT kosten_aktiv OR NOT ist_kostenrelevant THEN 0::numeric
               WHEN admin_id IS NULL THEN NULL::numeric
               WHEN kostenrolle = 'keine' THEN 0::numeric
               WHEN kostenrolle = 'eigen' THEN
                    coalesce(verwendeter_override, eigenunterricht)
               WHEN kostenrolle = 'fremd' THEN
                    coalesce(
                        verwendeter_override,
                        CASE verwendeter_tarif
                            WHEN 'tarif_1' THEN tarif_1
                            WHEN 'tarif_2' THEN tarif_2
                        END
                    )
               ELSE NULL::numeric
           END AS trainerkosten
    FROM aufgeloest a
)
SELECT
    b.*,
    CASE
        WHEN kosten_aktiv AND ist_kostenrelevant AND trainerkosten IS NULL
        THEN true ELSE false
    END AS kostenkonfiguration_fehlt
FROM berechnet b;

COMMENT ON VIEW kursplan.v_angebot_trainerkosten IS
'Eine Zeile je Trainerzuordnung und Gesamtangebot. Mehrere Trainer bleiben getrennt und ihre Kosten werden spaeter addiert.';

CREATE VIEW kursplan.v_termin_db1 AS
WITH kosten AS (
    SELECT
        offer_id,
        bool_or(kosten_aktiv) AS kosten_aktiv,
        min(kostenphase) AS kostenphase,
        min(kostenaktivierung) AS kostenaktivierung,
        count(admin_id) FILTER (WHERE ist_kostenrelevant) AS trainer_anzahl,
        array_agg(trainer_code ORDER BY trainer_code)
            FILTER (WHERE admin_id IS NOT NULL AND ist_kostenrelevant) AS trainer_codes,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE kostenkonfiguration_fehlt) AS fehlende_trainerkonfigurationen,
        bool_or(kostenkonfiguration_fehlt) AS kostenkonfiguration_fehlt,
        CASE
            WHEN bool_or(kostenkonfiguration_fehlt) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE round(sum(trainerkosten), 2)
        END AS trainerkosten,
        max(CASE WHEN kosten_aktiv THEN plattform_pauschale ELSE 0 END) AS plattformkosten,
        max(CASE WHEN kosten_aktiv THEN vor_nachbereitung_pauschale ELSE 0 END) AS vor_nachbereitungskosten
    FROM kursplan.v_angebot_trainerkosten
    GROUP BY offer_id
)
SELECT
    t.*,
    k.kosten_aktiv,
    k.kostenphase,
    k.kostenaktivierung,
    k.trainer_anzahl,
    k.trainer_codes,
    k.fehlende_trainerkonfigurationen,
    k.kostenkonfiguration_fehlt,
    k.trainerkosten,
    round(k.plattformkosten, 2) AS plattformkosten,
    round(k.vor_nachbereitungskosten, 2) AS vor_nachbereitungskosten,
    CASE
        WHEN k.trainerkosten IS NULL THEN NULL::numeric
        ELSE round(k.trainerkosten + k.plattformkosten + k.vor_nachbereitungskosten, 2)
    END AS direkte_kosten,
    CASE
        WHEN t.netto_gebucht IS NULL OR k.trainerkosten IS NULL THEN NULL::numeric
        ELSE round(t.netto_gebucht - k.trainerkosten - k.plattformkosten - k.vor_nachbereitungskosten, 2)
    END AS db1
FROM kursplan.v_kursart_termin t
JOIN kosten k ON k.offer_id = t.offer_id;

COMMENT ON VIEW kursplan.v_termin_db1 IS
'DB I je produktivem Gesamtangebot. Trainerkosten werden je Zuordnung addiert; Plattformkosten nur einmal je Angebot.';

CREATE VIEW kursplan.v_kursart_db1 AS
SELECT
    kurscode,
    min(kursbezeichnung) AS kursbezeichnung,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01') AS termine,
    count(*) FILTER (
        WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01' AND kosten_aktiv
    ) AS termine_mit_kosten,
    round(sum(netto_gebucht) FILTER (
        WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01'
    ), 2) AS netto,
    round(sum(direkte_kosten) FILTER (
        WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01'
    ), 2) AS direkte_kosten_berechenbar,
    round(sum(db1) FILTER (
        WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01'
    ), 2) AS db1_berechenbar,
    count(*) FILTER (
        WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01' AND kostenkonfiguration_fehlt
    ) AS konfiguration_fehlt
FROM kursplan.v_termin_db1
GROUP BY kurscode;

COMMENT ON VIEW kursplan.v_kursart_db1 IS
'Aggregierte DB-I-Kennzahlen je Kursart ab 2023. Offene Trainerkosten werden nicht als Nullkosten behandelt.';

    kursplan.angebot_kostenausnahme
TO n8n_writer;

GRANT SELECT ON
    kursplan.v_angebot_trainerkosten,
    kursplan.v_termin_db1,
    kursplan.v_kursart_db1
TO n8n_writer;

WITH roh AS (
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung,
           'A Kostenprofil'::text AS bereich,
           kostenrolle AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert,
           concat('Profile ', string_agg(trainer_code, ' / ' ORDER BY trainer_code)) AS hinweis
    FROM kursplan.trainer_kostenprofil_admin
    WHERE ist_aktiv
    GROUP BY kostenrolle

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 20, 'B Konfiguration offen',
           coalesce(trainer_code, '(ohne Profil oder Trainer)'),
           count(DISTINCT offer_id)::numeric,
           concat('Kurscodes ', count(DISTINCT kurscode),
                  ' / Netto ', round(sum(coalesce(netto_gebucht, 0)), 2))
    FROM kursplan.v_angebot_trainerkosten
    WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01'
      AND kostenkonfiguration_fehlt
    GROUP BY trainer_code

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 30, 'C DB I', 'vollstaendig berechenbare Angebote',
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('DB I ', round(sum(db1), 2),
                  ' / Netto ', round(sum(netto_gebucht), 2),
                  ' / direkte Kosten ', round(sum(direkte_kosten), 2))
    FROM kursplan.v_termin_db1
    WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01'
      AND NOT kostenkonfiguration_fehlt

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 40, 'D Kontrolle', 'Angebote mit offener Kostenkonfiguration',
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('Netto ', round(sum(coalesce(netto_gebucht, 0)), 2))
    FROM kursplan.v_termin_db1
    WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01'
      AND kostenkonfiguration_fehlt

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 50, 'E Kontrolle', 'produktives Netto ab 2023',
           round(coalesce(sum(netto_gebucht), 0), 2),
           'muss 430049.62 entsprechen'
    FROM kursplan.v_termin_db1
    WHERE date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01'
)
SELECT
    'S59a' AS schritt,
    count(*) AS zeilen,
    string_agg(
        concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl,
                  trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')), hinweis),
        chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, kennzahl
    ) AS bericht
FROM roh;

-- Rein lesende Grundlage fuer die spaetere Tarifpflege.
-- Jeder Trainer wird je Gesamtangebot genau einmal gezaehlt.
-- Bei Mehrfachzuweisungen ist der Erloes je Trainer nur ein Kontextwert und nicht addierbar.
WITH produktiv AS (
    SELECT t.offer_id, t.kurscode, t.kursbezeichnung, t.date_start,
           coalesce(t.netto_gebucht, 0)::numeric AS netto_gebucht
    FROM kursplan.v_kursart_termin t
    WHERE t.date_start >= timestamptz '2023-01-01 00:00:00 Europe/Berlin'
),
angebot_trainer AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.offer_id, dl.admin_id
    FROM edoobox_raw.offer_date d
    JOIN edoobox_raw.date_leader dl ON dl.date_id = d.date_id
    WHERE d.is_deleted = false
),
basis AS (
    SELECT p.*, z.admin_id, a.shortcut, a.is_active AS admin_aktiv,
           CASE
               WHEN z.admin_id IS NULL THEN 'offen'
               WHEN z.admin_id = 'admin_4c155f660347_225880320' THEN 'eigen'
               WHEN z.admin_id IN ('admin_802a0b62c8fa_230986090', 'admin_67d66851a4fb_399776305') THEN 'dummy'
               WHEN z.admin_id = 'admin_4fd8d3239e95_247330005' THEN 'administrativ'
               WHEN a.admin_id IS NULL THEN 'historisch_offen'
               ELSE 'fremd_offen'
           END::text AS kostenrolle,
           CASE
               WHEN z.admin_id IS NULL THEN '(ohne Trainer)'
               WHEN z.admin_id = 'admin_4c155f660347_225880320' THEN 'FW'
               WHEN z.admin_id = 'admin_802a0b62c8fa_230986090' THEN 'PP'
               WHEN z.admin_id = 'admin_67d66851a4fb_399776305' THEN 'Hansi Hansen'
               WHEN z.admin_id = 'admin_4fd8d3239e95_247330005' THEN 'PG'
               ELSE coalesce(nullif(a.shortcut, ''), z.admin_id)
           END::text AS trainer
    FROM produktiv p
    LEFT JOIN angebot_trainer z ON z.offer_id = p.offer_id
    LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.trainer_admin a ON a.admin_id = z.admin_id AND a.is_deleted = false
),
trainer_gesamt AS (
    SELECT trainer, kostenrolle, admin_id, bool_or(admin_aktiv) AS admin_aktiv,
           count(DISTINCT offer_id) AS angebote,
           count(DISTINCT kurscode) AS kurscodes,
           round(sum(netto_gebucht), 2) AS netto_kontext,
           min(date_start) AS erster_einsatz, max(date_start) AS letzter_einsatz
    FROM basis
    GROUP BY trainer, kostenrolle, admin_id
),
trainer_kurs AS (
    SELECT trainer, kostenrolle, admin_id, bool_or(admin_aktiv) AS admin_aktiv,
           kurscode, min(kursbezeichnung) AS kursbezeichnung,
           count(DISTINCT offer_id) AS angebote,
           round(sum(netto_gebucht), 2) AS netto_kontext,
           min(date_start) AS erster_einsatz, max(date_start) AS letzter_einsatz
    FROM basis
    GROUP BY trainer, kostenrolle, admin_id, kurscode
),
kontrolle AS (
    SELECT count(*)::bigint AS angebote,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM angebot_trainer at WHERE at.offer_id = p.offer_id
           ))::bigint AS ohne_trainer,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE (
               SELECT count(*) FROM angebot_trainer at WHERE at.offer_id = p.offer_id
           ) > 1)::bigint AS mehrfachtrainer,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM angebot_trainer at
               WHERE at.offer_id = p.offer_id
                 AND at.admin_id IN (
                     'admin_802a0b62c8fa_230986090',
                     'admin_67d66851a4fb_399776305',
                     'admin_4fd8d3239e95_247330005'
                 )
           ))::bigint AS dummy_oder_admin,
           round(sum(p.netto_gebucht), 2) AS netto
    FROM produktiv p
),
roh AS (
    SELECT 10 AS sort_bereich,
           'S56'::text AS schritt, 'A Trainerbestand'::text AS bereich,
           g.trainer, g.kostenrolle, g.admin_id, g.admin_aktiv,
           NULL::text AS kurscode, NULL::text AS kursbezeichnung,
           g.angebote, g.kurscodes, g.netto_kontext AS netto_ab_2023,
           g.erster_einsatz, g.letzter_einsatz,
           'Erloes ist bei Mehrfachtrainern nicht ueber Trainerzeilen addierbar'::text AS hinweis
    FROM trainer_gesamt g

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 20, 'S56', 'B Trainer x Kurscode',
           k.trainer, k.kostenrolle, k.admin_id, k.admin_aktiv,
           k.kurscode, k.kursbezeichnung, k.angebote, NULL::bigint,
           k.netto_kontext, k.erster_einsatz, k.letzter_einsatz,
           'Grundlage fuer trainer- und themenabhaengige Tarife'::text
    FROM trainer_kurs k

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 30, 'S56', 'C Kontrolle', '(gesamt)', 'kontrolle',
           NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, c.angebote, NULL::bigint, c.netto,
           NULL, NULL,
           concat('ohne Trainer ', c.ohne_trainer,
                  ' / Mehrfachtrainer ', c.mehrfachtrainer,
                  ' / Dummy oder administrativ ', c.dummy_oder_admin)
    FROM kontrolle c
)
SELECT schritt, bereich, trainer, kostenrolle, admin_id, admin_aktiv,
       kurscode, kursbezeichnung, angebote, kurscodes, netto_ab_2023,
       erster_einsatz, letzter_einsatz, hinweis
FROM roh
ORDER BY sort_bereich, kostenrolle, trainer, angebote DESC, kurscode NULLS FIRST;
